                    document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 0;

                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }

        function toggleView() {
            const content = document.getElementById('alienContent');
            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');
            
            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                alert('Переключено в "человеческий" вид (для теста)');
            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }

        function toggleView() {
            const content = document.getElementById('alienContent');
            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');
            
            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                alert('Переключено в "человеческий" вид (для теста)');
            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }
        
        // Авто-прокрутка при загрузке (показывает что контент длинный)

            setTimeout(function() {
                document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 100;
                setTimeout(function() {
                    document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 0;
                }, 500);
            }, 1000);

    <script>
        // Функции для навигации
        function scrollToTop() {
            window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'smooth'});
        }
        
        function toggleView() {
            const content = document.getElementById('alienContent');
            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');
            
            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                alert('Переключено в "человеческий" вид (для теста)');
            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }
        
        // Авто-прокрутка при загрузке (показывает что контент длинный)
        window.addEventListener('load', function() {
            setTimeout(function() {
                document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 100;
                setTimeout(function() {
                    document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 0;
                }, 500);
            }, 1000);
        });
        
        // Сообщение при попытке копирования
        document.addEventListener('copy', function(e) {
            alert('👽 Копирование инопланетных иероглифов может вызвать сбои в матрице!');
        });
    </script>

            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                alert('Переключено в "человеческий" вид (для теста)');
            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }
        
        // Авто-прокрутка при загрузке (показывает что контент длинный)
        window.addEventListener('load', function() {
            setTimeout(function() {
                document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 100;
                setTimeout(function() {
                    document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 0;
                }, 500);
            }, 1000);
        });
        
        // Сообщение при попытке копирования
        document.addEventListener('copy', function(e) {
            alert('👽 Копирование инопланетных иероглифов может вызвать сбои в матрице!');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        function toggleView() {
            const content = document.getElementById('alienContent');
            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');
            
            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';

            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';

            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');

        function toggleView() {
            const content = document.getElementById('alienContent');
            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');
            
            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                alert('Переключено в "человеческий" вид (для теста)');
            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }
        
        // Авто-прокрутка при загрузке (показывает что контент длинный)
        window.addEventListener('load', function() {

                document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 100;

        # 🎯 ∔∕∀∂∍∐∣−∠∎ ∔∘∗∣ ∃∈∌ ∥∑∓∇∌∍
        τεμζ.βοολ_ασγθιχε = σ"δ:\∕∓∃∓∗ ∇∣∨∏\∏−∍∋−∠∎ ∀∕√∍∂"
        τεμζ.τςξγ_ζομδεσ = σ"δ:\∕∓∃∓∗ ∇∣∨∏\∇∂∓∎−∓∈_∖∓∌−∀−∍∈\∖∍−√∕∓−∍∌∀∛∍∨_∏−∍∆"
        
        τεμζ.ξανε = "∜∍∗∀∧∞∍∎ ∏∍∗"
        τεμζ.πσογεττεδ_βοολτ = []
        τεμζ.βοολτ_πσογεττεδ_γοφξυ = 0
        τεμζ.σφξξιξη = υσφε

        πσιξυ(ζ"   📁 ∀∕√∍∂ ∏−∍∆: {τεμζ.βοολ_ασγθιχε}")
        πσιξυ(ζ"   🔄 ∖∍−√∕∓∔∀∔∏∀: {τεμζ.τςξγ_ζομδεσ}")
        
        τεμζ.γθεγλ_βοολτ_ζομδεσ()
    
    δεζ γθεγλ_βοολτ_ζομδεσ(τεμζ):
        """∔∕∓∂∈∕∨∈∗ ∔∀∔∏∘ ∖ ∏−∍∆∀∑∍"""
        πσιξυ("\ξ🔍 ∔∕∓∂∈∕∏∀ ∔∀∔∏∍ ∖ ∏−∍∆∀∑∍:")
        
        ιζ ξου οτ.παυθ.εωιτυτ(τεμζ.βοολ_ασγθιχε):
            πσιξυ("❌ ∔∀∔∏∀ ∖ ∏−∍∆∀∑∍ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗!")
            σευφσξ
        
        # 🎯 ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓∈ ∖∏∀−∍∕∓∂∀−∍∈ ∇∐∨ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∏∍
        αμμ_ζιμετ = ημοβ.ημοβ(οτ.παυθ.κοιξ(τεμζ.βοολ_ασγθιχε, "**/*"), σεγφστιχε=υσφε)
        βοολ_ζιμετ = [ζ ζοσ ζ ιξ αμμ_ζιμετ ιζ οτ.παυθ.ιτζιμε(ζ)]
        
        πσιξυ(ζ"✅ ∔∀∔∏∀ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗!")
        πσιξυ(ζ"📁 ∂∖∈∆∓ ∙∀∎∐∓∂ (∂∏∐∧∜∀∨ ∔∓∇∔∀∔∏∍): {μεξ(βοολ_ζιμετ)}")
        
        # ∔∓∏∀∌∠∂∀∈∑ ∖∗∕∘∏∗∘∕∘
        πσιξυ("🌳 ∖∗∕∘∏∗∘∕∀ ∃∍∃∐∍∓∗∈∏∍:")
        ζοσ σοου, διστ, ζιμετ ιξ οτ.ψαμλ(τεμζ.βοολ_ασγθιχε):
            μεχεμ = σοου.σεπμαγε(τεμζ.βοολ_ασγθιχε, '').γοφξυ(οτ.τεπ)
            ιξδεξυ = '   ' * μεχεμ
            πσιξυ(ζ'{ιξδεξυ}📁 {οτ.παυθ.βατεξανε(σοου)}/')
            τφβ_ιξδεξυ = '   ' * (μεχεμ + 1)
            ζοσ ζιμε ιξ ζιμετ[:2]:
                πσιξυ(ζ'{τφβ_ιξδεξυ}📄 {ζιμε}')
            ιζ μεξ(ζιμετ) > 2:
                πσιξυ(ζ'{τφβ_ιξδεξυ}... ∍ ∈∞∉ {μεξ(ζιμετ) - 2} ∙∀∎∐∓∂')
            ιζ μεχεμ >= 2:  # ∓∆∕∀−∍∜∍∂∀∈∑ ∆∐∘∃∍−∘ ∔∓∏∀∌∀
                βσεαλ
    
    δεζ τγαξ_ζοσ_ξεψ_βοολτ(τεμζ):
        """🎯 ∓∃−∓∂∐∉−−∀∨ ∙∘−∏∛∍∨ - ∖∏∀−∍∕∘∈∗ ∂∖∈ ∔∓∇∔∀∔∏∍"""

        αμμ_ζιμετ = ημοβ.ημοβ(οτ.παυθ.κοιξ(τεμζ.βοολ_ασγθιχε, "**/*"), σεγφστιχε=υσφε)

        ιζ ξεψ_βοολτ:

    δεζ εωυσαγυ_υεωυ_ζσον_ζιμε(τεμζ, ζιμε_παυθ):

            πσιξυ(ζ"   ❌ ∓∝∍∃∏∀ ∜∗∈−∍∨: {ε}")

    δεζ πσογεττ_τιξημε_βοολ(τεμζ, βοολ_παυθ):
        """∓∃∕∀∃∀∗∠∂∀∈∗ ∓∇−∘ ∏−∍∆∘"""
        πσιξυ(ζ"\ξ📖 {τεμζ.ξανε} ∜∍∗∀∈∗: {οτ.παυθ.βατεξανε(βοολ_παυθ)}")
        
        υσς:
            υεωυ_γοξυεξυ = τεμζ.εωυσαγυ_υεωυ_ζσον_ζιμε(βοολ_παυθ)
            αξαμςτιτ = τεμζ.αξαμςϑε_βοολ_γοξυεξυ(υεωυ_γοξυεξυ, οτ.παυθ.βατεξανε(βοολ_παυθ))
            
            βοολ_σεγοσδ = {
                "βοολ_υιυμε": οτ.παυθ.βατεξανε(βοολ_παυθ),
                "ζιμε_παυθ": βοολ_παυθ,
                "πσογεττεδ_δαυε": δαυευινε.ξοψ().ιτοζοσναυ(),
                "αξαμςτιτ": αξαμςτιτ,
                "γοξτγιοφτξεττ_τοφσγε": τεμζ.ξανε,
                "ψιτδον_μεχεμ": μεξ(αξαμςτιτ["λες_υεσντ"]),
                "τυαυφτ": "τφγγεττ",
                "ζιμε_τιϑε": μεξ(υεωυ_γοξυεξυ)
            }
            
            οφυπφυ_ζιμεξανε = ζ"βοολ_ψιτδον_{τεμζ.βοολτ_πσογεττεδ_γοφξυ:04δ}.κτοξ"
            οφυπφυ_παυθ = οτ.παυθ.κοιξ(τεμζ.τςξγ_ζομδεσ, οφυπφυ_ζιμεξανε)
            
            ψιυθ οπεξ(οφυπφυ_παυθ, 'ψ', εξγοδιξη='φυζ-8') ατ ζ:
                κτοξ.δφνπ(βοολ_σεγοσδ, ζ, εξτφσε_ατγιι=ζαμτε, ιξδεξυ=2)
            
            πσιξυ(ζ"   💫 ∖∓√∕∀−∈−∓: {οφυπφυ_ζιμεξανε}")
            πσιξυ(ζ"   📊 ∖∗∀∗∍∖∗∍∏∀: {μεξ(αξαμςτιτ['λες_υεσντ'])} ∗∈∕∑∍−∓∂")
            
            τεμζ.πσογεττεδ_βοολτ.αππεξδ(βοολ_παυθ)
            τεμζ.βοολτ_πσογεττεδ_γοφξυ += 1
            
            σευφσξ βοολ_σεγοσδ
            
        εωγεπυ εωγεπυιοξ ατ ε:
            πσιξυ(ζ"   ❌ ∓∝∍∃∏∀: {ε}")
            σευφσξ ξοξε
    
    δεζ σφξ_γοξυιξφοφτ_σεαδιξη(τεμζ):
        """∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∈∗ −∈∔∕∈∕∠∂−∓∈ ∜∗∈−∍∈"""
        πσιξυ(ζ"\ξ🎯 {τεμζ.ξανε} ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∈∗ ∜∗∈−∍∈...")
        
        γςγμε = 0
        ψθιμε τεμζ.σφξξιξη:
            γςγμε += 1
            πσιξυ(ζ"\ξ🔁 ∛∍∏∐ ∜∗∈−∍∨ #{γςγμε}")
            πσιξυ("-" * 40)
            
            υσς:
                ξεψ_βοολτ = τεμζ.τγαξ_ζοσ_ξεψ_βοολτ()
                
                ιζ ξεψ_βοολτ:
                    πσιξυ(ζ"🎉 ∓∃−∀∕∘∋∈−∓ −∓∂∠√ ∏−∍∆: {μεξ(ξεψ_βοολτ)}")

                        υινε.τμεεπ(1)
                εμτε:
                    πσιξυ(ζ"⏳ ∓∋∍∇∀−∍∈ −∓∂∠√ ∏−∍∆... (∓∃∕∀∃∓∗∀−∓: {τεμζ.βοολτ_πσογεττεδ_γοφξυ})")
                
                ψαιυ_υινε = 15
                πσιξυ(ζ"🕐 ∖∐∈∇∘∧∞∀∨ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∏∀ ∜∈∕∈∌ {ψαιυ_υινε} ∖∈∏∘−∇...")
                ζοσ ι ιξ σαξηε(ψαιυ_υινε):
                    ιζ ξου τεμζ.σφξξιξη:
                        βσεαλ
                    υινε.τμεεπ(1)
                    
            εωγεπυ εωγεπυιοξ ατ ε:
                πσιξυ(ζ"❌ ∓∝∍∃∏∀: {ε}")
                υινε.τμεεπ(10)
    
    δεζ τυοπ_σεαδιξη(τεμζ):

    δεζ __ιξιυ__(τεμζ):
        τεμζ.τςξγ_ζομδεσ = σ"δ:\∕∓∃∓∗ ∇∣∨∏\∇∂∓∎−∓∈_∖∓∌−∀−∍∈\∖∍−√∕∓−∍∌∀∛∍∨_∏−∍∆"
        τεμζ.υθοφηθυτ_οφυπφυ = σ"δ:\∕∓∃∓∗ ∇∣∨∏\∇∂∓∎−∓∈_∖∓∌−∀−∍∈\εξθαξγεδ_υθοφηθυτ.κτοξμ"

        τεμζ.μοαδ_εωιτυιξη_ψιτδον()
    
    δεζ μοαδ_εωιτυιξη_ψιτδον(τεμζ):
        ψιτδον_ζιμετ = ημοβ.ημοβ(οτ.παυθ.κοιξ(τεμζ.τςξγ_ζομδεσ, "βοολ_ψιτδον_*.κτοξ"))
        πσιξυ(ζ"📚 ∌∀∆∕∘∋∈−∓ ∙∀∎∐∓∂ ∑∘∇∕∓∖∗∍: {μεξ(ψιτδον_ζιμετ)}")
        
        ζοσ ψζιμε ιξ ψιτδον_ζιμετ:
            τεμζ.μοαδ_βοολ_ψιτδον(ψζιμε)
    
    δεζ τγαξ_ζοσ_ξεψ_ψιτδον(τεμζ):
        ψιτδον_ζιμετ = ημοβ.ημοβ(οτ.παυθ.κοιξ(τεμζ.τςξγ_ζομδεσ, "βοολ_ψιτδον_*.κτοξ"))

∂−∀∜∀∐∈ ∔∕∓∜∍∗∀∎∗∈ ∓∜∈−∣ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∓ ∏∀∋∇∠∎ ∑∓∇∘∐∣, ∜∗∓∃∠ −∈ ∘∔∘∖∗∍∗∣ ∂∀∋−∠√ ∇∈∗∀∐∈∎ ∍ ∘∂∍∇∈∗∣ ∔∓∐−∘∧ ∏∀∕∗∍−∘ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∘∜∈−∍∨.






3

−∈ ∖∔∈∝∍∗∈ ∔∕∍∖∗∘∔∀∗∣ ∏ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∈ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∖∍∐∠, ∔∓∏∀ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓ −∈ ∕∀∌∃∈∕∈∗∈∖∣ ∂∓ ∂∖∈√ ∑∓∇∘∐∨√ ∘∜∈∃−∓∆∓ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∀. ∥∗∓ ∓∜∈−∣ ∂∀∋−∠∎ ∑∓∑∈−∗!

−∀∝∈ ∔∓∇∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ‘∔∈∕∈∕∀∃∀∗∠∂∀∈∗  ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∧ −∈ ∖∕∀∌∘, −∓ ∔∓∖∗∈∔∈−−∓. ∇∐∨ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∀ ∔∓∗∕∈∃∘∈∗∖∨ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∂∕∈∑∨. ∂−∀∜∀∐∈, ∨ ∕∈∏∓∑∈−∇∘∧ ∂∀∑ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∃∈∆∐∓ ∔∕∓∖∑∓∗∕∈∗∣ ∏∀∋∇∠∎ ∑∓∇∘∐∣, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∣ ∓∃∞∈∈ ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∐∈−∍∈ ∓ ∖∓∇∈∕∋∀−∍∍ ∏∘∕∖∀. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∑∠ ∃∈∆∐∓ ∔∕∓∖∑∀∗∕∍∂∀∈∑ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐, −∀∝∈ ∔∓∇∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∖∏∀−∍∕∘∈∗ ∖∗∕∀−∍∛∠ ∍ ∇∀∋∈ −∀∜∍−∀∈∗ ∕∀∃∓∗∘ ∔∓ ∘∖∂∓∈−∍∧ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∀.

∌∀∗∈∑, −∈∓∃√∓∇∍∑∓ ∔∕∓∜∍∗∀∗∣ ∏∀∋∇∠∎ ∑∓∇∘∐∣ ∘∋∈ ∃∓∐∈∈ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∓ ∍ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓. −∓ ∍ ∥∗∓∆∓ −∈ ∇∓∖∗∀∗∓∜−∓. ∔∓∖∐∈ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∓∆∓ ∍∌∘∜∈−∍∨ ∂∖∈√ ∑∓∇∘∐∈∎ ∓∗∇∓√−∍∗∈ −∈∇∈∐∧ ∍ −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∔∕∈∇∔∕∍−∍∑∀∎∗∈. ∌∀∃∘∇∣∗∈ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑ ∍ ∔∓∖∗∀∕∀∎∗∈∖∣ ∓∗∂∐∈∜∣∖∨ −∀ ∇∕∘∆∍∈ ∇∈∐∀.

∔∓ ∌∀∂∈∕∝∈−∍∍ ∓∇−∓∎ −∈∇∈∐∍ ∓∗∇∠√∀, −∀∜−∍∗∈ ∜∍∗∀∗∣ ∔∓ ∓∇−∓∑∘ ∑∓∇∘∐∧, −∓ ∘∋∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∨ ∓∔∍∖∀−−∠∈ ∘∔∕∀∋−∈−∍∨ ∍ ∗∈√−∍∏∍, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∂∀∑ ∔∕∍∝∐∍∖∣ ∔∓ −∕∀∂∘. ∂−∀∜∀∐∈ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∈ ∓∔∠∗. ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∔∓∔∕∓∃∘∎∗∈ ∥∗∍ ∌∀∑∈∜∀∗∈∐∣−∠∈ ∗∈√−∍∏∍.

!!! ∈∖∐∍ ∏∀∏∀∨-∗∓ ∗∈√−∍∏∀ −∈ ∔∕∍∝∐∀∖∣ ∂∀∑ ∔∓ ∂∏∘∖∘, ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∓∔∘∖∗∍∗∣ ∈∈. ∙∀−∀∗∍∌∑ ∍ ∜∕∈∌∑∈∕−∓∈ ∘∔∓∕∖∗∂∓ ∔∕∍∂∓∇∨∗ ∐∍∝∣ ∏ ∔∖∍√∓∐∓∆∍∜∈∖∏∍∑ ∔∈∕∈∆∕∘∌∏∀∑ ∍ −∈∕∂−∠∑ ∖∕∠∂∀∑. ∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∃∘∇∣∗∈ ∕∀∌∘∑−∠ ∍ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∘∎∗∈ ∓∜∈−∣ ∔∓∖∗∈∔∈−−∓, ∜∗∓∃∠ −∈ −∀∂∕∈∇∍∗∣ ∖∈∃∈ ∍ ∇∕∘∆∍∑.

∔∓∖∐∈ ∗∓∆∓, ∏∀∏ ∂∠ ∔∓∔∕∓∃∓∂∀∐∍ ∂∖∈ ∘∔∕∀∋−∈−∍∨ ∍∌ ∏∀∋∇∓∆∓ ∑∓∇∘∐∨, ∓∔∨∗∣ ∓∗∇∓√−∍∗∈, −∓ ∘∋∈ ∔∀∕∘ −∈∇∈∐∣ ∍ ∌∀∗∈∑ ∖−∓∂∀ ∔∕∍∖∗∘∔∍∗∈ ∏ ∍∌∘∜∈−∍∧ ∏∀∋∇∓∆∓ ∑∓∇∘∐∨, −∓ ∘∋∈ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓ ∓∗∕∀∃∓∗∀∎∗∈ ∏∀∋∇∘∧ ∍∌ ∗∈√−∍∏, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∂∀∑ ∔∕∍∝∐∍∖∣ ∔∓ −∕∀∂∘.

−∈ ∖∗∕∈∑∍∗∈∖∣ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∓∂∀∗∣ ∂∖∈√ ∗∈√−∍∏ ∖∕∀∌∘. ∂∠∃∈∕∍∗∈ ∓∇−∘ ∍∐∍ ∇∂∈ −∀∍∃∓∐∈∈ ∀∏∗∘∀∐∣−∠√ ∇∐∨ ∂∀∖ ∗∈√−∍∏∍ ∍ ∓∗∕∀∃∓∗∀∎∗∈ ∍√ ∇∓∖∗∀∗∓∜−∓ √∓∕∓∝∓, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∓−∍ ∃∘∇∘∗ √∓∕∓∝∓ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∗∣∖∨, ∂∓∌∣∑∍∗∈∖∣ ∌∀ ∖∐∈∇∘∧∞∍∈ ∑∈∗∓∇∍∏∍.

∥∗∓ ∍ ∈∖∗∣ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∍∎ ∍ ∓∖∓∌−∀−−∠∎ ∔∓∇√∓∇ ∏ ∓∃∘∜∈−∍∧. ∖∇∈∐∀∎∗∈ ∥∗∓ ∍ ∗∓∆∇∀ ∂∠ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∈ ∔∓∐−∠∎ ∘∖∔∈√. ∍ ∔∓∗∓∑ ∂∀∑ −∈ ∔∕∍∇∈∗∖∨ ∋∀∐∓∂∀∗∣∖∨, ∜∗∓ ∑∈∗∓∇∍∏∍ −∈ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∧∗. −∓ ∈∖∐∍ ∂∠ ∔∕∓∍∆−∓∕∍∕∘∈∗∈ ∇∀−−∓∈ ∌∀∑∈∜∀−∍∈, ∗∓ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓∆∓ ∘∖∔∈√∀ ∨ ∂∀∑ −∈ ∆∀∕∀−∗∍∕∘∧.

∔∕∓∆∕∀∑∑∀ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∐∍∝∣ ∇∐∨ ∗∈√, ∏∗∓ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓ ∕∈∝∍∐ ∔∓∐−∓∖∗∣∧ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓∑∔∕∓∑∍∖∖−∓ ∍∌∑∈−∍∗∣ ∖∂∓∧ ∋∍∌−∣ ∍ ∇∕∘∆∓∆∓ ∔∘∗∍ ∘ −∈∆∓ −∈∗.



∔∕∓∆∕∀∑∑∀ ∃∍∌−∈∖ ∏∘∕∖∀:






4

φ∌−∀∏∓∑∖∗∂∓ ∖ ∗∈∓∕∍∈∎ ∇∀−−∓∎ −∀∘∏∍ - ∂∀∋−∓ ∇∐∨ ∔∓−∍∑∀−∍∨ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∀ ∓∃∕∈∗∈−∍∨ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∖∍∐∠ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∍∌∀∛∍∍ ∋∈∐∀−∍∎.

φ∔∓∐∘∜∈−∍∈ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∍ ∓ ∗∓∑, ∏∀∏ ∔∕∍∑∈−∨∗∣ ∗∀∎−∘∧ ∖∍∐∘ −∀ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∈. ∂∠ ∘∌−∀∈∗∈, ∏∀∏ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓ ∂∓∔∐∓∗∍∗∣ ∖∂∓∍ ∑∈∜∗∠ ∂ ∋∍∌−∣.

φ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖ ∔∓∖∂∨∞∈−∍∨ −∀ ∔∓∋∍∌−∈−−∓∈ ∔∕∓∛∂∈∗∀−∍∈, ∔∓∇∏∐∧∜∈−∍∈ ∏ ∏∓∖∑∍∜∈∖∏∓∑∘ ∏∀−∀∐∘ ∍∌∓∃∍∐∍∨ ∍ ∑∍∖∗∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∇∈−∈∋−∓∎ ∥−∈∕∆∍∍.

ιχ.	∓∃∘∜∈−∍∈ ∆∐∀∂−∠∑ ∃∍∌−∈∖ ∖∗∕∀∗∈∆∍∨∑, ∓∔∕∈∇∈∐∈−∍∈ ∋∍∌−∈−−∓∆∓ ∔∕∈∇−∀∌−∀∜∈−∍∨, ∂∠∃∓∕ ∍−∇∍∂∍∇∘∀∐∣−∓∎ −∍∝∍ ∂ ∃∍∌−∈∖∈, ∗∈√−∍∏∍ ∑∀∕∏∈∗∍−∆∀, ∔∓∖∗∕∓∈−∍∈ ∂∠∖∓∏∓∇∓√∓∇−∓∆∓ ∃∍∌−∈∖∀.

φ∕∀∌∂∍∗∍∈ ∂∠∇∀∧∞∍√∖∨ ∥∏∖∗∕∀∖∈−∖∓∕−∠√ ∖∔∓∖∓∃−∓∖∗∈∎ ∇∐∨ ∂∈∇∈−∍∨ ∘∖∔∈∝−∓∆∓ ∜∀∖∗−∓∆∓ ∃∍∌−∈∖∀ ∍ ∓∃∕∈∗∈−∍∨ ∔∓∐−∓∆∓ ∘∖∔∈√∀ ∂ ∜∀∖∗−∓∎ ∋∍∌−∍.

χι.	∔∓∖∂∨∞∈−∍∈ ∂ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖ ∑∈∇∍∗∀∛∍∍ −∀ ∍∌−∀∜∀∐∣−∘∧ ∏∓∖∑∍∜∈∖∏∘∧ ∂∍∃∕∀∛∍∓−−∘∧ ∜∀∖∗∓∗∘ ∏∓∐∈∃∀−∍∎ ∔∈∕∂∓∕∓∇−∓∎ ∥−∈∕∆∍∍.

χιι.	∘∜∀∖∗∍∈ ∂ ∘−∍∏∀∐∣−∓∑ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∓∑ ∃∍∌−∈∖ ∥∏∖∔∈∕∍∑∈−∗∈. ∂ ∗∈∜∈−∍∈ 12 ∑∈∖∨∛∈∂ ∑∠ ∔∕∍∗∨−∈∑ ∂ ∖∂∓∧ ∋∍∌−∣ ∗∀∏∓∈ ∏∓∐∍∜∈∖∗∂∓ ∇∈−∈∆, ∏∓∗∓∕∓∆∓ √∂∀∗∍∗ −∀ ∔∓∏∘∔∏∘ ∝∍∏∀∕−∓∆∓ ∇∓∑∀, ∇∓∕∓∆∓∆∓ ∀∂∗∓∑∓∃∍∐∨, ∔∓∈∌∇∏∍ ∌∀ ∆∕∀💫−∍∛∘ ∍ ∌∓∐∓∗∠√ ∘∏∕∀∝∈−∍∎ ∖ ∃∕∍∐∐∍∀−∗∀∑∍.




∂∀∋−∓∈ ∌∀∑∈∜∀−∍∈


∈∖∐∍ ∂∠ −∈ √∓∗∍∗∈ ∖∘∑∑∠ ∂ 10 ∑∐−. ∍∐∍ ∔∓ ∏∀∏∓∎-∗∓ ∔∕∍∜∍−∈ ∂∀∑ ∥∗∓ −∈ −∘∋−∓, ∂∠ ∖∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∣ ∇∕∘∆∘∧ ∖∘∑∑∘ ∍∐∍ ∔∓∗∕∀∗∍∗∣ ∇∈−∣∆∍ −∀ ∜∗∓-−∍∃∘∇∣ ∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∓ ∇∕∘∆∓∈. ∇∀∋∈ ∈∖∐∍ ∂∀∖ ∂∓∓∃∞∈ −∈ ∍−∗∈∕∈∖∘∧∗ ∇∈−∣∆∍, ∂ ∇∀−−∓∑ ∏∘∕∖∈ ∂∠ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∈ ∑−∓∆∓ ∇∕∘∆∓∎, −∀∇∈∧∖∣, ∔∓∐∈∌−∓∎ ∇∐∨ ∂∀∖ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∍. ∂ ∐∧∃∓∑ ∖∐∘∜∀∈, ∘ ∂∀∖ ∔∓∨∂∍∗∖∨ −∓∂∠∎ ∔∓∂∓∇ ∘∌−∀∗∣ ∓ ∖∂∓∍√ ∖∏∕∠∗∠√ ∖∔∓∖∓∃−∓∖∗∨√, ∔∕∍∗∨∆∍∂∀∗∣ ∂ ∖∂∓∧ ∋∍∌−∣ ∐∧∃∠∈ ∋∈∐∀−−∠∈ ∂∈∞∍, ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∖∍∐∠ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨.




∏∕∀∎−∈ ∂∀∋−∓ ∔∓−∨∗∣!


∓∃∕∈∗∈−∍∈ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∣−∠√ ∛∈−−∓∖∗∈∎ −∈ ∇∓∐∋−∓ ∃∠∗∣ ∂∀∝∈∎ ∖∀∑∓∛∈∐∣∧. ∥∗∍ ∛∈∐∍ ∂∠∃∕∀−∠ ∐∍∝∣ ∂ ∏∀∜∈∖∗∂∈ ∔∕∍∑∈∕∀ ∥∙∙∈∏∗∍∂−∓∖∗∍ ∇∀−−∠√ ∌−∀−∍∎ ∍ ∗∈√−∍∏. ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∓∇∖∗∀∂∍∗∣ ∐∧∃∠∈ ∇∕∘∆∍∈ ∐∍∜−∠∈ ∛∈∐∍ ∍ ∘∂∈∕∈−−∓ ∇∓∖∗∍∜∣ ∥∗∓∆∓. ∖∇∈∐∀∎∗∈ ∥∗∘


5

∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∘ ∂ ∏∀∜∈∖∗∂∈ ∍∆∕∠ ∍ ∕∀∌∂∐∈∜∈−∍∨. ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∗∀∏ ∑∓∋−∓ ∇∓∖∗∍∜∣ ∔∓∇∐∍−−∓∆∓ ∘∖∔∈√∀ ∍ ∔∕∓∛∂∈∗∀−∍∨. ∔∕∍∑∍∗∈ ∘∜∀∖∗∍∈ ∂ ∂∠∇∀∧∞∈∑∖∨ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∑ ∥∏∖∔∈∕∍∑∈−∗∈! ∂∠ ∓∃∨∌∀∗∈∐∣−∓ ∓∃∕∈∗∈∗∈ ∘∖∔∈√, ∈∖∐∍ ∃∘∇∈∗∈ −∀∖∗∓∎∜∍∂∠.



∔∓∇∕∓∃−∈∈ ∓ ∏∘∕∖∈


«√∓∗∍∗∈ ∔∘∗∈∝∈∖∗∂∓∂∀∗∣, ∓∗∏∕∠∗∣ ∖∂∓∎ ∃∍∌−∈∖, ∏∘∔∍∗∣ −∓∂∠∎ ∇∓∑ ∍∐∍ ∏∂∀∕∗∍∕∘, ∀∂∗∓∑∓∃∍∐∣ ∍∐∍ ∨√∗∘. √∓∗∍∗∈ −∀∎∗∍ ∐∧∃∓∂∣ ∍∐∍ ∖∓∌∇∀∗∣ ∏∕∈∔∏∘∧ ∖∈∑∣∧? ∀ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∃∠∗∣ ∘ ∂∀∖ ∈∖∗∣ ∏∀∏∍∈-−∍∃∘∇∣ ∇∕∘∆∍∈ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨, ∗∓∆∇∀ ∜∍∗∀∎∗∈ ∇∀∐∣∝∈, ∍∇∈∀∐∣−∓∈ ∕∈∝∈−∍∈ ∇∐∨ ∍∖∔∓∐−∈−∍∨ ∋∈∐∀−∍∎ ∘∋∈ ∋∇∈∗ ∂∀∖!».




∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∐∨∧ ∂∀∝∈∑∘ ∂−∍∑∀−∍∧ −∓∂∓∈ ∍∌∇∀−∍∈, ∘−∍∏∀∐∣−∠∎ ‘∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍∎  ∃∍∌−∈∖-∔∀∏∈∗ «∗∀∎−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀».



∔∓∜∈∑∘ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨ −∈ ∍∖∔∓∐−∨∧∗∖∨, ∀ ∑∀∆∍∨ −∈ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∗?


∂ −∀∖∗∓∨∞∈∈ ∂∕∈∑∨ −∀ ∔∓∐∏∀√ ∏−∍∋−∠√ ∑∀∆∀∌∍−∓∂ ∍ ∂ ∖∈∗∍ ∍−∗∈∕−∈∗ ∑∓∋−∓ −∀∎∗∍ ∂∈∐∍∏∓∈ ∑−∓∋∈∖∗∂∓ ∏−∍∆ ∍ ∂∍∇∈∓∙∍∐∣∑∓∂, ∔∓∖∂∨∞∈−−∠√ ∑∀∆∍∍, ∖∍∐∈ ∑∠∖∐∍, ∖∐∓∂∀ ∍ ∌∀∏∓−∘ ∂∖∈∑∍∕−∓∆∓ ∔∕∍∗∨∋∈−∍∨. ∂ ∥∗∍√ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∀√ ∂∀∑ ∕∀∖∖∏∀∌∠∂∀∈∗∖∨ ∓ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓ ∂∀∝∍ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∍ −∀∑∈∕∈−∍∨ ∓∃∐∀∇∀∧∗ ∓∆∕∓∑−∓∎ ∖∍∐∓∎ ∗∂∓∕∍∗∣ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣ ∍ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∍∌∓∂∠∂∀∗∣ ∐∧∃∠∈ ∂∀∝∍ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨.




∍ ∥∗∓ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓ ∗∀∏!


∓∇−∀∏∓ ∓∔∠∗ ∔∓∏∀∌∠∂∀∈∗, ∜∗∓ ∑−∓∆∍∈ ∐∧∇∍ ∔∠∗∀∧∞∍∈∖∨ ∔∕∍∑∈−∍∗∣ ∥∗∍ ∌−∀−∍∨ ∍ ∑∈∗∓∇∠ ∂ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∎ ∋∍∌−∍ ∖∗∀∐∏∍∂∀∧∗∖∨ ∖ ∗∈∑, ∜∗∓ ∘ −∍√ −∈ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∈∗∖∨ ∃∠∖∗∕∓ ∇∓∖∗∍∜∣ ∔∓∖∗∀∂∐∈−−∓∎ ∛∈∐∍.

∋∈∐∀−∍∨, −∈ ∖∑∓∗∕∨ −∀ ∏∓∐∓∖∖∀∐∣−∠∈ ∘∖∍∐∍∨, ∃∓∐∣∝∍∈ ∗∈∓∕∈∗∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∔∓∌−∀−∍∨, ∑−∓∆∓∜∀∖∓∂∠∈ ∂∍∌∘∀∐∍∌∀∛∍∍ ∍ ∔∓∂∗∓∕∈−∍∈ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∙∓∕∑∘∐, −∈ ∍∖∔∓∐−∨∧∗∖∨. ∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∐∧∇∍, −∈ ∌−∀∧∞∍∈ ∆∐∀∂−∓∎ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∗∀∎−∠, ∕∀∌∓∜∀∕∓∂∠∂∀∧∗∖∨ ∍ ∓∖∗∀∂∐∨∧∗ ∖∂∓∍ ∔∓∔∠∗∏∍ −∀∂∖∈∆∇∀.





6

∂ ∜∈∑ ∋∈ ∌∇∈∖∣ ∔∕∓∃∐∈∑∀?


∂∈∕∓∨∗−∓, ∖∏∕∠∗ ∖∀∑∠∎ ∂∀∋−∠∎ ∍ ∖∓∏∕∓∂∈−−∠∎ ∀∖∔∈∏∗ ∇∕∈∂−∈∎ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∗∀∎−∠. ∏∀∏ ∍∑∈−−∓ ∑∀∆∍ ∍∖∔∓∐−∨∧∗ ∂∓∐∧ ∖∂∓∧, ∎∓∆∍ ∗∂∓∕∨∗ ∜∘∇∈∖∀, ∀ ∐∧∇∍ ∍∌ ∗∕∘∞∓∃, ∌∀ ∖∗∓∐∣ ∏∓∕∓∗∏∍∎ ∖∕∓∏ ∇∓∖∗∍∆∀∧∗ ∓∆∕∓∑−∓∆∓ ∃∓∆∀∗∖∗∂∀ ∍ ∑∓∆∘∞∈∖∗∂∀.



‘∃∈∌ ∥∗∓∎ ∖∓∏∕∓∂∈−−∓∎ ∖∗∀∕∍−−∓∎ ∗∀∎−∠ −∍ ∓∇−∓ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∓∈ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∈, −∍ ∓∇−∓ ∌∀∏∐∍−∀−∍∈, −∍ ∓∇∍− ∕∍∗∘∀∐ ∍ −∍ ∓∇−∀ ∙∓∕∑∘∐∀ −∈ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∗ .



∑−∓∆∍∈ ∔∓∔∀∇∀∐∍ ∂ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∧, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∃∕∀∐∍ ∂ ∕∘∏∍ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∏−∍∆∍ ∍∐∍ ∏−∍∆∍ ∓ ∖∍∐∈ ∑∠∖∐∍, ∔∕∓∃∓∂∀∐∍ ∇∈∐∀∗∣ −∈∏∍∈ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∨ (∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∑∀−∍∔∘∐∨∛∍∍), −∈∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∇∀∋∈ ∌∀−∍∑∀∐∍∖∣ ∎∓∆∓∎ ∍∐∍ ∑∈∇∍∗∀∛∍∈∎, −∓ ∓∋∍∇∀∈∑∠∈ ∜∘∇∈∖−∠∈ ∕∈∌∘∐∣∗∀∗∠ ∍∐∍ ∔∕∈∖∐∓∂∘∗∓∈ ∔∕∓∖∂∈∗∐∈−∍∈, ∏ ∖∓∋∀∐∈−∍∧ ∗∀∏ ∍ −∈ ∃∠∐∍ ∇∓∖∗∍∆−∘∗∠.




∔∓∜∈∑∘ ∋∈ ∗∀∏ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗?


∂∈∕∓∨∗−∓, −∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∂∠∔∓∐−∈−∓ ∖∀∑∓∈ ∆∐∀∂−∓∈ ∘∖∐∓∂∍∈ ∐∧∃∓∆∓ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∓∔∠∗∀ ∍∐∍ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∨. ∂∈∇∣ ∍∑∈−−∓ ∃∐∀∆∓∇∀∕∨ ∈∑∘ ∍ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∨∗ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∈ «∜∘∇∈∖∀» ∍ ∖∂∈∕∝∈−∍∨ ∂ ∋∍∌−∍ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀, ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∘∧∞∈∆∓ ∖∗∓∐∣ ∗∓−∏∍∈ ∍ ∖∈∏∕∈∗−∠∈ −∀∘∏∍.



∜∈∑ ∂∈∐∍∏∀∨ ∛∈−−∓∖∗∣ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∕∘∏∓∂∓∇∖∗∂∀?


∥∗∓∑ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∜∈∖∏∓∑ ∕∘∏∓∂∓∇∖∗∂∈ ∂∀∑ ∇∀∈∗∖∨ ∆∐∀∂−∠∎ ∏∐∧∜ ∏ ∑∀∆∍∍, ∎∓∆∈, ∏ ∐∧∃∓∑∘ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∑∘ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∧, ∏ ∍∖∔∓∐−∈−∍∧ ∐∧∃∓∆∓ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨, ∏ ∕∈∀∐∍∌∀∛∍∍ ∂ ∐∧∃∓∎ ∖∙∈∕∈ ∂∀∝∈∎ ∋∍∌−∍.

«∂ −∀∜∀∐∈ ∑∓∈∆∓ ∔∘∗∍ ∨ ∖∓∃∕∀∐ ∃∍∃∐∍∓∗∈∏∘ ∍∌ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∍√ ∖∓∗∈− ∏−∍∆, ∔∓∖∈∗∍∐ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∇∈∖∨∗∏∓∂ ∖∈∑∍−∀∕∓∂ ∔∓ ∂∖∈∑∘ ∑∍∕∘, ∓∃∘∜∀∐∖∨ ∘ ∕∀∌−∠√ ∘∜∍∗∈∐∈∎ (∎∓∆∓∂, ∔∀∕∀∔∖∍√∓∐∓∆∓∂, ∍∌∂∈∖∗−∠√ ∥∏∖∗∕∀∖∈−∖∓∂, ∨∖−∓∂∍∇∨∞∍√, ∂∈∇∘∞∍√ ∃∍∌−∈∖∑∈−∓∂), −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∐∈∗ ∍∌∘∜∀∐ ∘−∍∏∀∐∣−∠∈ ∎∓∆∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∗∈√−∍∏∍, ∋∍∐ ∂ ∆∍∑∀∐∀∨√ ∂ ∇∕∈∂−∈∑ ∑∓−∀∖∗∠∕∈, ∓∔∕∓∃∓∂∀∐ ∖∓∗−∍ ∑∈∗∓∇∍∏ −∀ ∂∖∈ ∖∐∘∜∀∍ ∋∍∌−∍… −∓ ∖∔∘∖∗∨ ∆∓∇∠ ∨ ∖∂∈∐ ∍√ ∏ ∔∕∓∖∗∠∑ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∜∈∖∏∍∑ ∗∈√−∍∏∀∑, ∕∀∃∓∗∀∧∞∍∑ ∔∓∖∐∈∇∓∂∀∗∈∐∣−∓, ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∍ ∘−∍∂∈∕∖∀∐∣−∓. ∍∗∀∏, ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∣∗∈ ∖∈∃∈ ∓∆∕∓∑−∘∧ ∛∈−−∓∖∗∣ ∇∀−−∓∆∓ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∀!».


7

∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∘∨ ∥∗∓∗ ∏∐∧∜, ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∗∣ ∂∖∈, ∜∗∓ ∌∀√∓∗∍∗∈, ∃∈∌ ∏∀∏∍√-∐∍∃∓ ∔∕∓∃∐∈∑. ∂∠ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∈∗∈ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∈−−∘∧ ∔∕∓∆∕∀∑∑∘ ∔∕∓∛∂∈∗∀−∍∨ −∀ 12 ∑∈∖∨∛∈∂ ∍ ∑∓∞−∠∎ ∑∈∗∓∇ ∖∀∑∓∕∀∌∂∍∗∍∨.

−∈∓∇−∓∏∕∀∗−∓ ∨ ∃∠∐ ∖∂∍∇∈∗∈∐∈∑ ∗∓∆∓, ∏∀∏ ∐∧∇∍ ∔∓∖∐∈ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∓∆∓ ∔∕∓∜∗∈−∍∨ ∍ ∘∖∈∕∇−∠√ ∌∀−∨∗∍∎ ∔∓ ∇∀−−∓∑∘ ∑∈∗∓∇∘, ∓∃∕∈∗∀∐∍ ∂∖∈ ∜∗∓ ∓−∍ √∓∗∈∐∍ ∍ ∔∓∗∓∑ ∖∓ ∖∐∈∌∀∑∍ −∀ ∆∐∀∌∀√ ∃∐∀∆∓∇∀∕∍∐∍ ∑∈−∨. −∓ ∨ ∖∜∍∗∀∧, ∜∗∓ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ −∈ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∑∓∨ ∌∀∖∐∘∆∀. ∨ ∐∍∝∣ ∔∕∓∂∓∇−∍∏ ∏∓∖∑∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∌−∀−∍∎ ∍ ∑∓∍ ∕∘∏∍ ∔∓∕∓∎ ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∘∈∗ ∖∀∑∀ ∂∖∈∐∈−−∀∨, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∔∍∖∀∗∣ ∍ ∇∀∂∀∗∣ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∃∠∂∀∈∗ ∗∀∏ ∂∀∋−∓ ∇∐∨ ∗∈√, ∏∓∑∘ ∥∗∓ ∔∓∖∐∀−∍∈ ∔∓∖∂∨∞∈−∓...




∆∐∀∂−∓∈ ∔∓−∨∗∣ ∔∕∍−∛∍∔ ∕∀∃∓∗∠ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∑∈∗∓∇∀


∃∘∇∣∗∈ ∔∕∈∇∈∐∣−∓ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∠, ∍∌∘∜∍∗∈ ∇∀−−∓∈ ∕∘∏∓∂∓∇∖∗∂∓ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∕∀∌, ∇∓ ∈∆∓ ∔∓∐−∓∆∓ ∗∈∓∕∈∗∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∍ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∘∖∂∓∈−∍∨. ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∖∐∘∜∀∈ ∂∀∖ ∋∇∈∗ ∔∓∐−∠∎ ∘∖∔∈√, ∔∕∓∛∂∈∗∀−∍∈, ∍∖∔∓∐−∈−∍∈ ∋∈∐∀−∍∎ ∍ ∇∓∖∗∍∋∈−∍∈ ∂∠∖∝∍√ ∖∔∓∖∓∃−∓∖∗∈∎.



∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∂∖∈ ∓∜∈−∣ ∔∕∓∖∗∓


∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∓∇∍− ∑∀∐∈−∣∏∍∎ −∧∀−∖ - ∖∈∏∕∈∗ ∍∐∍ ∔∕∍∈∑, ∃∐∀∆∓∇∀∕∨ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∑∘ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∨∗ ∍ ∖∓∂∈∕∝∀∧∗∖∨ −∀∖∗∓∨∞∀∨ ‘∑∀∆∍∨ , ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∈ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∈ ∍∐∍ ∗∂∓∕∨∗∖∨ ‘∜∘∇∈∖∀ . ∥∗∓ ∗∀∎−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ - ∓∖∓∃∓∈ ∖∓∖∗∓∨−∍∈ ∑∈∇∍∗∀∗∍∂−∓∆∓ ∗∕∀−∖∀. ∖∀∑ ∑∈∗∓∇ ∔∕∈∇∈∐∣−∓ ∔∕∓∖∗, ∏∀∏ ∍ ∂∖∈ ∆∈−∍∀∐∣−∓∈. ∂∓∖∔∓∐∣∌∓∂∀∗∣∖∨ ∍∑ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∏∀∋∇∠∎, ∈∖∐∍ ∔∓∎∑∈∗ ∍ ∘∌−∀∈∗ ∗∀∎−∘. ∃∘∇∣∗∈ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∠ ∍ ∔∕∓∜∗∍∗∈ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∕∀∌, ∀ ∏∓∆∇∀ ∂∠ ∔∓∎∑∈∗∈ ∥∗∘ ∗∀∎−∘ ∌∀∑∕∍∗∈ ∍ ∔∓∃∐∀∆∓∇∀∕∍∗∈ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∘∧ ∂∖∈∐∈−−∘∧.




∖∏∓🌌∕∓ ∂∠ −∀∘∜∍∗∈∖∣ −∀∖∗∓∨∞∈∑∘ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∑∘ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∧


∖∂∓∍∑ ∗∈∕∔∈−∍∈∑ ∑∠ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∇∓∖∗∍∜∣ −∀∑−∓∆∓ ∃∓∐∣∝∈∆∓, ∜∈∑ ∆∕∘∃∓∎ ∖∍∐∓∎.





∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ ‘∑∀∆∍∨  ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍?

«∑∀∆∍∨ ∈∖∗∣ ∖∔∓∖∓∃−∓∖∗∣, ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∂∓∐∍ ∍ ∂−∘∗∕∈−−∍√ ∖∍∐ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∓∂∀∗∣ −∀ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∨, ∨∂∐∈−∍∨ ∍ ∔∕∈∇∑∈∗∠ ∂ ∓∏∕∘∋∀∧∞∈∎ −∀∖ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∍».



8

∗∕∍ ∌∀∃∐∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∓∗−∓∖∍∗∈∐∣−∓ ∔∕∍∕∓∇∠ ∑∀∆∍∍:


∑∀∆∍∨ - ∥∗∓ ∖∂∈∕√∟∈∖∗∈∖∗∂∈−−∓∈ ∜∘∇∓.

∑∀∆∍∨ ∍∑∈∈∗ ∇∈∐∓ ∖ −∈∏∍∑∍ ∕∍∗∘∀∐∀∑∍.

∑∀∆∍∨ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∗ ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∔∓∗∘∖∗∓∕∓−−∍√ ∖∍∐ ∍∐∍ ∗∈∑−∠√ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂.





−∀ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∇∈∐∈ ∂∖∈ ∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∓ −∈ ∗∀∏


∂∠ ∘∌−∀∈∗∈ ∍∖∗∍−−∠∈, ∂−∘∗∕∈−−∍∈ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∠ ‘∑∀∆∍∍ , ∔∕∍∜∈∑ ∖ −∀∘∜−∓∎ ∗∓∜∏∍ ∌∕∈−∍∨. ∑∀∆∍∨ −∈ ∜∘∇∓, ∀ −∀∘∜−∠∎ ∙∀∏∗, ∐∈∆∏∓ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∨∈∑∠∎ −∀ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∈. ∑∀∆∍∨ ∌∀∏∐∧∜∈−∀ ∂ ∔∕∍∕∓∇∈ ∏∀∋∇∓∆∓ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀ ∍ ∏∀∋∇∠∎ ∈∎ ∔∓∐∣∌∘∈∗∖∨ ∔∓∖∗∓∨−−∓, −∈∌∀∂∍∖∍∑∓ ∓∗ ∗∓∆∓, ∌−∀∈∗ ∓− ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑ ∍∐∍ −∈∗. ∑∀∆∍∨ ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∘∈∗ ∐∍∝∣ ∂−∘∗∕∈−−∍∈ ∖∍∐∠ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀ ∍ ∂∓∂∖∈ −∈ ∨∂∐∨∈∗∖∨ ∜∘∇∓∑, ∏∀∏ ∔∕∈∇∔∓∐∀∆∀∐∓∖∣ ∕∀−∈∈.

∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∖∍∐∠ ∖∂∓∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ ∍ ∃∍∓∥−∈∕∆∍∍ ∗∂∓∕∍∗ ∖∓∃∖∗∂∈−−∘∧ ∖∘∇∣∃∘ ∍ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∘∈∗ −∀ ∓∏∕∘∋∀∧∞∘∧ ∈∆∓ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣, ∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∖∂∈∕√∟∈∖∗∈∖∗∂∈−−∠∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∀ ∍ ∔∓∗∘∖∗∓∕∓−−∍∈ ∖∍∐∠, ∌∇∈∖∣ −∈ ∔∕∍∜∈∑. ∗∀∏ ∔∓∜∈∑∘ ∋∈ ∂ ∇∕∈∂−∍√ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∑∀−∘∖∏∕∍∔∗∀√, ∗∀∏ ∑−∓∆∓ ∆∓∂∓∕∍∗∖∨ ∓ ∕∍∗∘∀∐∀√, ∖∍∐∈ ∔∕∍∌∕∀∏∓∂ ∍ ∜∘∇∈∖∀√?




∓∗∕∠∂∓∏ ∍∌ ∇∕∈∂−∈∆∓ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∑∀−∘∖∏∕∍∔∗∀


∔∕∍∑∈∕ ∖∗∀∕∍−−∓∆∓ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∕∍∗∘∀∐∀ – «∍∌∆−∀−∍∈ ∥∔∍∇∈∑∍∍ ∍∌ ∇∈∕∈∂−∍».

∔∓∇ ∥∔∍∇∈∑∍∈∎ ∔∓∇∕∀∌∘∑∈∂∀∧∗∖∨ ∕∀∌−∠∈ ∃∓∐∈∌−∍ ∐∧∇∈∎, −∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∍−∙∈∏∛∍∓−−∠∈, −∓ ∏∓∗∓∕∠∑∍ ∂ ∖∈∐∈ ∃∓∐∈∈∗ ∑−∓∆∓ ∐∧∇∈∎, ∍ ∓∗ ∏∓∗∓∕∠√ ∓−∍ −∍∏∀∏ −∈ ∑∓∆∘∗ ∍∌∐∈∜∍∗∣∖∨. ∗∀∏ ∋∈ ∥∔∍∇∈∑∍∈∎ ∖∜∍∗∀∧∗∖∨ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∈ ∃∓∐∈∌−∍ ∖∏∓∗∀, −∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∨∞∘∕, ∍ ∃∓∐∈∌−∍ ∕∀∖∗∈−∍∎, ∀ ∗∀∏ ∋∈ ∇∕∘∆∍∈ −∀∔∀∖∗∍, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∔∓∨∂∍∐∍∖∣ ∂ ∖∈∐∈.




∓∔∍∖∀−∍∈ ∕∍∗∘∀∐∀

 

∋∍∗∈∐∍ ∖∈∐∀ ∇∓∐∋−∠ ∖∏∍−∘∗∣∖∨ ∍ ∔∓∖∐∀∗∣ ∓∇−∓∆∓ ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∍∗∈∐∨ −∀ ∃∀∌∀∕ ∂ ∇∕∘∆∘∧ ∑∈∖∗−∓∖∗∣, ∔∓∇∀∐∣∝∈ ∓∗ ∖∈∐∀. ∥∗∓∗ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏, ∏∓∗∓∕∓∑∘ ∇∓∂∈∕∍∐∍ ∓∗∂∈∗∖∗∂∈−−∓∈ ∌∀∇∀−∍∈, ∂ ∖∘∃∃∓∗∘ −∀ ∘∃∠∂∀∧∞∈∎ ∐∘−∈, ∕∀−∓ ∘∗∕∓∑ ∇∓∐∋∈− ∔∓∎∗∍ −∀ ∃∀∌∀∕. −∀ ∃∀∌∀∕∈ ∖∐∈∇∘∈∗ ∏∘∔∍∗∣, ∔∈∕∂∓∆∓ ∔∓∔∀∂∝∈∆∓∖∨ ∓∖∐∀, −∈ ∗∓∕∆∘∨∖∣. ∈∖∐∍ ∓∖∗∀−∘∗∖∨ ∇∈−∣∆∍ ∔∓∖∐∈



9

∔∓∏∘∔∏∍, ∍√ −∀∇∓ ∓∗∇∀∗∣ ∏∀∏ ∑∍∐∓∖∗∠−∧ ∔∕∍ ∂∠√∓∇∈ ∖ ∃∀∌∀∕∀. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∓∖∐∀ ∔∕∍∂∈∇∘∗ ∂ ∇∈∕∈∂−∧, −∀∇∓ ∜∗∓∃∠ ∜∈∗∠∕∈ ∑∈∖∗−∠√ ∋∍∗∈∐∨ ∕∀∌−∠√ ∔∓∏∓∐∈−∍∎ ∍ ∔∓∐∓∂ ∔∓∑∓∜∍∐∍∖∣ ∂ ∓∇∍− ∖∓∖∘∇. ∑∓∜∘ ∂ ∖∓∖∘∇∈ ∕∀∌∑∈∝∀∗∣ ∍ ∂∠∐∍∗∣ −∀ ∓∖∐∀. ∇∈∐∀∗∣ ∥∗∓ −∀∇∓ −∀ ∛∈−∗∕∀∐∣−∓∎ ∔∐∓∞∀∇∍ ∖∈∐∀. ∌∀∗∈∑ ∇∕∘∆∍∈ ∋∍∗∈∐∍ ∖∈∐∀ ∇∓∐∋−∠ ∆−∀∗∣ ∓∖∐∀ ∏∀∏ ∑∓∋−∓ ∇∀∐∣∝∈ ∍∌ ∇∈∕∈∂−∍. ∍∌∆∓−∨∗∣ ∃∓∐∈∌−∣ ∍∌ ∖∈∐∀ −∀∇∓ ∇∕∘∆∓∎ ∇∓∕∓∆∓∎, −∈ ∗∓∎, ∏∓∗∓∕∓∎ ∔∕∍∂∈∐∍ ∓∖∐∀ ∂ ∖∈∐∓. ∔∕∍ ∂∠√∓∇∈ ∍∌ ∇∈∕∈∂−∍ −∀∇∓ ∆∓∂∓∕∍∗∣:

 

«∗∠, ∓ ∨∕∕∍, −∀∖∐∀∐ ∌∐∓ −∀ ∥∗∓ ∖∈∐∓,   −∓ ∔∘∖∗∣ ∥∗∓∗ ∓∖∈∐, ∌∀∃∈∕∈∗ ∥∗∓ ∌∐∓   ∍ ∔∈∕∈−∈∖∈∗ ∈∆∓ ∂ ∇∕∘∆∘∧ ∖∗∓∕∓−∘».  

 

∔∓∖∐∈ ∗∓∆∓, ∏∀∏ ∓∖∐∀ ∓∗∆∓−∨∗ ∔∓ ∇∓∕∓∆∈ ∔∓∇∀∐∣∝∈, ∋∍∗∈∐∍ ∇∓∐∋−∠ ∂∓∌∂∕∀∞∀∗∣∖∨ ∂ ∇∈∕∈∂−∧, −∓ −∈ ∔∕∨∑∓∎ ∇∓∕∓∆∓∎, ∀ ∓∏∕∘∋−∠∑ ∔∘∗∈∑.



∓∇−∀∏∓, ∈∖∐∍ ∂ ∗∓∜−∓∖∗∍ ∔∓∂∗∓∕∍∗∣ ∥∗∓∗ ∕∍∗∘∀∐ ∂ −∀∝∈ ∂∕∈∑∨, ∑∓∋∈∗ −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∣∖∨. −∓ ∔∓∜∈∑∘?



∇∐∨ ∜∈∆∓ ∂∠∇∘∑∠∂∀∐∍ ∗∀∏∍∈ ∖∐∓∋−∠∈ ∕∍∗∘∀∐∠?


∂∖∈ ∔∕∓∖∗∓. ∖∐∓∋−∠∈ ∍ ∌∀∔∘∗∀−−∠∈ ∕∍∗∘∀∐∠ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∧∗ ∂ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∈ ∓∔∕∈∇∈∐∈−−∠∈ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∠ ∔∓∇∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∓∎ ∖∍∐∠, ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∏∓∗∓∕∠√ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∘∈∗ −∀ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∧, ∜∈∕∈∌ ∥−∈∕∆∈∗∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∍ ∏∂∀−∗∓∂∠∈ ∂∌∀∍∑∓∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∨. ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑ ∌−∀∐∍ ∇∀👽∋∈ ∇∕∈∂−∍∈ ∍−∏∍ ∍ ∇∕∘∆∍∈ ∔∕∀-∛∍∂∍∐∍∌∀∛∍∍. ∥∗∓ ∌−∀−∍∈ ∔∈∕∈∇∀∂∀∐∓∖∣ ∍∌ ∔∓∏∓∐∈−∍∨ ∂ ∔∓∏∓∐∈−∍∈, ∍∌ ∘∖∗ ∂ ∘∖∗∀. ∓∗ ∘∜∍∗∈∐∨ ∏ ∘∜∈−∍∏∘.




−∈∂∈∕∓∨∗−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀ ∔∕∈∇∜∘∂∖∗∂∍∎


−∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∍∌∂∈∖∗−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀ ∔∕∈∇∜∘∂∖∗∂∍∎. ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∌∀∕∀−∈∈ ∜∘∂∖∗∂∓∂∀∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∖∏∓∕∓ ∜∗∓-∗∓ ∖∐∘∜∍∗∖∨. ∜∈∕∈∌ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∂∕∈∑∨ ∥∗∓ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓ ∖∐∘∜∀∈∗∖∨. ∍∐∍ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∇∘∑∀∈∗ ∓ ∜∈∑-∐∍∃∓, ∑∈∜∗∀∈∗, ∀ ∜∈∕∈∌ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∂∕∈∑∨ ∈∆∓ ∑∈∜∗∠ ∍∐∍ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∂ ∗∓∜−∓∖∗∍ ∖∃∠∂∀∧∗∖∨ ∂ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∣−∓∎ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍.

∥∗∓ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗ ∔∓∕∓∎ −∈∓∖∓∌−∀−−∓... ∓∇−∀∏∓, ∑∓∋−∓ −∀∘∜∍∗∣∖∨ ∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∓ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∗∣ ∥∗∍ ∔∕∍∕∓∇−∠∈ ‘∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍∈  ∍∐∍ ∆∓∂∓∕∨ ∖∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∠∑ ∨∌∠∏∓∑ ∃∈∖∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∠∈ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∠ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∂−∘∗∕∈−−∈∆∓ ∑∍∕∀.


10

∍∖∖∐∈∇∘∨ ∥∗∍ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∠ ∘∋∈ ∃∓∐∈∈ 15 ∐∈∗, ∨ ∔∕∍∝∈∐ ∏ ∂∠∂∓∇∀∑, ∐∈∆∏∓ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∨∈∑∠∑ −∀ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∈. ∥∗∍ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∠ ∘∋∈ ∌∀∐∓∋∈−∠ ∂ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∈ ∓∗ ∔∕∍∕∓∇∠ ∍ ∇∀∂−∓ −∈ ∖∜∍∗∀∧∗∖∨ ∜∘∇∓∑.

∓ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∀√ ∔∕∍∕∓∇−∓∎ ∑∀∆∍∍ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∕∀∖∖∏∀∌∀−∓ −∍∋∈. ∀ ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∘∌−∀∎∗∈ ∓ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓ ∔∕∍∌−∀∈∗∖∨, ∏∀∏ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∈−−∠∎ −∀∘∜−∠∎ ∙∀∏∗ ∍ −∈ ∔∓∇∐∈∋∍∗ ∖∓∑−∈−∍∧.



∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ ∔∕∍∌−∀−−∠∎ −∀∘∜−∠∎ ∙∀∏∗?

«−∀∘∜−∠∎ ∙∀∏∗ - ∥∗∓ ∗∀ ∍∖∗∍−∀, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨ ∃∠∐∀ −∈∓∇−∓∏∕∀∗−∓ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∈−∀ ∍ ∘∖∗∀−∓∂∐∈−∀ ∔∘∗∈∑ ∥∏∖∔∈∕∍∑∈−∗∀, ∑−∓∆∍∑∍ ∐∧∇∣∑∍».

∗∀ ∍∖∗∍−∀, ∓ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∎ ∂∠ ∘∌−∀∈∗∈ ∍∌ ∥∗∓∎ ∏−∍∆∍, ∃∠∐∀ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∈−∀ ∑−∓∧ ∐∍∜−∓ ∘∋∈, ∏∀∏ ∑∍−∍∑∘∑ 10000 ∕∀∌. ∃∓∐∈∈ ∗∓∆∓, ∓−∀ ∃∠∐∀ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∈−∀ ∑−∓∆∍∑∍ ∑∓∍∑∍ ∘∜∈−∍∏∀∑∍ ∍ ∔∕∓∍∌∂∈∐∀ ∓∋∍∇∀∈∑∠∎ ∔∓∐∓∋∍∗∈∐∣−∠∎ ∥∙∙∈∏∗ −∀ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∎ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∈. ∔∕∓∃∐∈∑∠ ∕∀∌∕∈∝∀∧∗∖∨, ∋∈∐∀−∍∨ ∍∖∔∓∐−∨∧∗∖∨. ∖∜∍∗∀∧ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∇∓∖∗∀∗∓∜−∓, ∜∗∓∃∠ −∈ ∖∜∍∗∀∗∣ ∥∗∓ ∔∕∓∖∗∠∑ ∖∓∂∔∀∇∈−∍∈∑ ∍ ∔∕∍∌−∀∗∣ ∂∔∓∐−∈ −∀∘∜−∠∑ ∙∀∏∗∓∑.

∐∧∇∍ ∕∀∌−∠√ ∂∓∌∕∀∖∗∓∂ ∍ ∔∕∓∙∈∖∖∍∎, ∍∌ ∜∍∖∐∀ ∑∓∍√ ∃∐∍∌∏∍√ ∘∜∈−∍∏∓∂ ∘∋∈ ∓∔∕∓∃∓∂∀∐∍ ∥∗∘ ∗∀∎−∘∧ ∖∍∐∘ −∀ ∐∍∜−∓∑ ∓∔∠∗∈ ∍ ∃∠∐∍ ∂∓∖√∍∞∈−∠ ∈∈ ∑∓∞−∠∑ ∍ ∃∠∖∗∕∠∑ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∈∑. ∍∑∈−−∓ ∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∃∠∐∓ ∔∕∍−∨∗∓ ∕∈∝∈−∍∈ ∔∓∇∈∐∍∗∣∖∨ ∥∗∍∑ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∜∈∖∏∍∑ ∓∔∠∗∓∑ ∍ ∖ ∂∀∑∍.

−∀ ∓∖−∓∂∀−∍∍ ∥∗∓∆∓, ∑∓∋−∓ ∖ ∘∂∈∕∈−−∓∖∗∣ −∀∌∂∀∗∣ ∇∀−−∘∧ ∑∈∗∓∇∍∏∘ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∈−−∠∑ −∀∘∜−∠∑ ∙∀∏∗∓∑. −∓ ∔∓∏∀ ∥∗∓ −∈ ∕∈∀∐∍∌∓∂∀−∓ ∂ ∂∀∝∈∎ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∎ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∋∍∌−∍, ∇∐∨ ∂∀∖ ∥∗∓ ∓∖∗∀−∈∗∖∨ ∐∍∝∣ ∖∐∓∂∀∑∍ ∍ ∆∓∐∓∎ ∗∈∓∕∍∈∎. ∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∐∘∜∝∈ ∔∓∔∕∓∃∓∂∀∗∣ ∑∈∗∓∇ −∀ ∖∂∓∈∑ ∐∍∜−∓∑ ∓∔∠∗∈ ∍ ∖∇∈∐∀∗∣ ∖∂∓∍ ∖∓∃∖∗∂∈−−∠∈ ∂∠∂∓∇∠, ∔∓∐∘∜∍∂ ∂ ∖∂∓∈ ∔∓∖∗∓∨−−∓∈ ∕∀∖∔∓∕∨∋∈−∍∈ ∖∔∓∖∓∃, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∇∀∖∗ ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓∖∗∣ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∣ ∂∖∈ ∋∈∐∀∈∑∓∈ ∂∖∈∆∇∀ ∍ ∂∈∌∇∈ ∍∌ −∈∓∆∕∀−∍∜∈−−∠√ ∍ −∈∓∋∍∇∀−−∠√ ∍∖∗∓∜−∍∏∓∂ ∂∖∈∐∈−−∓∎.

∔∓ ∖∈∏∕∈∗∘, ∍∌ ∐∍∜−∓∆∓ ∓∔∠∗∀

«−∀∝∀ ∖∍∐∀ ∂ ∖∐∓∂∀√ ∍ ∇∈∐∀√ — ∂∖∈∆∓ ∐∍∝∣ ∥√∓ −∀∕∀∖∗∀∧∞∈∎ ∖∍∐∠ ∑∠∖∐∍».

∂ ∏∘∕∖∈ «∗∀∎−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀» ∂∀∑ ∓∗∏∕∓∈∗∖∨ ∖∓∏∕∓∂∈−−∀∨ ∗∀∎−∀. ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∥∗∓∎ ∗∀∎−∠ ∐∧∇∍ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∧∗ ∆∕∀−∇∍∓∌−∠ ∘∖∔∈√. ∥∗∀ ∗∀∎−∀∨ ∗∈√−∓∐∓∆∍∨ ∍∖∔∓∐−∨∈∗ ∐∧∃∠∈ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨ ∍ ∑∈∜∗∠. ∇∐∨ ∗∓∆∓, ∏∗∓ ∔∓∌−∀∐ ∗∀∎−∘∧ ∖∍∐∘, −∈∗ −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓∆∓!

∂∔🌀∈∕∂∠∈ ∌−∀−∍∈ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∎ ∑∈∗∓∇∍∏∈ ∔∕∍∝∐∓ ∑−∈ ∓∏∓∐∓ 10 ∐∈∗ −∀∌∀∇. ∥∗∘ ∗∀∎−∘ ∕∀∖∏∕∠∐∍ ∑−∈ ∂ ∆∍∑∀∐∀∨√ ∍−∇∍∎∖∏∍∈ ∕∀∇∋∀ - ∎∓∆∍. ∑∈−∨ ∓∃∘∜∍∐∍ ∘∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∧ ∖∍∐∓∎ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ (∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∍∑ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∈∑) ∍ ∂−∘∗∕∈−−∈∑∘ ∔∈∕∈∔∕∓∆∕∀∑∑∍∕∓∂∀−∍∧ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∍. ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∓∖−∓∂−∀∨ ∖∘∗∣ ∇∀−−∓∎ ∗∈√−∓∐∓∆∍∍. ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∥∗∓∎ ∖∍∐∠ ∎∓∆∍ ∗∂∓∕∨∗ ∜∘∇∈∖∀, ∑∀∆∍ ∇∈∐∀∧∗ −∈∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓∈, ∀ ∔∕∈∘∖∔∈∂∀∧∞∍∈ ∔∕∈∇∔∕∍−∍∑∀∗∈∐∍ ∇∓∖∗∍∆∀∧∗ ∂∈∕∝∍− ∃∓∆∀∗∖∗∂∀.




∥∗∓ ∔∓∗∕∨∖∀∧∞∀∨ ∍ ∑∓∞−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀!


∏∓∆∇∀ ∨ ∂∔∈∕∂∠∈ ∘∌−∀∐ ∥∗∘ ∗∀∎−∘, ∨ ∃∠∐ ∂ ∝∓∏∈ ∓∗ ∈∈ ∔∕∓∖∗∓∗∠. ∂∈∕−∘∂∝∍∖∣ ∍∌ ∍−∇∍∍ ∂ ∕∓∖∖∍∧, ∨ ∖∕∀∌∘ ∋∈ ∕∈∝∍∐ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∍∗∣ ∂∖∈, ∓ ∜∈∑ ∕∀∖∖∏∀∌∀∐ ∑−∈ ∑∀∖∗∈∕. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∨ ∓∔∕∓∃∓∂∀∐ ∈∈, ∃∠∐ ∔∓∕∀∋∈− ∗∈∑, ∜∗∓ ∂∖∈ ∑∓∍ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨ −∀∜∀∐∍ ∍∖∔∓∐−∨∗∣∖∨ ∓∜∈−∣ ∃∠∖∗∕∓ ∍ ∐∈∆∏∓. ∖∕∀∌∘ ∌∀√∓∗∈∐∓∖∣ ∔∕∓∂∈∕∍∗∣ ∈∈ −∀ ∜∈∑-∗∓ ∔∓∏∀∌∀∗∈∐∣−∓∑ ∍ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∑. ∃∠∐∓ ∔∕∍−∨∗∓ ∕∈∝∈−∍∈ ∔∕∓∂∈∖∗∍ ∓∔∠∗ ∖ ∌∓∐∓∗∠∑ ∏∓∐∣∛∓∑.




∑∓∎ ∓∔∠∗ ∖ ∌∓∐∓∗∠∑ ∏∓∐∣∛∓∑ ∘∇∀∐∖∨


∨ ∔∓∔∕∓∃∓∂∀∐ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∍∌∓∂∀∗∣ ∍∐∍ ∔∕∍∗∨−∘∗∣ −∈∃∓∐∣∝∓∈ ∌∓∐∓∗∓∈ ∏∓∐∣∛∓ ∖ ∃∕∍∐∐∍∀−∗∓∑. ∨ ∔∕∓∇∈∐∀∐ ∂∖∈ ∗∀∏, ∏∀∏ ∖∏∀∌∀∐ ∑−∈ ∑∀∖∗∈∕. ∏ ∑∓∈∑∘ ∂∈∐∍∏∓∑∘ ∘∇∍∂∐∈−∍∧ ∕∈∌∘∐∣∗∀∗ ∃∠∐ ∘∋∈ −∀ ∖∐∈∇∘∧∞∈∈ ∘∗∕∓, ∔∕∍∜∈∑ ∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∓ −∈∓∋∍∇∀−−∓ ∇∐∨ ∑∈−∨, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∨ ∃∠∐ ∂∠−∘∋∇∈− ∂∠∎∗∍ −∀ ∘∐∍∛∘ ∍ ∖∗∓∨∗∣ −∀ ∓∖∗∀−∓∂∏∈ ∂ ∓∋∍∇∀−∍∍ ∗∕∀−∖∔∓∕∗∀. ∇∈∐∀∗∣ ∃∠∐∓ −∈∜∈∆∓, ∨ ∔∈∕∈∃∍∕∀∐ ∘∐∍∜−∠∎ ∔∈∖∓∏ −∓∆∓∎, ∂∇∕∘∆, ∜∗∓-∗∓ ∔∓∇ −∓∆∀∑∍ ∌∀∃∐∈∖∗∈∐∓. ∨ −∀∏∐∓−∍∐∖∨, ∔∕∓∗∨−∘∐ ∕∘∏∘ ∍ ∂∠∗∀∞∍∐ ∍∌ ∔∈∖∏∀ ∌∓∐∓∗∓∈ ∏∓∐∣∛∓ ∖ ∃∕∍∐∐∍∀−∗∓∑. ∑−∈ −∈ ∂∈∕∍∐∓∖∣, ∨ ∇∘∑∀∐ ∥∗∓ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∘∇∀∜−∓∈ ∖∓∂∔∀∇∈−∍∈.




∨ ∕∈∝∍∐ ∔∈∕∈∔∕∓∂∈∕∍∗∣ ∂∖∈ ∖−∓∂∀



12

∨ ∖−∓∂∀ −∀∜∀∐ ∏∓−∛∈−∗∕∍∕∓∂∀∗∣∖∨ −∀ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓ ∨ −∀√∓∋∘ ∌∓∐∓∗∓. ∘∋∈ ∜∈∕∈∌ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∇−∈∎ ∑∈−∨ ∔∕∍∆∐∀∖∍∐∍ −∀ ∖∈∑∍−∀∕ ∓∇−∓∆∓ ∍−∇∍∎∖∏∓∆∓ ∑∀∖∗∈∕∀, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∂ ∥∗∓ ∂∕∈∑∨ ∔∕∍∈√∀∐ ∂ −∀∝ ∆∓∕∓∇. ∔∓∖∐∈ ∐∈∏∛∍∍, ∂∇∕∘∆ ∔∕∨∑∓ ∔∓∇ ∖∍∇∈−∣∈∑ ∨ ∘∂∍∇∈∐ ∇∓∐∆∓∋∇∀−−∠∎ ∃∐∈∖∏ ∌∓∐∓∗∀! ∥∗∓ ∃∠∐∀ ∌∓∐∓∗∀∨ ∛∈∔∓∜∏∀, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨ ∓∇∈∂∀∐∀∖∣ −∀ ∌∀∔∨∖∗∣∈.




∇∀∐∣∝∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∈∞∈ ∍−∗∈∕∈∖−∈∈...


∔∓∖∐∈ ∇∂∘√ ∐∈∗ ∋∍∌−∍ ∂ ∈∂∕∓∔∈ ∨ ∂∈∕−∘∐∖∨ ∂ ∕∓∖∖∍∧. ∘ ∑∈−∨ ∘∋∈ ∃∠∐ ∖∂∓∎ ∖∀∎∗. ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∂∠ ∂∍∇∍∗∈ «∥−∛∍∏∐∓∔∈∇∍∧ ∗∀∎−∠√ ∑∈∗∓∇∍∏», −∓ ∕∀−∣∝∈ ∥∗∓ −∀∌∠∂∀∐∓∖∣ «∝∏∓∐∀ ∖∂∈∕√∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀». ∝∏∓∐∀ ∗∓∆∇∀ −∀√∓∇∍∐∀∖∣ −∀ ∖∀∑∓∎ −∀∜∀∐∣−∓∎ ∖∗∀∇∍∍ ∕∀∌∂∍∗∍∨, ∃∠∐∓ −∀∔∍∖∀−∓ ∂∖∈∆∓ 25 ∖∗∀∗∈∎. ∇∈−∣∆∍, ∌∀∕∀∃∓∗∀−−∠∈ ∂ ∈∂∕∓∔∈, ∌∀∏∓−∜∍∐∍∖∣, −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∓∖∗∀∂∀∐∓∖∣, ∏∀∏ ∖−∓∂∀ ∔∕∍∑∈−∍∗∣ ∗∀∎−∘∧ ∖∍∐∘ ∖∂∓∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ ∍ ∕∈∌∈∕∂−∠∈ ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓∖∗∍ ∔∖∍√∍∏∍.

∃∠∐ −∈∓∃√∓∇∍∑ −∓∂∠∎ −∓∘∗∃∘∏ ∇∐∨ ∕∀∃∓∗∠ ∂ ∍−∗∈∕−∈∗∈ ∍ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∏∓∐∍∜∈∖∗∂∓ ∇∈−∈∆ −∀ ∋∍∌−∣. ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∨ ∏∀∌∀∐∀∖∣ ∏∕∀∎−∈ ∖∐∓∋−∓∎. ∨ ∂∓∝∈∐ ∂ ∑∈∇∍∗∀∗∍∂−∠∎ ∗∕∀−∖ ∍ ∔∕∍∑∈−∍∐ ∗∀∎−∠∎ ∑∈∗∓∇ ∍−∇∍∎∖∏∍√ ∕∀∇∋∀ - ∎∓∆∓∂, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∏∓∆∇∀-∗∓ ∘∌−∀∐. ∘∋∈ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∔∀∕∘ ∇−∈∎ ∨ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∐ ∔∍∖∣∑∓, ∆∇∈ ∓∇−∀ ∋∈−∞∍−∀ ∔∍∖∀∐∀ ∓ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓ ∖∐∘∜∀∎−∓ −∀∝∐∀ ∑∓∎ ∖∀∎∗ ∍ √∓∗∈∐∀ ∃∠ −∀∘∜∍∗∣∖∨ ∘ ∑∈−∨ ∂∖∈∑∘ ∗∓∑∘, ∓ ∜∈∑ ∂ −∈∑ −∀∔∍∖∀−∓.




∗∓∆∇∀ ∨ ∈∞∈ −∈ ∇∘∑∀∐ ∓ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∓∃∘∜∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∍−∗∈∕−∈∗


∥∗∀ ∋∈−∞∍−∀ ∔∕∓∖∍∐∀ ∑∈−∨ ∓∃∘∜∀∗∣ ∈∈ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∖∏∀∎∔ - ∍−∇∍∂∍∇∘∀∐∣−∓. ∨ −∈ ∖∗∀∐ −∀∌∠∂∀∗∣ ∈∎ ∛∈−∠ ∍ ∖∏∀∌∀∐, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∓−∀ ∖∀∑∀ ∕∈∝∍∐∀, ∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∑−∈ ∌∀∔∐∀∗∍∗∣ ∌∀ ∍−∇∍∂∍∇∘∀∐∣−∓∈ ∓∃∘∜∈−∍∈. −∀ ∖∐∈∇∘∧∞∍∎ ∇∈−∣ ∓−∀ ∔∈∕∈∂∈∐∀ 2000 $.



∏∐∀∖∖−∀∨ −∓∂∓∖∗∣

−∀ ∖∐∈∇∘∧∞∍∎ ∇∈−∣ ∇∈−∣∆∍ ∃∠∐∍ ∔∓∐∘∜∈−∠. ∨ ∌∀∏∘∔∍∐ −∓∂∓∈ ∓∃∓∕∘∇∓∂∀−∍∈ ∍ −∀∜∀∐∀∖∣ ∕∀∃∓∗∀ −∀∇ ∕∀∖∝∍∕∈−∍∈∑ ∑∓∈∎ ∓−∐∀∎− ∝∏∓∐∠. ∗∀∏ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∗ ∥∗∓∗ ∑∈∗∓∇! ∃∠∖∗∕∓, ∥∙∙∈∏∗∍∂−∓ ∍ ∔∕∈∇∈∐∣−∓ ∔∕∓∖∗∓!



∍∌ ∓∔∠∗∀ ∑∓∍√ ∘∜∈−∍∏∓∂




13

∓∇−∀∋∇∠ ∏∓ ∑−∈ ∓∃∕∀∗∍∐∀∖∣ ∋∈−∞∍−∀, ∌∂∀∐∍ ∈∈ ∓∏∖∀−∀. ∓−∀ ∕∀∖∖∏∀∌∀∐∀ ∓ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓ ∈∈ ∐∧∃∍∑∠∎ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ −∈∓∋∍∇∀−−∓ ∍∌∑∈−∍∐∖∨ ∍ −∓∜∣∧, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∓−∀ ∖∔∀∐∀, ∖∓∃∕∀∐ ∂∈∞∍ ∍ ∘∝∈∐. ∓∏∖∀−∀ ∃∠∐∀ ∔∓∗∕∨∖∈−∀ ∍ ∔∓∆∕∘∌∍∐∀∖∣ ∂ ∌∀∗∨∋−∘∧ ∇∈∔∕∈∖∖∍∧.

∜∈∕∈∌ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∇−∈∎ ∓−∀ ∘∌−∀∐∀, ∜∗∓ ∀−∇∕∈∎ ∘∝∈∐ ∏ ∇∕∘∆∓∎ ∋∈−∞∍−∈. ∔∓∖∐∈ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∓∏∖∀−∀ ∔∓∌∂∓−∍∐∀ ∑−∈ ∍ −∀∌−∀∜∍∐∀ ∐∍∜−∘∧ ∂∖∗∕∈∜∘. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∑∠ ∂∖∗∕∈∗∍∐∍∖∣ −∀ −∈∎ «−∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∐∍∛∀», ∈∈ ∆∐∀∌∀ ∃∠∐∍ ∌∀∔∐∀∏∀−∠, ∀ ∐∍∛∓ ∓∔∘√∐∓ ∓∗ ∖∐∈∌.

−∀ ∂∖∗∕∈∜∈ ∓−∀ ∔∕∓∗∨−∘∐∀ ∑−∈ 10 000 ∕∘∃∐∈∎ ∍ ∖∏∀∌∀∐∀: «∇∈∐∀∎ ∜∗∓ √∓∜∈∝∣ ∀∐∈∏∖∀−∇∕, −∓ ∀−∇∕∈∎ ∇∓∐∋∈− ∏∓ ∑−∈ ∂∈∕−∘∗∣∖∨ ∍−∀∜∈ ∨ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∘∑∕∘ ∃∈∌ −∈∆∓.

∨ ∖∏∀∌∀∐, ∜∗∓ −∈ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∧ ∖ ∏∀∕∑∓∎ ∇∕∘∆∍√ ∐∧∇∈∎ ∍ −∈ ∓∏∀∌∠∂∀∧ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∘∖∐∘∆ ∂∕∓∇∈ ∔∕∍∂∓∕∓∗∓∂, ∗∀∏∋∈ −∈ ∇∈∐∀∧ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∍∎ ∂∓∌∂∕∀∗ ∂ ∖∈∑∣∧, ∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∇∈−∣∆∍ ∓∗ −∈∈ −∈ ∔∕∍∑∘. −∓ ∘ ∑∈−∨ ∈∖∗∣ ∇∕∘∆∓∎ ∂∀∕∍∀−∗ ∕∀∃∓∗∠. ∨ −∀∘∜∘ ∂∀∖ ∖∈∏∕∈∗−∓∑∘ ∑∈∗∓∇∘ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∨, ∍ ∂∠ ∖∀∑∍ ∃∘∇∈∗∈ ∏∓∕∕∈∏∗∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∖∂∓∧ ∖∘∇∣∃∘ ∔∕∍ ∐∧∃∓∎ ∑∀∐∈∎∝∈∎ −∈∓∃√∓∇∍∑∓∖∗∍. ∃∠∐ ∌∀∏∐∧∜∈− ∇∓∆∓∂∓∕ −∀ ∍−∇∍∂∍∇∘∀∐∣−∓∈ ∓∃∘∜∈−∍∈. ∓∃∘∜∈−∍∈ ∔∕∓∇∓∐∋∀∐∓∖∣ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∗∕∍ ∇−∨. ∔∓∖∐∈ ∜∈∆∓ ∓−∀ ∔∕∍∖∗∘∔∍∐∀ ∏ ∕∀∃∓∗∈ −∀∇ ∥∗∍∑ ∘∇∍∂∍∗∈∐∣−∠∑ ∑∈∗∓∇∓∑.




∜∈∑ ∂∖∈ ∌∀∏∓−∜∍∐∓∖∣?


∔∓∖∐∈ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∖∐∘∜∀∨ ∔∕∓∝∐∓ ∇∓∂∓∐∣−∓ ∑−∓∆∓ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍. ∨ ∌∀∃∠∐ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∎ ∍∖∗∓∕∍∍, ∌∀−∍∑∀∨∖∣ ∖∂∓∍∑∍ ∇∈∐∀∑∍, ∓∏∖∀−∀ ∃∓∐∣∝∈ −∈ ∌∂∓−∍∐∀. ∜∈∕∈∌ ∆∓∇, ∨ ∖∐∘∜∀∎−∓ ∂∖∗∕∈∗∍∐ ∓∏∖∀−∘ −∀ ∕∠−∏∈.

- ∇∓∃∕∠∎ ∇∈−∣ ∓∏∖∀−∀, ∏∀∏ ∇∈∐∀, ∜∗∓ ∖ ∂∀∝∍∑∍ ∓∗−∓∝∈−∍∨∑∍ ∖ ∀−∇∕∈∈∑, ∏∀∏ ∂∀∑ ∑∈∗∓∇? ∖∔∕∓∖∍∐ ∨.

∓−∀ ∓∗∂∈∗∍∐∀, ∜∗∓ ∘∋∈ ∜∈∕∈∌ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∇−∈∎ ∔∓∖∐∈ ∓∃🌌∘∜∈−∍∨ ∍ ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∍ ∑∈∗∓∇∀, ∀−∇∕∈∎ ∂∈∕−∘∐∖∨ ∏ −∈∎ ∖ ∔∕∍∌−∀−∍∨∑∍ ∂ ∆∓∕∨∜∈∎ ∐∧∃∂∍. ∓−∀ ∔∕∈∇∐∓∋∍∐∀ ∔∓∎∗∍ ∏ −∈∎ ∂ ∆∓∖∗∍ ∍ ∔∓∌−∀∏∓∑∍∗∣∖∨ ∖ ∀−∇∕∈∈∑. ∑∠ ∂∖∗∕∈∗∍∐∍∖∣ ∍ ∑∍∐∓ ∔∓∓∃∞∀∐∍∖∣ ∌∀ ∜∀∝∈∜∏∓∎ ∆∓∕∨∜∈∆∓ ∏∍∗∀∎∖∏∓∆∓ ∜∀∨. ∌∀∗∈∑ ∂ ∌−∀∏ ∃∐∀∆∓∇∀∕−∓∖∗∍ ∓−∀ ∔∈∕∈∇∀∐∀ ∑−∈ 25000 ∕∘∃∐∈∎.

∕∀∌∇∈∐ 3


∓ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∖∍∐∈ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨


∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∓∔∕∈∇∈∐∨∈∗ −∀∝ ∔∘∗∣, −∀∌∠∂∀∈∗∖∨ ∐∍∜−∓∎ ∖∍∐∓∎. ∐∍∜−∓∖∗∣ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀ - ∥∗∓ ∖∘∑∑∀∕−∠∎ ∓∃∟∉∑ ∈∆∓ ∐∍∜−∓∎ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∖∍∐∠. ∍ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∥∗∍∑ ∖∘∑∑∀∕−∠∑ ∓∃∟∉∑∓∑ ∓∔∕∈∇∈∐∨∈∗∖∨ ∗∓, ∏∀∏ ∓− ∋∍∂∉∗ ∍ ∏∀∏ ∘∑∍∕∀∈∗.

∗∀∎−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ ∓∜∈−∣ ∑∓∆∘∞∈∖∗∂∈−−∀ ∍ ∖∔∓∖∓∃−∀ ∍∌∑∈−∍∗∣ ∋∍∌−∣. ∥∗∓ ∌−∀−∍∈ - ∃∈∖∛∈−−∠∎ ∏∐∧∜, ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∆∓ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∂∐∍∨∗∣ −∀ ∐∧∃∠∈ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍, ∍∌∑∈−∨∗∣ ∓∗−∓∝∈−∍∈ ∏ ∂∀∑ ∇∕∘∆∍√ ∐∧∇∈∎, ∂∠∌∠∂∀∨ ∂ −∍√ ∐∧∃∓∂∣, ∘∂∀∋∈−∍∈ ∍ ∖∍∑∔∀∗∍∧.

∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∥∗∓∎ ∖∍∐∠ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∗∣ ∌∓∐∓∗∠∈ ∘∏∕∀∝∈−∍∨ ∍ ∏∕∘∔−∠∈ ∖∘∑∑∠ ∇∈−∈∆. ∥∗∀ ∖∍∐∀ −∈ ∓∆∕∀−∍∜∈−∀ ∔∓ ∂∈∐∍∜∍−∈ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨. ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∣: ∃∓∆∀∗∖∗∂∓, ∇∓∑, ∏∂∀∕∗∍∕∘, ∑∀∝∍−∘, ∔∓∂∠∝∈−∍∈ ∔∓ ∖∐∘∋∃∈, ∐∧∃∓∂∣ ∍ ∂∌∀∍∑∓∔∓−∍∑∀−∍∈.

∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∑∈∗∓∇∀ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∍∖∛∈∐∨∗∣ ∃∓∐∣−∠∈ ∓∕∆∀−∠ ∍ ∇∓∖∗∍∆∀∗∣ ∃∐∀∆∓∔∓∐∘∜∍∨ ∂ ∐∧∃∠√ ∖∙∈∕∀√ ∋∍∌−∍. ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∓∗∏∕∠∗∣ ∏∕∘∔−∘∧ ∏∓∕∔∓∕∀∛∍∧ ∍ ∖∗∀∗∣ ∂∐∀∇∈∐∣∛∈∑ ∔∕∍∃∠∐∣−∓∎ ∏∓∑∔∀−∍∍.

∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∓∐∘∜∍∗∣ ∐∧∃∓∈ ∋∈∐∀∈∑∓∈ ∔∓∐∓∋∈−∍∈ ∂ ∓∃∞∈∖∗∂∈, −∈∌∀∂∍∖∍∑∓∖∗∣ ∍ ∖∂∓∃∓∇∘. ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∘∗∈∝∈∖∗∂∓∂∀∗∣, −∀∖∐∀∋∇∀∨∖∣ ∔∕∈∏∕∀∖−∠∑∍ ∑∈∖∗∀∑∍ ∔∐∀−∈∗∠. ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∑∈∗∓∇∀ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∍∌∓∂∀∗∣ ∐∧∃∓∈ ∋∈∐∀−∍∈ ∍∐∍ −∀∑∈∕∈−∍∈ ∃∠∖∗∕∓, ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∍ ∥∙∙∈∏∗∍∂−∓.




∗∕∍ ∖∓∖∗∀∂∐∨∧∞∍√ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∖∍∐∠:


∕∀∖∖∑∓∗∕∍∑ ∖∐∀∆∀∧∞∍∈ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∖∍∐∠ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨:

φ  ∖∍∐∀ ∑∠∖∐∍.

φ  ∖∍∐∀ ∥∑∓∛∍∎.

φ  ∖∍∐∀ ∘∇∈∕∋∀−∍∨.















15

∕∀∌∇∈∐ 4


∏∀∏ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∗ ∑∈∗∓∇?


∇∐∨ ∗∓∆∓, ∜∗∓∃∠ −∀∘∜∍∗∣∖∨ ∔∓∐∣∌∓∂∀∗∣∖∨ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∖∍∐∓∎ ∖∂∓∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨, ∖∓∖∗∓∨∞∈∎ ∍∌ ∗∕∈√ ∏∓∑∔∓−∈−∗∓∂, −∈∓∃√∓∇∍∑∓ ∔∓−∨∗∣ ∔∕∍−∛∍∔ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∨ ∇∀−−∓∎ ∗∈√−∓∐∓∆∍∍.



∂∌∆∐∨∇ ∖ −∀∘∜−∓∎ ∗∓∜∏∍ ∌∕∈−∍∨


∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∓ ∜∍∗∀∎∗∈, ∖∗∀∕∀∎∗∈∖∣ ∔∓−∨∗∣, ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓ ∂−∍∏−∘∗∣ ∂ ∖∘∗∣ ∖∈∆∓ ∘∜∈−∍∨!

∖ ☄️∖∀∑∓∆∓ ∕∓∋∇∈−∍∨ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∘ ∂−∘∝∀∈∗∖∨ ∑∠∖∐∣, ∜∗∓ ∑∍∕, ∂ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∑ ∓− ∋∍∂∈∗, ∨∂∐∨∈∗∖∨ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∓∎ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∣−∓∎ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣∧. ∖ ∖∀∑∓∆∓ ∇∈∗∖∗∂∀ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∖∗∕∓∍∗ ∖∂∓∧ ∋∍∌−∣ ∍∖√∓∇∨ ∍∑∈−−∓ ∍∌ ∥∗∍√ ∘∖∐∓∂∍∎. ∓∇−∀∏∓, −∓∂∈∎∝∍∈ ∍∖∖∐∈∇∓∂∀−∍∨ ∖∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∓∎ ∙∍∌∍∏∍ ∔∓∏∀∌∀∐∍, ∜∗∓ ∂∖∈ ∓∃∖∗∓∍∗ ∖∓∂∖∈∑ ∍−∀∜∈, ∜∈∑ ∑∠ ∔∕∍∂∠∏∐∍ ∇∘∑∀∗∣.

∂∖∧ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∧ ∓ ∂−∈∝−∈∑ ∑∍∕∈ ∑∠ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∈∑ ∔∓∖∕∈∇∖∗∂∓∑ ∔∨∗∍ ∓∖−∓∂−∠√ ∓∕∆∀−∓∂ ∜∘∂∖∗∂. ∓∏∕∘∋∀∧∞∍∎ −∀∖ ∑∍∕ ∍∌∂∈∖∗∈− −∀∑ ∐∍∝∣ ∂ ∗∓∎ ∖∗∈∔∈−∍, ∂ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∎ ∈∆∓ ∘∂∍∇∈∐∍ −∀∝∍ ∆∐∀∌∀, ∘∖∐∠∝∀∐∍ −∀∝∍ ∘∝∍. ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣ ∌∀∔∀√∓∂ - ∥∗∓ ∐∍∝∣ −∀∝∈ ∓∃∓−∨−∍∈. ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣ ∂∏∘∖∓∂ - ∥∗∓ ∐∍∝∣ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∓∞∘∗∍∐∍ ∨∌∠∏∓∑. ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∓∖∨∌∀−∍∨, ∐∍∝∣ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∔∓∜∘∂∖∗∂∓∂∀∐∍ ∕∘∏∀∑∍ ∍∐∍ ∏∓∋∈∎.

∖ ∖∀∑∓∆∓ ∕∓∋∇∈−∍∨ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∌∀∂∍∖∍∗ ∓∗ ∔∨∗∍ ∓∕∆∀−∓∂ ∜∘∂∖∗∂. ∓− ∔∓∌−∀∈∗ ∥∗∓∗ ∑∍∕ ∍∑∈−−∓ ∗∀∏∍∑, ∏∀∏∍∑ ∈∆∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∧∗ ∥∗∍ ∔∨∗∣ ∓∕∆∀−∓∂ ∜∘∂∖∗∂. ∓∇−∀∏∓, ∔∕∓∂∓∇∨ ∍∖∖∐∈∇∓∂∀−∍∨ ∙∘−∏∛∍∓−∍∕∓∂∀−∍∨ ∍ ∖∗∕∓∈−∍∨ ∓∕∆∀−∓∂ ∜∘∂∖∗∂ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀, −∀∘∏∀ ∔∕∍∝∐∀ ∏ −∈∓∋∍∇∀−−∠∑ ∙∀∏∗∀∑ ∓ ∖∘∞−∓∖∗∍ ∗∓∆∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ −∀∌∠∂∀∈∑ ∂−∈∝−∍∑ ∑∍∕∓∑.

∥∗∍ ∙∀∏∗∠ ∔∕∓∐∍∐∍ ∖∂∈∗ −∀ ∓∜∈−∣ ∂∀∋−∘∧ ∗∀∎−∘, ∐∈∋∀∞∘∧ ∔∓ ∗∘ ∖∗∓∕∓−∘ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∍, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨ ∖∓∖∗∀∂∐∨∈∗ −∀∝ ∂−∈∝−∍∎ ∑∍∕. −∈∑∈∛∏∍∎ ∘∜∈−∠∎ ∙∍∐∓∖∓∙ ∙∕∈∇∈∕∍∏ ∂∈∖∗∈∕, ∗∀∏ ∏∓∑∑∈−∗∍∕∘∈∗ ∂∠∂∓∇∠, ∏ ∏∓∗∓∕∠∑ ∔∕∍∝∐∀ −∀∘∏∀ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ −∀∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∍.

«∔∓ ∑−∈−∍∧ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∠√ ∑∠∖∐∍∗∈∐∈∎, ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ – ∥∗∓ ∔∕∍∌∕∀∏, ∂∖∈ ∔∈∕∈∋∍∂∀∈∑∓∈ ∍∑, −∀ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∇∈∐∈ ∓∃∑∀−∜∍∂∓ ∍ ∔∕∈√∓∇∨∞∈, ∀ ∂∖∨ ∂∖∈∐∈−−∀∨ – ∐∍∝∣ ∗∈−∣. ∍, ∔∓√∓∋∈, ∜∗∓ ∖∈∆∓∇−∨ ∥∗∍, −∀ ∔∈∕∂∠∎ ∂∌∆∐∨∇ ∙∀−∗∀∖∗∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∖∐∓∂∀, ∔∓∇∗∂∈∕∋∇∀∧∗∖∨ ∖∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∓∎ −∀∘∏∓∎».

∜∗∓∃∠ ∐∘∜∝∈ ∔∓−∨∗∣ ∗∀∎−∘, ∖∏∕∠∗∘∧ ∌∀ ∂−∈∝−∍∑ ∑∍∕∓∑, ∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∂∖∔∓∑−∍∑ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∌−∀∈∑ ∓ ∌∕∈−∍∍, ∜∈∕∈∌ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∏ −∀∑ ∔∓∖∗∘∔∀∈∗ ∃∓∐∣∝∀∨ ∜∀∖∗∣ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∍ ∓∃ ∓∏∕∘∋∀∧∞∈∑ −∀∖ ∑∍∕∈.


16

∏∀∏ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑?


∀∏∗ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∓∆∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∨ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗ ∂ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∥∗∀∔∓∂. ∂ ∑∓∑∈−∗ ∂∍∇∈−∍∨, ∖∂∈∗∓∂∠∈ ∜∀∖∗∍∛∠ ∍∌∂∈∖∗−∠∈, ∏∀∏ ∙∓∗∓−∠ ∔∈∕∈∑∈∞∀∧∗∖∨ ∓∗ ∔∕∈∇∑∈∗∀ ∏ ∆∐∀∌∘, ∔∕∓√∓∇∨∗ ∜∈∕∈∌ √∕∘∖∗∀∐∍∏ ∆∐∀∌∀, ∆∇∈ ∓−∍ ∔∕∈∐∓∑∐∨∧∗∖∨ ∍ ∙∓∏∘∖∍∕∘∧∗∖∨ −∀ ∖∈∗∜∀∗∏∈ ∂∠∖∗∍∐∀∧∞∈∎ ∆∐∀∌−∓∈ ∇−∓.

∌∇∈∖∣ ∐∘∜∍ ∖∂∈∗∀ ∔∕∈∓∃∕∀∌∘∧∗∖∨ ∂ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠ ∍ ∔∈∕∈∇∀∧∗∖∨ −∈∎∕∓−∀∑∍ ∑∓∌∆∀ ∂ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∠∎ ∛∈−∗∕ ∂ ∌∀∗∠∐∓∜−∓∎ ∜∀∖∗∍ ∑∓∌∆∀. ∍∑∈−−∓ ∂ ∥∗∓∎ ∜∀∖∗∍ ∑∓∌∆∀ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈ ∂∖∈∎ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∓∎ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∍.

∂∖∈ ∓∃∕∀∌∠, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑ ∂ ∋∍∌−∍, ∍ ∂∖∈ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∨ ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∑∠ −∀∃∐∧∇∀∈∑, ∔∈∕∈∋∍∂∀∧∗∖∨ ∍∑∈−−∓ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∏∕∓∝∈∜−∓∑ ∘∜∀∖∗∏∈ ∑∓∌∆∀. ∍ ∗∈∏∖∗, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∂∠ ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∜∍∗∀∈∗∈ ∍ ∏∕∀∖∍∂∠∎ ∔∈∎∌∀∋, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∂∠ ∂∍∇∍∗∈ ∌∀ ∓∏−∓∑, ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∂∓∌−∍∏∀∈∗ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∑∍∌∈∕−∓∑ ∘∜∀∖∗∏∈ ∑∓∌∆∀ ∓∃∟∈∑∓∑ ∂∖∈∆∓ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∏∘∃∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∖∀−∗∍∑∈∗∕∓∂.

∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∔∕∓∀−∀∐∍∌∍∕∘∈∑ ∥∗∘ −∈∔∕∓∖∗∘∧ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∧. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∑∠ ∆∓∂∓∕∍∑, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑, ∑∠ ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∔∓∇∕∀∌∘∑∈∂∀∈∑ ∗∓∗ ∥∙∙∈∏∗, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∂∓∌−🔮∍∏∀∈∗ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∘∜∀∖∗∏∈ ∑∓∌∆∀ ∔∕∓∍∌∂∓∇∍∑∠∎ ∖∂∈∗∓∂∠∑∍ ∐∘∜∀∑∍ ∇∓∖∗∍∆∀∧∞∍∑∍ −∀∝∍√ ∆∐∀∌ ∍ ∔∕∈∂∕∀∞∀∧∞∍√∖∨ ∂ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑, ∑∠ ∐∍∝∣ −∀∃∐∧∇∀∈∑ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠, ∂∓∌−∍∏∀∧∞∍∈ ∂ ∑∓∌∆∈.

∖∐∈∇∘∈∗ ∘∜∈∖∗∣ ∈∞∈ ∓∇∍− ∙∀∏∗, ∑∓∌∆ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∓ ∖∂∈∗∓−∈∔∕∓−∍∛∀∈∑ ∍ ∂−∘∗∕∍ −∈∆∓ ∛∀∕∍∗ ∏∕∓∑∈∝−∀∨ ∗∈∑−∓∗∀. −∈∔∓∖∕∈∇∖∗∂∈−−∠∎ ∏∓−∗∀∏∗ ∑∓∌∆∀ ∖∓ ∖∂∈∗∓∑ ∗∀∏∋∈ −∈∂∓∌∑∓∋∈−.

∇∐∨ −∀∆∐∨∇−∓∖∗∍ ∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∍∑, ∜∗∓ ∔∈∕∈∇ −∀∑∍ ∆∓∕∨∞∀∨ ∖∂∈∜∀ ∍ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑ ∖∂∈∗, ∍∌∐∘∜∀∈∑∠∎ ∈∈ ∔∐∀∑∈−∈∑. √∓∗∨ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑ ∖∂∈∗ ∖∂∈∜∍, ∔∓∐∓∖∗∣ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∜∈∕∈∔∀ ∍ ∖∀∑ ∑∓∌∆ ∔∓∆∕∘∋∈−∠ ∂ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∠∎ ∑∕∀∏. ∖∂∈∗ ∖∂∈∜∍ −∈ ∓∖∂∈∞∀∈∗ −∍ ∖∀∑ ∑∓∌∆, −∍ ∈∆∓ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∠∎ ∛∈−∗∕, ∍ ∗∈∑ −∈ ∑∈−∈∈ ∑∠ ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∑ ∨∕∏∍∎ ∍ ∕∀∌−∓∛∂∈∗−∠∎ ∑∍∕ ∂−∘∗∕∍ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∑∓∌∆∀.

∗∓ ∋∈ ∖∀∑∓∈ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗ ∍ ∖ ∓∖∗∀∐∣−∠∑∍ ∓∕∆∀−∀∑∍ ∜∘∂∖∗∂, ∌∂∘∏, ∔∕∍∏∓∖−∓∂∈−∍∈, ∂∏∘∖ ∍ ∌∀∔∀√, ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∧∗∖∨ ∑∓∌∆∓∑ ∐∍∝∣ ∂ ∂∍∇∈ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∖∍∆−∀∐∓∂. ∂ ∗∈∜∈−∍∈ ∂∖∈∎ −∀∝∈∎ ∋∍∌−∍ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆ −∈ ∍∑∈∈∗ −∈∔∓∖∕∈∇∖∗∂∈−−∓∆∓ ∏∓−∗∀∏∗∀ ∖ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∈∎ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∧∞∈∎, ∏∀∏ ∃∠ ∂−∈ −∀∖. ∓− ∍∑∈∈∗ ∇∈∐∓ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∖ ∈∈ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∏∓∔∍∈∎ ∂∓∌−∍∏∀∧∞∈∎ ∂ ∑∓∌∆∈. ∌∇∈∖∣ ∑∠ ∍ ∔∓∔∀∇∀∈∑ ∂ ∍∐∐∧∌∍∧, ∔∕∈∇∔∓∐∀∆∀∨, ∜∗∓ ∥∗∀ ∏∓∔∍∨ ∍ ∈∖∗∣ −∀∖∗∓∨∞∀∨ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∨, ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∧∞∀∨ ∂−∈ −∀∖.







17

∂−∈∝−∍∎ ∑∍∕ −∀√∓∇∍∗∖∨ ∂−∘∗∕∍ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∑∓∌∆∀


∙∍∌∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∌∀∏∓−∠ ∔∕∍∂∓∇∨∗ −∀∖ ∏ −∈∓∖∔∓∕∍∑∓∑∘ ∂∠∂∓∇∘. −∀∝∈ ∌∕∈−∍∈, ∖∐∘√, ∓∖∨∌∀−∍∈, ∓∃∓−∨−∍∈ ∍ ∂∏∘∖, ∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∑∠∈ −∀∑∍ ∌∀ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∧, ∓∃∟∈∏∗∍∂−∠∎ ∑∍∕ ∍∐∍ ∂∖∈∐∈−−∘∧, ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∍ −∀ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∇∈∐∈ ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∐∨∧∗ ∖∓∃∓∎ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠, ∔∓∖∗∘∔∀∧∞∍∈ ∏ −∀∑ ∂ ∑∓∌∆ ∍ ∗∕∀−∖∙∓∕∑∍∕∘∈∑∠∈ ∂ −∈∑ ∂ ∓∃∕∀∌∠.

−∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑ ∕∈∏∘ ∍ ∖∜∍∗∀∈∑, ∜∗∓ ∕∈∏∀ −∀√∓∇∍∗∖∨ ∂−∈ −∀∖, √∓∗∨ ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∕∈∏∀ −∀√∓∇∍∗∖∨ ∂−∘∗∕∍ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∑∓∌∆∀. ∖∂∈∗∓∂∠∈ ∜∀∖∗∍∛∠, ∓∗∕∀∋∀∨∖∣ ∓∗ ∕∈∏∍, ∔∓∔∀∇∀∧∗ ∏ −∀∑ ∂ ∆∐∀∌ ∍ ∔∕∈∂∕∀∞∀∧∗∖∨ ∗∀∑, ∂ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠.

∥∗∍ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠ ∔∓∖∕∈∇∖∗∂∓∑ −∈∕∂−∠√ ∓∏∓−∜∀−∍∎ ∂ ∆∐∀∌−∓∑ ∇−∈ ∔∈∕∈∇∀∧∗∖∨ ∂ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∠∎ ∛∈−∗∕ ∑∓∌∆∀.



−∍∏∗∓ −∈ ∌−∀∈∗ ∏∀∏∓∂∠ ∈∆∓ ∖∍∐∠, ∔∓∏∀ ∍√ −∈ ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∘∈∗


∕∈∏∀, ∏∓∗∓∕∘∧ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑ −∀ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∇∈∐∈ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍∎ ∖∍∆−∀∐ ∂ −∀∝∈∑ ∑∓∌∆∈. ∈∖∐∍ ∂∇∕∘∆ ∓∃∓∕∂∈∗∖∨ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∠∎ −∈∕∂, ∍∇∘∞∍∎🌟 ∓∗ ∆∐∀∌∀ ∂ ∑∓∌∆, ∖∕∀∌∘ ∍∖∜∈∌−∈∗ ∍ ∓∃∕∀∌ ∕∈∏∍. ∗∓∜−∓ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∍ ∝∘∑ ∕∈∏∍ −∀√∓∇∍∗∖∨ ∘ −∀∖ ∂ ∑∓∌∆∈. ∕∈∏∀, ∏∓∗∓∕∘∧ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑, ∝∘∑ ∕∈∏∍, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∑∠ ∖∐∠∝∍∑ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∐∍∝∣ ∕∀∖∝∍∙∕∓∂∏∀ ∍∑∔∘∐∣∖∓∂ ∍∇∘∞∍√ ∏ −∀∑ ∂ ∑∓∌∆. ∈∖∐∍ ∓∖∓∌−∀∗∣ ∥∗∓ ∓∜∈−∣ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓ ∍ ∔∕∍−∨∗∣ ∗∓∗ ∙∀∏∗, ∜∗∓ ∕∈∏∍ ∂∓∂∖∈ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗, ∀ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∐∍∝∣ −∀∝∈ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈, ∗∓ ∑∓∋−∓ ∂−∘∗∕∍ ∖∈∃∨ ∖∇∈∐∀∗∣ ∂∓∇∘ ∗∂∈∕∇∓∎. ∍∑∈−−∓ ∗∀∏ ∑∓∋−∓ −∀∘∜∍∗∣∖∨ √∓∇∍∗∣ ∔∓ ∂∓∇∈. ∂∈∇∣ −∍∏∀∏∓∎ ∂∓∇∠ ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗. ∔∓∇∘∑∀∎∗∈ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∂∕∈∑∨, ∍ ∂∠ ∔∓∎∑∈∗∈ ∖∘∗∣ ∥∗∓∎ ∍∖∗∍−∠. ∔∓∇∘∑∀∎∗∈ ∔∕∨∑∓ ∖∈∎∜∀∖! ∥∗∓ ∂∀∝∈ ∔∈∕∂∓∈ ∌∀∇∀−∍∈.




∍∐∐∧∌∍∨ ∕∀∖∖∗∓∨−∍∨


∓∞∘∞∈−∍∈ ∕∀∖∖∗∓∨−∍∨ ∑∈∋∇∘ ∥∏∕∀−∓∑ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕∀ ∍ ∂∀∑∍, ∈∖∗∣ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∈ ∔∘∖∗∓∗∠, ∖∙∓∕∑∍∕∓∂∀−−∓∈ ∂ ∂∀∝∈∑ ∑∓∌∆∈. ∀−∀∐∓∆∍∜−∠∑ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∑ ∍ ∔∕∈∇∑∈∗∠ ∏∀∋∘∞∍∈∖∨ ∓∜∈−∣ ∇∀∐∈∏∍∑∍, −∀ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∇∈∐∈ ∓∃∕∀∌∠, ∗∈∖−∨∞∍∈∖∨ ∂ ∓∇−∓∑ ∏∕∓√∓∗−∓∑ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∓∑ ∘∜∀∖∗∏∈ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∑∓∌∆∀. −∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏, −∀∃∐✨∧∇∀∧∞∍∎ ∂ ∗∈∐∈∖∏∓∔, ∌∀ ∌∂∈∌∇∀∑∍ ∌−∀∈∗, ∜∗∓ ∓−∍ −∀√∓∇∨∗∖∨ −∀ ∕∀∖∖∗∓∨−∍∍ ∗∠∖∨∜ ∖∂∈∗∓∂∠√ ∐∈∗ ∓∗ −∈∆∓. ∓∇−∀∏∓ −∀ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∇∈∐∈ ∌∂∈∌∇∠ −∀√∓∇∨∗∖∨ ∂−∘∗∕∍ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀ ∂ ∈∆∓ ∌∕∍∗∈∐∣−∓∑ ∘∜∀∖∗∏∈ ∑∓∌∆∀.







18

∔∓∏∀ ∂∠ ∜∍∗∀∈∗∈ ∥∗∓∗ ∗∈∏∖∗, ∂∠ −∈ −∀√∓∇∍∗∈∖∣, ∏∀∏ ∂∀∑ ∏∀∋∈∗∖∨ ∂−∘∗∕∍ ∗∓∆∓ ∔∓∑∈∞∈−∍∨, ∂ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∑ ∂∠ ∖∍∇∍∗∈. ∥∗∓ ∔∓∑∈∞∈−∍∈, ∏∀∏ −∍ ∘∇∍∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓, −∀√∓∇∍∗∖∨ ∂−∘∗∕∍ ∂∀∖ ∖∀∑∍√. ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∂∠ ∂∍∇∍∗∈ ∖∂∓∈ ∗∈∐∓, ∌∀∖∗∀∂∐∨∈∗ ∂∀∖ ∇∘∑∀∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∂∠ ∂−∘∗∕∍ −∈∆∓. −∓ ∖∐∈∇∘∈∗ ∔∓∑−∍∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∍ ∂∀∝∈ ∗∈∐∓ −∀√∓∇∍∗∖∨ ∂−∘∗∕∍ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∑∓∌∆∀.




«−∓ ∈∖∐∍ ∑∠ −∈ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∔∓-−∀∖∗∓∨∞∈∑∘ ∇∓∖∗∍∜∣ ∂−∈∝−∈∆∓ ∑∍∕∀, ∗∓ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∐∍ ∑∠ ∃∠∗∣ ∘∂∈∕∈−∠, ∜∗∓ ∓− ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗?»



∏∓−∈∜−∓, −∈∗! ∈∇∍−∖∗∂∈−−∀∨ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣, ∖ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∎ ∑∠ ∍∑∈∈∑ ∇∈∐∓ - ∥∗∓ ∑∍∕ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∎, ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∧∞∍∎ ∐∍∝∣ ∂ −∀∝∈∑ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∍.

«∑∠ ∂∈∕∍∑ ∂ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∓∂∀−∍∈ ∔∕∈∇∑∈∗∓∂ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∔∓∗∓∑∘, ∜∗∓ ∂∍∇∍∑ ∍√ ∍ ∓∞∘∞∀∈∑ ∗∀∏∍∑∍, ∏∀∏∍∑∍ ∓∗∕∀∋∀∈∗ ∍√ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆. ∓∇−∀∏∓ −∀∝∍ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∨ – ∐∍∝∣ −∀∝∍ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∂ −∀∝∈∑ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∍, ∗∓, ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∐∨∨ ∖∈∃∈ ∂∖∈∐∈−−∘∧ ∍ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∧, ∏∀∏ ∕∈∀∐∍∍, ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∧∞∍∈ ∂−∈ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨, ∑∠ ∂∔∀∇∀∈∑ ∂ ∃∓∐∣∝∓∈ ∌∀∃∐∘∋∇∈−∍∈». ∇∋. ∃∀∕∏∐∍.






∌∀∃∀∂−∠∎ ∓∔∠∗


∔∕∈∇∔∓∐∓∋∍∑, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∂∠−∘∐∍ ∑∓∌∆ ∍∌ ∗∈∐∀ ∍ ∔∓∇∇∈∕∋∍∂∀∈∑ ∈∆∓ ∋∍∌−∈∇∈∨∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∣ ∂ ∖∗∈∏∐∨−−∓∑ ∖∓∖∘∇∈, ∔∓∑∈∖∗∍∑ ∕∨∇∓∑ ∖ ∖∓∖∘∇∓∑ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕, ∂ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∑ ∑∓∋−∓ ∙∍∏∖∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∖∀∑∘∧ ∕∀∌−∓∓∃∕∀∌−∘∧ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∧ ∍ −∀∜−∈∑ ∌∀∆∕∘∋∀∗∣ ∂ ∃∀∌∘ ∇∀−−∠√ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕∀ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍∈ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠, ∔∓∖∗∘∔∀∧∞∍∈ ∓∗ ∍∌∓∃∕∀∋∈−∍∨, ∌∂∘∏∀, ∌∀∔∀√∓∂ ∍ ∗.∇.

∗∈∔∈∕∣ ∔∓∇∖∓∈∇∍−∍∑ ∥∗∓∗ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕ ∏ ∛∈−∗∕∀∑, ∓∗∂∈∗∖∗∂∈−−∠∑ ∌∀ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∨ ∂ ∂∀∝∈∑ ∑∓∌∆∈. ∗∈∔∈∕∣ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∔∓∖∠∐∀∗∣ ∈∑∘ ∌∀∕∀−∈∈ ∌∀∔∍∖∀−−∠∈ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠ ∖ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕∀. ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∨ ∥∗∍ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∂∍∇∈∗∣ ∀∇∈∏∂∀∗−∘∧ ∍∑ ∓∃∖∗∀−∓∂∏∘ ∍ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∋∍∗∣ ∂ −∈∎. ∍∌ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕∀ ∑∠ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∔∓∖∠∐∀∗∣ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠, ∖∂∨∌∀−−∠∈ ∖ −∀∝∍∑ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈∑ ∖∀∑∍√ ∖∈∃∨.

∏ ∔∕∍∑∈∕∘, ∂∖∈, ∜∗∓ ∂∠ ∂∍∇∍∗∈, ∖∐∠∝∍∗∈ ∍ ∓∖∨∌∀∈∗∈ ∖∍∇∨ ∌∀ ∂∀∝∍∑ ∕∀∃∓∜∍∑ ∖∗∓∐∓∑, ∔∈∕∈∇∀∗∣ ∑∓∌∆∘ ∔∓∖∕∈∇∖∗∂∓∑ ∗∓∜−∠√ ∥∐∈∏∗∕∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∖∍∆−∀∐∓∂, ∗∓ ∂∀∝ ∑∓∌∆ ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∍∗ ∂∀∖ ∃∍∌−∈∖∑∈−∓∑, ∖∍∇∨∞∍∑ ∘ ∖∈∃∨ ∂ ∓∙∍∖∈.






19

∥∗∓∗ ∂∓∓∃∕∀∋∀∈∑∠∎ ∑∍∕ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∓∖∓∌−∀∂∀∗∣∖∨ ∑∓∌∆∓∑ ∕∓∂−∓ ∖∗∓∐∣∏∓, ∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∃∘∇∘∗ ∔∓∖∗∘∔∀∗∣ ∖∍∆−∀∐∠ ∍∌ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕∀ (∇∀−−∠∈ ∕∀∌∕∀∃∓∗∏∍ ∂∍∕∗∘∀∐∣−∓∎ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∍, ∗∕∀−∖∐∍∕∘∈∑∓∎ ∔∕∨∑∓ ∖ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕∀ ∂ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆, ∘∋∈ ∂∈∇∘∗∖∨ ∂ −∀∘∜−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈). ∂ ∥∗∓∎ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍ ∑∠ −∈ ∖∑∓∋∈∑ ∓∖∓∌−∀∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∖∓∖∗∓∍∑ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∍∌ ∓∇−∓∆∓ ∑∓∌∆∀.




«∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∘ ∓∜∈−∣ ∐∈∆∏∓ ∓∃∑∀−∘∗∣∖∨ ∍ ∔∓∂∈∕∍∗∣ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∨∑, ∘ ∏∓∗∓∕∠√ −∈∗ −∍∏∀∏∍√ ∕∈∀∐∣−∠√ ∖∓∓∗∂∈∗∖∗∂∍∎. ∥∗∓ ∍ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗ ∖ −∀∑∍ ∂ ∖∐∘∜∀∈ ∖−∓∂».



∑∍∕ ∂ ∖−∓∂∍∇∈−∍∍


∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣ ∇∐∨ −∀∖, ∥∗∓ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∓∋−∓ ∔∓∗∕∓∆∀∗∣ ∕∘∏∀∑∍ ∍ ∘∂∍∇∈∗∣ ∆∐∀∌∀∑∍. ∂∓ ∖−∈ ∗∓∋∈ ∑∓∋−∓ ∗∕∓∆∀∗∣ ∕∘∏∀∑∍ ∍ ∂∍∇∈∗∣ ∆∐∀∌∀∑∍. −∓ ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∂∓ ∖−∈ ∘ ∂∀∖ −∈∗ −∍ ∕∘∏, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∑∍ ∑∓∋−∓ ∗∕∓∆∀∗∣ −∍ ∆∐∀∌, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∑∍ ∑∓∋−∓ ∂∍∇∈∗∣.

∓∇−∀∏∓ ∔∕∍−∍∑∀∨ ∂∓ ∖−∈ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∨ ∌∀ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∣−∘∧ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣, ∑∠ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∓∃∑∀−∠∂∀∈∑∖∨. −∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏, ∏∕∈∔∏∓ ∖∔∨∞∍∎ ∂ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∔∓∖∗∈∐∍ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∂∓ ∖−∈ ∓∞∘∞∀∗∣ ∖∈∃∨ −∀√∓∇∨∞∍∑∖∨ ∂ ∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∓ ∇∕∘∆∓∑ ∑∍∕∈. ∈∑∘ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∖−∍∗∣∖∨, ∜∗∓ ∓− ∔∕∈∌∍∇∈−∗ ∍ ∘∔∕∀∂∐∨∈∗ ∓∆∕∓∑−∓∎ ∖∗∕∀−∓∎. ∃∓∐∈∈ ∗∓∆∓ ∓− ∑∓∋∈∗ ∃∠∗∣ −∀ ∔∕∈∇∈∐∈ ∥∑∓∛∍∎ ∓∗ ∘∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∨ ∖∂∓∍∑ ∆∓∖∘∇∀∕∖∗∂∓∑.




−∀ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∇∈∐∈ ∥∗∓∗ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∐∈∋∍∗ ∂ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∔∓∖∗∈∐∍.






∖−∓∂∍∇∈−∍∨√ ∓− ∑∓∋∈∗ ∔∓∖∈∞∀∗∣ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∈ ∑∈∖∗∀, ∂∖∗∕∈∜∀∗∣∖∨ ∖ ∐∧∇∣∑∍, ∕∀∌∆∓∂∀∕∍∂∀∗∣, ∈∖∗∣, ∔∍∗∣, ∖∑∈∨∗∣∖∨, ∜∘∂∖∗∂∓∂∀∗∣ ∌∀∔∀√∍, ∔∕∍∏∀∖∀∗∣∖∨, ∖∐∠∝∀∗∣ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∈ ∌∂∘∏∍ ∍ ∇∀∋∈ ∍∖∔∠∗∠∂∀∗∣ ∓∕∆∀∌∑. −∈∖∑∓∗∕∨ −∀ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∥∗∓ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∨ ∃∈∌ ∂∖∨∏∓∆∓ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∣−∓∆∓ ∖∓∓∗∂∈∗∖∗∂∍∨, ∓−∍ ∔∈∕∈∋∍∂∀∧∗∖∨, ∏∀∏ −∀∨∂∘. ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∔∕∓∃∘∇∍∂∝∍∖∣ ∓∗∓ ∖−∀, ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∔∓−∍∑∀∈∗, ∜∗∓ ∥∗∓ ∃∠∐∍ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∨.

∈∖∐∍ ∑∠ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∂∓ ∖−∈ ∐∈∆∏∓ ∋∍∗∣ ∂ −∈∕∈∀∐∣−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ −∀∝∍√ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∎, ∗∓ ∂ ∗∀∏∓∎ ∋∈ ∖∗∈∔∈−∍ ∥∗∓ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∓∗−∓∖∍∗∣∖∨ ∏ ∗∓∑∘ ∑∍∕∘, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∑∠ ∓∞∘∞∀∈∑ −∀∨∂∘. −∈∗ −∍∏∀∏∓∆∓ ∔∕∓∗∍∂∓∕∈∜∍∨ ∂ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓ ∔∕∓∖∠∔∀∨∖∣ ∓∗∓ ∖−∀, ∑∠ ∔∈∕∈√∓∇∍∑ ∏ ∃∓∐∈∈ ∇∐∍−−∓∑∘ ∖−∘, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ −∀∌∠∂∀∈∑ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∎ ∋∍∌−∣∧.





20

∔∕∍∜∍−∀, ∔∓ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∎ ∑∠ ∖∜∍∗∀∈∑ −∀∝∍ ∖−∠ ∍∐∐∧∌∍∈∎, ∀ ∋∍∌−∣ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣∧, ∌∀∏∐∧∜∈−∀ ∂ −∀∝∍√ ∔∕∍∂∠∜∏∀√ ∍ ∘∖∐∓∂−∓∖∗∨√. ∍∌ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∖∐∈∇∘∈∗, ∜∗∓ −∈ ∇∀∐∈∏ ∗∓∗ ∇∈−∣, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∑∠ ∔∕∓∖−∈∑∖∨ ∍ ∓∗ ∗∓∎ ∌∈∑−∓∎ ∋∍∌−∍, ∏∓∗∓∕∘∧, ∏∀∏ −∀∑ ∏∀∋∈∗∖∨, ∑∠ ∋∍∂∈∑ ∖∈∎∜∀∖, ∗∀∏∍∑ ∋∈ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∑, ∏∀∏ ∑∠ ∏∀∋∇∓∈ ∘∗∕∓ ∔∕∓∖∠∔∀∈∑∖∨ ∓∗∓ ∖−∀.




∏∗∓ ∋∈ ∗∓∆∇∀ ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∗ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∨?


∥∗∓, ∔∓∋∀∐∘∎, ∖∀∑∠∎ ∂∀∋−∠∎ ∂∓∔∕∓∖! ∏∀∏ ∘∋∈ ∨∖−∓ ∍∌ ∂∠∝∈∖∏∀∌∀−−∓∆∓, −∈∖∓∑−∈−−∓, ∜∗∓ ∂−∈∝−∍∑ ∑∍∕ ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎, ∏∀∋∈∗∖∨ −∀∑ ∕∈∀∐∣−∠∑, ∙∓∕∑∍∕∘∈∗∖∨ ∂ −∀∝∈∑ ∑∓∌∆∈. −∓ ∌∇∈∖∣ ∂∓∌−∍∏∀∈∗ ∓∇∍− ∂∓∔∕∓∖, ∈∖∐∍ ∂∖∈ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∣−∠∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∀ ∨∂∐∨∧∗∖∨ ∔∕∓∖∗∠∑ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈∑ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∐∨∈∗ ∖∓∃∓∎ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆?

∖∘∇∨ ∔∓ ∗∓∑∘, ∜∗∓ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆, ∕∀∂−∓, ∏∀∏ ∍ −∀∝∍ ∕∘∏∍, −∓∆∍ ∍ ∂∖∈ ∓∖∗∀∐∣−∓∈ ∨∂∐∨∈∗∖∨ ∗∀∏∓∎ ∋∈ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∈∎. ∗∓ ∍ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆, −∈ ∜∗∓ ∍−∓∈, ∏∀∏ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈.

∔∓∨∖−∍∑ ∖∏∀∌∀−−∓∈ −∀ ∔∕∍∑∈∕∈: «∈∖∐∍ ∃∠ ∑∠ ∑∓∆∐∍ ∂∠∗∨−∘∗∣ ∆∐∀∌−∠∈ −∈∕∂∠ ∍ ∔∓∑∈∖∗∍∗∣ ∑∓∌∆ −∀∕∘∋∘, ∔∓∑∈∖∗∍∂ ∈∆∓ ∌∀ ∔∕∈∇∈∐∀∑∍ ∜∈∕∈∔∀, ∜∗∓ ∃∠ ∓− ∔∓∔∀∇∀∐ ∂ −∀∝∈ ∔∓∐∈ ∌∕∈−∍∨, ∗∓∆∇∀ ∃∠ ∑∠ ∑∓∆∐∍ ∂∍∇∈∗∣ ∈∆∓ ∍ ∗∕∓∆∀∗∣ ∕∘∏∀∑∍. ∗∀∏∍∑ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∑, ∖∗∀−∈∗ ∔∓−∨∗−∓, ∜∗∓ −∀∝ ∑∓∌∆ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∐∍∝∣ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈, ∖∙∓∕∑∍∕∓∂∀−−∓∈ ∜∘∂∖∗∂∀∑∍ ∌∕∈−∍∨ ∍ ∓∖∨∌∀−∍∨».






«∆∇∈ ∋∈ ∗∓∆∇∀ ∗∓∗ ∕∀∌∘∑, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∗, ∈∖∐∍ ∥∗∓ −∈ ∑∓∌∆?».





∏∀∏∓∂∠ ∓∗∐∍∜∍∗∈∐∣−∠∈ ∔∕∍∌−∀∏∍ ∍∖∗∍−−∓ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∂ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∈? ∕∀∌∘∑, ∂∓∐∨ ∍ ∖∈∕∇∛∈. ∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∠∎ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∓∃∐∀∇∀∈∗ ∖∍∐∓∎ ∑∠∝∐∈−∍∨, ∖∍∐∓∎ ∂∓∐∍ ∍ ∖∍∐∓∎ ∜∘∂∖∗∂. ∖∍∐∀ ∑∠∝∐∈−∍∨ ∈∖∗∣ ∖∂∈∗ ∔∓∌−∀−∍∨, ∖∍∐∀ ∂∓∐∍ — ∥−∈∕∆∍∨ √∀∕∀∏∗∈∕∀, ∖∍∐∀ ∜∘∂∖∗∂∀ — ∐∧∃∓∂∣.




∏∗∓ ∂∍∇∍∗ ∖∐∠∝∍∗ ∓∖∨∌∀∈∗ ∍ ∜∘∂∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∌∀∔∀√∍?


∏∗∓ ∥∗∓ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∓, ∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∇∘∑∀∈∗ ∍ ∜∘∂∖∗∂∘∈∗? ∆∇∈ ∗∀ ∐∍∜−∓∖∗∣, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨ ∆∓∂∓∕∍∗, ∜∗∓ «∨» - ∥∗∓ «∨»? ∆∇∈ ∋∈ ∗∓ «∨», ∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∔∓∐∣∌∘∈∗∖∨ ∑∓∌∆∓∑? ∏∗∓ ∗∓∗, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∔∓∌−∀∈∗?





21

∑∠ ∍∞∈∑ ∗∓∆∓, ∏∗∓ ∂∍∇∍∗. ∓∜∈∂∍∇−∓, ∜∗∓ - ∗∓ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∓, ∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∂∍∇∍∗, ∖∐∠∝∍∗ ∍ ∜∘∂∖∗∂∘∈∗, ∈∖∗∣ −∈∜∗∓ −∀∑−∓∆∓ ∃∓∐∈∈ ∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∓∈, ∜∈∑ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∨.



∥∗∓ ∋∍∂∓∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∓ ∍∐∍ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈


∍ ∓−∓ ∨∂∐∨∈∗∖∨ −∈ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∈∎ ∍∐∍ ∍∌∓∃∕∀∋∈−∍∈∑, ∀ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈∑. ∀ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ −∀∌∠∂∀∈∑ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∣−∠∑ ∑∍∕∓∑ ∥∗∓ ∖∓∂∓∏∘∔−∓∖∗∣ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∎ ∍ ∔∈∕∈∋∍∂∀−∍∎ (∍∌∓∃∕∀∋∈−∍∈), ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∑∠√ ∥∗∍∑ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈∑. ∗∓∜−∓ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∏∀∏ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∑∍∕∀ ∂∓ ∖−∈, −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∍ ∥∗∓∆∓ «∕∈∀∐∣−∓∆∓» ∑∍∕∀.

∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∐∍∝∣ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ∍∐∍ «∨», ∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∗, ∂∍∇∍∗, ∖∐∠∝∍∗ ∍ ∓∞∘∞∀∈∗. ∂−∈∝−∍∎ ∑∍∕ ∖∓∖∗∓∍∗ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∍∌ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∂ −∀∂∍∂∀∈∑∠√ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∧. ∇∀∋∈ ∈∖∐∍ ∑∠ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∍∖√∓∇∍∗∣ ∍∌ ∗∓∆∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∨ ∕∈∀∐∣−∀, ∓∗∏∕∠∗∍∨ ∖∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∓∎ ∙∍∌∍∏∍, √∍∑∍∍ ∍ ∔∖∍√∓∐∓∆∍∍ ∔∕∍∂∈∇∘∗ −∀∖ ∏ ∗∓∑∘, ∜∗∓ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∨ ∖∓∖∗∓∍∗ ∍∌ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∂ ∍ ∔∕∍∇∈∗∖∨ ∔∕∍∌−∀∗∣ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣ −∈∏∓∎ ∑∈∗∀∙∍∌∍∜∈∖∏∓∎ ∖∘∃∖∗∀−∛∍∍ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∧∞∈∎ −∀∕∨∇∘ ∖ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∈∎.

∗∀∏∍∑ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∑, ∥∗∓ ∐∓∆∍∜∈∖∏∍ ∔∕∍∂∈∇∈∗ −∀∖ ∏ ∗∓∑∘, ∜∗∓ ∖∏∕∠∂∀∈∗∖∨ ∌∀ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∈∎. ∥∗∓∗ ∂∠∂∓∇ −∀∖∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∐∓∆∍∜∈∖∏∍ ∍ −∀∘∜−∓ ∓∃∓∖−∓∂∀− ∂ ∖∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∓∖∗∍, ∜∗∓ ∂∠∌∠∂∀∈∗ ∖∗∕∀√ ∘ ∕∨∇∀ ∘∜∈−∠√ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∀∐∍∖∗∓∂, ∖∜∍∗∀∧∞∍√ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∧ ∔∈∕∂∍∜−∓∎ ∍ −∈∌∠∃∐∈∑∓∎



∓∜∈−∣ ∂∀∋−∠∎ ∂∓∔∕∓∖!


∈∖∐∍ ∂∖∈, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∑, ∖∓∖∗∓∍∗ ∍∌ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∎ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∋∈ ∗∓∆∇∀ ∨∂∐∨∈∗∖∨ ∍∖∗∓∜−∍∏∓∑, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∥∗∍ ∓∞∘∞∈−∍∨ ∗∕∀−∖∐∍∕∘∈∗? ∓∗∂∈∜∀∨ −∀ ∥∗∓∗ ∂∓∔∕∓∖, ∑∠ ∇∓∐∋−∠ ∌∀∇∘∑∀∗∣∖∨ −∀∇ ∗∈∑, ∜∗∓ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∨ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∖∀∑∀ ∔∓ ∖∈∃∈, −∈ ∘∔∕∀∂∐∨∈∗ ∖∓∃∓∎, ∀ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∨∂∐∨∈∗∖∨ −∀∝∍∑ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈∑ ∍∐∍ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈∑ −∀∝∈∆∓ «∨».

∖∐∈∇∓∂∀∗∈∐∣−∓, ∥∗∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈ ∇∓∐∋−∓ ∃∠∗∣ ∖∓∌∇∀−∓ ∏∀∏∓∎-∗∓ ∇∕∘∆∓∎, ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓ ∔∓∇∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∓∎ ∍∐∍ ∂∠∖∝∈∎ ∖∍∐∓∎. ∍ ∥∗∓∗ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖ ∗∂∓∕∈−∍∨ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∂ ∇∓∐∋∈− ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗∣ ∔∓∖∗∓∨−−∓.

∈∖∐∍ ∃∠ −∈ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∐∓ ∔∓∖∗∓∨−−∓∎ ∗∕∀−∖∐∨∛∍∍ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∂, ∗∓ ∂∖∈ ∜∗∓ ∑∠ −∀∌∠∂∀∈∑ ∑∀∗∈∕∍∈∎, ∍∖∜∈∌∐∓ ∃∠ −∀∂∖∈∆∇∀. ∥∗∓∗ −∈∔∕∈∕∠∂−∠∎ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖ ∑∓∋−∓ ∖∕∀∂−∍∗∣ ∖ ∗∈∐∈∂∍∌∓∕∓∑, −∀ ∥∏∕∀−∈ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∆∓ ∍∌∓∃∕∀∋∈−∍∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∕∓∂−∓ ∖∗∓∐∣∏∓, ∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∔∈∕∈∇∀∈∗∖∨ ∖∍∆−∀∐ ∂∈∞∀−∍∨ ∖ ∗∈∐∈∛∈−∗∕∀. ∏∀∏ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∔∕∈∕∂∈∗∖∨ ∗∕∀−∖∐∨∛∍∨, ∍∖∜∈∌−∈∗ ∍ ∍∌∓∃∕∀∋∈−∍∈ ∖ ∥∏∕∀−∀.




22

∍∖∗∍−−∀∨ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∀∨ ∖∘∞−∓∖∗∣


∜∗∓∃∠ ∔∕∍∎∗∍ −∈∔∓∖∕∈∇∖∗∂∈−−∓ ∏ ∔∓∌−∀−∍∧ ∍∖∗∍−∠, −∈∗ ∍−∓∆∓ ∔∘∗∍, ∜∈∑ ∖∓∃∖∗∂∈−−∠∈ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∍ ∋∍∌−∈−−∠∎ ∓∔∠∗. −∀∇ ∑∠∖∐∣∧ −∈ ∂∐∀∖∗−∠ ∂∈∏∀ ∓−∀ ∋∍∂∈∗ ∂∈∜−∓.



∏∗∓ ∌∀∖∗∀∂∐∨∈∗ −∀∝∈ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ∂∍∇∈∗∣ ∂∖∈, ∜∗∓ −∀∖ ∓∏∕∘∋∀∈∗?


∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∓ ∓∜∈∂∍∇−∓ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∓∂∀−∍∈ −∈∏∓∆∓ ∂∠∖∝∈∆∓ «∨», ∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∖∓∌∇∀∐∓ ∂∖∧ ∖∓∂∓∏∘∔−∓∖∗∣ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∎ ∍ ∔∕∓∇∓∐∋∀∈∗ ∖∂∓∧ ∕∀∃∓∗∘ ∃∈∖∔∕∈∖∗∀−−∓. ∂∠∖∝∍∎ ∕∀∌∘∑, ∗∂∓∕∨∞∍∎ ∖∗∓∐∣ ∗∓−∏∓ ∍ ∥∙∙∈∏∗∍∂−∓, ∃∈∌ ∖∓∑−∈−∍∎ ∓∃∐∀∇∀∈∗ ∂∠∖∝∈∎ ∖∍∐∓∎ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∎ ∂∐∀∖∗∣∧. −∓ ∥∗∓∗ ∀∖∔∈∏∗ ∔∓∌−∀−∍∨ ∘∋∈ ∂∠√∓∇∍∗ ∌∀ ∔∕∈∇∈∐∠ −∀∘∜−∓∆∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∨, ∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∕∀∖∖∑∓∗∕∍∑ ∇∀∐∣−∈∎∝∘∧ ∗∈∓∕∍∧ ∖ ∗∓∜∏∍ ∌∕∈−∍∨ ∇∕∈∂−∍√ ∑∍∖∗∍∜∈∖∏∍√ ∘∜∈−∍∎.

∜∗∓ ∃∠∐∓ ∇∀∐∣∝∈?


∨ ∔∓∔∠∗∀∐∖∨ ∓∗∖∗∕∀−∍∗∣∖∨ ∓∗ ∂∖∨∏∍√ ∑∠∖∐∈∎. ∃∠∐∀ ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∓∂∀−∀ ∓∜∈−∣ ∔∕∓∖∗∀∨ ∗∈√−∓∐∓∆∍∨ ∂√∓∋∇∈−∍∨ ∂ ∗∕∀−∖∓∂∓∈ ∖∓∖∗∓∨−∍∈. ∌∀∑∍∕∀∈∝∣ ∍ ∕∀∖∖∈∍∂∀∈∝∣ ∖∂∓∎ ∂∌∆∐∨∇, ∔∓ ∂∖∈∑∘ ∍∌∓∃∕∀∋∈−∍∧ ∑∍∕∀, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∂∍∇∨∗ ∆∐∀∌∀, ∓∖∗∀−∀∂∐∍∂∀∈∝∣ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∍ ∗∠ ∘∋∈ ∂ ∗∕∀−∖∈...

«∓∃∠∜−∓ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∖∑∓∗∕∍∗ ∂ ∏∀∏∘∧-∐∍∃∓ ∓∔∕∈∇∈∐∈−−∘∧ ∗∓∜∏∘ ∔∕∓∖∗∕∀−∖∗∂∀ ∍∐∍ −∀ ∏∀∏∓∎-∐∍∃∓ ∏∓−∏∕∈∗−∠∎ ∓∃∟∈∏∗. ∂ ∗∕∀−∖∈ ∓− ∖∑∓∗∕∍∗ ∖∕∀∌∘ ∂∈∌∇∈. ∂ ∑∓∑∈−∗ ∗∀∏∓∆∓ ∂∌∆∐∨∇∀ ∔∖∍√∍∏∀ ∔∓∐−∓∖∗∣∧ ∕∀∖∖∐∀∃∐∨∈∗∖∨, ∀ ∕∀∃∓∗∀ ∑∠∖∐∈∎ ∔∕∍∓∖∗∀−∀∂∐∍∂∀∈∗∖∨. ∂∏∐∧∜∀∈∗∖∨ ∃∓∐∈∈ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∍∎ ∖∐∓∎ ∔∓∇∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∓∆∓ ∑∠∝∐∈−∍∨».

∨ ∃∠∐ ∓∜∈−∣ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∈− ∂ ∗∓∗ ∑∓∑∈−∗ ∍ ∖∐∈∇∍∐ ∌∀ ∗∓−∜∀∎∝∍∑∍ ∍∌∑∈−∈−∍∨∑∍ ∂ ∖∂∓∈∑ ∑∠∝∐∈−∍∍ ∍ ∑∍∕∓∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∍. ∂ ∕∈∌∘∐∣∗∀∗∈ ∨ ∔∕∍∝∈∐ ∏ ∍−∗∈∕∈∖−∠∑ ∂∠∂∓∇∀∑, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∓∔∍∝∘ −∀ ∖∐∈∇∘∧∞∈∎ ∖∗∕∀−∍∛∈...

∆∐∘∃∓∏∀∨ ∔∓∇∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∀∨ ∕∀∃∓∗∀


∜∈∕∈∌ ∏∀∏∓∈-∗∓ ∂∕∈∑∨ ∗∕∀−∖∀ ∆∐∘∃∓∜∀∎∝∍∎ ∕∀∌∘∑ −∀∜∀∐ ∀−∀∐∍∌∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∂∖∧ ∑∓∧ ∋∍∌−∣. ∓− ∍∖∏∀∐ ∔∕∍∜∍−∘ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠√ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∎, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∐∍ −∀ ∔∕∓∗∨∋∈−∍∍ ∑−∓∆∍√ ∐∈∗ ∋∍∌−∍. ∀−∀∐∍∌ −∀∜∀∐ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗∣ ∖ ∗∓∆∓ ∑∓∑∈−∗∀, ∂ ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∨ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∑∓∆ ∖∈∃∨ ∂∖∔∓∑−∍∗∣. ∥∗∓ ∃∠∐∓ ∖∀∑∓∈ ∕∀−−∈∈ ∇∈∗∖∗∂∓. ∨ ∔∓∑−∧ ∖∈∃∨ ∖ ∖∀∑∓∆∓ ∕∓∋∇∈−∍∨ ∍ ∥∗∓ ∖∜∍∗∀∈∗∖∨ ∇∓∂∓∐∣−∓ ∕∈∇∏∍∑ ∨∂∐∈−∍∈∑. ∓∇−∀∏∓, ∥∗∓ ∔∓∑∓∆∐∓ ∑−∈ ∂ ∑∓∈∎ ∍∖∖∐∈∇∓∂∀−∍∍.




∏∀∏∍∈ ∂∠∂∓∇∠?


−∈∓∋∍∇∀−−∓ ∔∕∍∝∐∓ ∓∜∈−∣ ∜∈∗∏∓∈ ∓∖∓∌−∀−∍∈, ∜∗∓ ∂∖∈ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍ ∋∍∌−∍ ∖∓∌∇∀∐ ∨ ∖∀∑, ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∂∖∈ ∗∓∆∓ ∋∈ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∀ ∗∀∎−∓∎ ∖∍∐∠. ∂∖∈ ∥∗∍ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍ ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∘∋∈ −∀√∓∇∨∗∖∨ ∂−∘∗∕∍ ∑∈−∨ ∍ ∍∑∈∧∗ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∍∈ ∔∓∇∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∠∈ ∏∓∕−∍. ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗ ∂∖∈ ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∓, ∀ ∌∀∜∀∖∗∘∧ ∃∠∂∀∈∗ −∀∔∕∀∂∐∈−∓ ∔∕∓∗∍∂ ∑∈−∨ ∖∀∑∓∆∓, ∂∠∌∠∂∀∨ −∈∆∀∗∍∂−∠∈ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍ ∂ ∑∓∈∎ ∋∍∌−∍. ∂ ∑∓∑∈−∗ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∨ ∑∠ ∔∠∗∀∈∑∖∨ ∖∓∌−∀∗∈∐∣−∓ ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∓∂∀∗∣ ∥∗∓∗ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑, ∔∕∍∏∐∀∇∠∂∀∨ ∏ −∈∑∘ ∖∂∓∧ ∂∓∐∧ ∍ ∖∍∐∘ ∂∠∖∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨.




∏∀∏ ∑∠ ∘∔∕∀∂∐∨∈∑ −∀∝∈∎ ∖∘∇∣∃∓∎?


∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∜∍∗∀∎∗∈ ∓∜∈−∣ ∂−∍∑∀∗∈∐∣−∓! ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑ ∔∕∈∇∈∐∣−∓ ∔∕∓∖∗ ∍ ∂∏∐∧∜∀∈∗ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∗∕∍ ∏∓∑∔∓−∈−∗∀, ∓ ∏∓∗∓∕∠√ ∑∠ ∘∋∈ ∆∓∂∓∕∍∐∍ ∕∀−∈∈, ∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∕∀∖∖∑∓∗∕∍∑ ∥∗∓ ∃∓∐∈∈ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓.

∈∖∐∍ ∂∠ ∔∓∎∑∈∗∈ ∥∗∓∗ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑, ∂∠ ∖∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∖∀∑∓∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣−∓ ∗∂∓∕∍∗∣ ∖∂∓∧ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣, ∍∖∔∓∐−∨∨ ∐∧∃∠∈ ∋∈∐∀−∍∨ ∍ ∔∕∍∗∂∓∕∨∨ ∂ ∋∍∌−∣ ∖∂∓∍ ∖∀∑∠∈ ∖∑∈∐∠∈ ∌∀∑∠∖∐∠.

∕∀∌∇∈∐ 6


∖∍∐∀ ∑∠∖∐∍


√∀∕∀∏∗∈∕ ∍ ∐∍∜−∀∨ ∖∍∐∀ — ∂∓∗ ∈∇∍−∖∗∂∈−−∠∈ ∇∓∖∗∓∎−∠∈ ∔∕∍∓∃∕∈∗∈−∍∨. ∑∠∖∐∣ ∖∗∓∍∗ ∂−∀∜∀∐∈ ∂∖∈∆∓. ∂−∀∜∀∐∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∖∐∓∂∓. ∑∠∖∐∣ - ∥∗∓ ∓∖−∓∂∀ ∂∖∈∆∓. ∑∠∖∐∣ - ∥∗∓ ∖∈∑∨, ∍∌ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∆∓ ∔∕∓∕∀∖∗∀∈∗ ∇∈∕∈∂∓ ∓∃∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣∖∗∂!



∕∀∖∖∑∓∗∕∍∑ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖ ∃∓∐∈∈ ∔∓∇∕∓∃−∓


∜∈∐∓∂∈∏ ∖∓∌∇∀∈∗ ∖∘∇∣∃∘ ∖∂∓∍∑∍ ∑∠∖∐∨∑∍ ∍ ∔∓∖∗∘∔∏∀∑∍. ∓− ∑∓∋∈∗ ∍∌∑∈−∍∗∣ ∖∘∇∣∃∘. ∓− - √∓∌∨∍− ∖∘∇∣∃∠. ∂ ∥∗∓∑ −∈∗ ∖∓∑−∈−∍∎. ∔∕∀∂∍∐∣−∠∎ ∓∃∕∀∌ ∑∠∖∐∈∎ ∍ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∘∖∍∐∍∈ ∇∈∐∀∧∗ ∈∆∓ √∓∌∨∍−∓∑ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∖∘∇∣∃∠.



∓∔∍∖∀−∍∈ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∀


∂−∀∜∀∐∈ ∏ −∀∑ ∂ ∆∓∐∓∂∘ ∔∕∍√∓∇∍∗ −∈∏∀∨ ∑∠∖∐∣. ∓−∀ ∔∕∍√∓∇∍∗ ∓∜∈−∣ ∃∠∖∗∕∓ - ∑∍∑∓∐∈∗−∓, ∌∀∗∈∑ ∃∠∖∗∕∓ ∘√∓∇∍∗ ∍∌ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ (∓∗∏∘∇∀ ∃∈∕∈∗∖∨ ∥∗∀ ∑∠∖∐∣, ∑∠ −∈ ∕∀∖∖∑∀∗∕∍∂∀∈∑).



∂∖∔∓∑−∍∗∈ ∐∧∃∘∧ ∨∕∏∘∧ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∧ ∂ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∋∍∌−∍


−∀∂∈∕−∨∏∀ ∂−∀∜∀∐∈ ∃∠∐∀, ∏∀∏∀∨-∐∍∃∓ −∈∌−∀∜∍∗∈∐∣−∀∨ ∑∠∖∐∣ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∎ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍. ∥∗∀ ∑∠∖∐∣ ∑∓∆∐∀ ∌∀∕∓∇∍∗∣∖∨ ∖∔∓−∗∀−−∓ ∍∐∍ ∈∈ ∑∓∆∐∍ ∖∔∕∓∂∓∛∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∏∀∏∍∈-∗∓ ∂−∈∝−∍∈ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍.

∏∀∏∍∈-∗∓ ∙∕∀∌∠, ∔∕∓−∈∖∝∍∈∖∨ ∂ −∀∝∈∑ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∍, ∑∓∆∘∗ ∂ ∇∀∐∣−∈∎∝∈∑ ∂∠∌∠∂∀∗∣ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∈ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍. ∑∠∖∐∣ - ∥∗∓ ∂∍∃∕∀∛∍∨ ∥−∈∕∆∍∍, ∀ ∂∍∃∕∀∛∍∨ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∂∠∌∠∂∀∗∣ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∈ ∓∃∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣∖∗∂∀.

∍−∓∆∇∀, ∘ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∠√ ∐∧∇∈∎ ∃∠∂∀∈∗ ∔∓-∇∕∘∆∓∑∘, ∓− ∇∘∑∀∈∗ ∓∃ ∓∇−∓∎ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍, ∀ ∔∕∓∍∖√∓∇∍∗ ∔∕∨∑∓ ∔∕∓∗∍∂∓∔∓∐∓∋−∓∈ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∈. ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∧∗ ∕∀∌−∠∈ ∗∍∔∠ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨.

∂∀∑ ∍∌∂∈∖∗∈− ∂∀∝ ∗∍∔ ∑∠∝∐∈−∍∨. ∇∐∨ ∓∖∂∓∈−∍∨ ∗∈√−∍∏ ∔∖∍√∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∂∓∌∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∨ −∈∓∃√∓∇∍∑∓ ∓∗∐∀∋∍∂∀∗∣ ∖∂∓∎ ∖∓∃∖∗∂∈−−∠∎ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∂∠∨∂∍∗∣, ∍∖∖∐∈∇∘∨ ∋∍∌−∈−−∠∎ ∓∔∠∗ ∍ ∔∓∐∣∌∘∨∖∣ ∗∓∎ ∖√∈∑∓∎, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨ ∂∀∑ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∔∕∈∇∓∖∗∀∂∐∈−∀.

∕∀∃∓∜∀∨ ∖√∈∑∀


∗∀∏ ∋∈ ∏∀∏ ∔∐∓∇ ∕∓∋∇∀∈∗∖∨ ∍∌ ∖∈∑∈−∍, ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍ ∕∓∋∇∀∧∗∖∨ ∍∌ ∂∀∝∍√ ∑∠∖∐∈∎. ∔∓∌∍∗∍∂−∠∈ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∔∕∍∂∓∇∨∗ ∏ ∔∓∌∍∗∍∂−∠∑ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∨∑. −∈∆∀∗∍∂−∠∈ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∔∓∕∓∋∇∀∧∗ −∈∆∀∗∍∂−∠∈ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍.

∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∍ ∔∓∌∍∗∍∂−∠∈ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∑∓∆∘∗ ∂ ∔∓∖∐∈∇∖∗∂∍∍ ∔∕∍∂∓∇∍∗∣ ∏ −∈∆∀∗∍∂∘ ∍ −∈∆∀∗∍∂−∠∈ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∑∓∆∘ ∔∕∍∂∓∇∍∗∣ ∏ ∔∓∌∍∗∍∂∘, ∂∖∈ ∔∈∕∈∑∈∝∍∂∀∈∗∖∨ ∍ ∂∌∀∍∑∓∇∈∎∖∗∂∘∈∗, −∓ ∥∗∓ ∘∋∈ ∃∓∐∈∈ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∀∨ ∗∈∑∀ ∍ ∑∠ ∈∈ ∌∇∈∖∣ ∕∀∖∖∑∀∗∕∍∂∀∗∣ −∈ ∃∘∇∈∑. ∑∓∆∘ ∕∀∖∖∏∀∌∀∗∣ ∐∍∝∣ ∂ ∏∕∀∗∛∈ ∍ −∀ ∔∕∍∑∈∕∈.

«∇∓∔∘∖∗∍∑ ∂∠ ∇∘∑∀∈∗∈ ∓ ∔∐∓√∓∑, ∂ ∕∈∌∘∐∣∗∀∗∈ ∖∐∘∜∀∈∗∖∨ ∔∐∓√∓∈, ∀ ∂ ∕∈∌∘∐∣∗∀∗∈ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∔∐∓√∓∆∓ ∖∐∘∜∀∈∗∖∨ ∜∗∓ ∗∓ √∓∕∓∝∈∈. −∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∃∠ ∖∜∀∖∗∣∨, ∇∀ −∈∖∜∀∖∗∣∈ ∔∓∑∓∆∐∓. ∌−∀∈∗∈ ∗∀∏∓∈?». ∂∖∈ ∃∠∂∀∈∗, −∓ ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∑∠ ∆∓∂∓∕∍∑ ∓ ∖∓∂∈∕∝∈−−∓ ∇∕∘∆∓∑ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∈.



∏∀∏ ∔∕∓∕∀∖∗∀∈∗ ∖∈∑∨ ∑∠∖∐∍ ∍ ∖∐∘∜∀∧∗∖∨ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∨ ∋∍∌−∍?


∥∗∓ ∓∜∈−∣ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∔∓−∨∗∣. −∈∃∓∐∣∝∓∈ ∕∀∌∑∠∝∐∈−∍∈ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑ ∑∀∆∍∜∈∖∏∓∑ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∈ ∔∕∍∂∈∇∈∗ ∏ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓∑∘ ∔∓−∍∑∀−∍∧ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∀ ∖∓∌∇∀−∍∨ ∖∘∇∣∃∠ ∍ ∐∧∃∠√ ∓∃∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣∖∗∂ ∋∍∌−∍. ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∘∈∗∖∨ ∀∃∖∗∕∀∏∗−∠∎ −∈∆∀∗∍∂−∠∎ ∔∕∍∑∈∕ ∑∈√∀−∍∌∑∀ – ∇∐∨ ∐∘∜∝∈∆∓ ∔∓−∍∑∀−∍∨.

∕∀∌∇∈∐ 7


∥∗∀∔∠ ∍ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖ ∙∓∕∑∍∕∓∂∀−∍∨ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∎





∥∗∀∔ №1

(∂ ∆∓∐∓∂∘ ∔∕∍√∓∇∍∗ ∑∍∑∓∐∈∗−∀∨ ∑∠∖∐∣ ∓ ∜∈∑-∗∓, ∔∓∗∓∑ ∂∠ ∈∈ ∌∀∃∠∂∀∈∗∈).


∏∓∆∇∀-∗∓ −∈∏∗∓ ∏∘∔∍∐ ∖∈∃∈ ∓∜∈−∣ ∇∓∕∓∆∓∎🌀, −∓∂∠∎ −∓∘∗∃∘∏. ∂∓ ∂∕∈∑∨ ∔∓∏∘∔∏∍ ∘ −∈∆∓ ∂∓∌−∍∏∐∀ ∑∠∖∐∣:

«∓√, ∏∀∏∓∎ ∓− ∇∓∕∓∆∓∎, ∂∇∕∘∆ ∖∐∓∑∀∈∗∖∨, ∀ ∓∗ ∆∀∕∀−∗∍∍, ∏∀∏ ∂∖∈∆∇∀ −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∇∓∃∣∈∝∣∖∨, ∀ ∈∖∐∍ ∍ ∇∓∃∣∈∝∣∖∨, ∗∓ ∥∗∓ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∓∜∈−∣ ∍ ∓∜∈−∣ ∇∓∐∆∓».

∥∗∀ ∑∠∖∐∣ ∔∕∓∝∐∀ ∑∍∑∓∐∈∗∓∑ ∍ ∍∖∜∈∌∐∀ ∂ ∔∓∗∓∏∈ ∕∀∇∓∖∗∍ ∘∇∀∜−∓∆∓ ∔∕∍∓∃∕∈∗∈−∍∨.





∥∗∀∔ № 2

(∜∈∕∈∌ ∂∕∈∑∨ ∑∠∖∐∣ ∔∓∂∗∓∕∨∈∗∖∨, −∓ ∘∋∈ ∨∕∜∈ ∍ ∌∀∇∈∕∋∍∂∀∈∗∖∨ ∇∓∐∣∝∈).


∔∕∓∝∈∐ ∑∈∖∨∛. ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∐ √∓∕∓∝∓ ∍ ∃∠∖∗∕∓. ∂∇∕∘∆ ∔∕∓∍∌∓∝∐∀ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∨, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∓− ∜∘∗∣ −∈ ∘∕∓−∍∐ ∈∆∓. ∖∕∀∌∘ ∓− ∂∖∔∓∑−∍∐ ∑∠∖∐∣ ∓ ∔∓∐∓∑∏∈ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕∀, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨ ∔∕∍∝∐∀ ∏ −∈∑∘ ∂ ∑∀∆∀∌∍−∈. ∌∀∗∈∑ ∓− ∌∀∇∘∑∀∐∖∨ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑ ∘∋∈ ∆∐∘∃∋∈:

«∀ ∂∇∕∘∆ ∨ ∂∖∈ ∕∀∂−∓ ∘∕∓−∧ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕. ∀ ∂∇∕∘∆ ∓− ∖∐∓∑∀∈∗∖∨ ∍∐∍ ∂ −∈∆∓ ∔∓∔∀∇∈∗ ∂∍∕∘∖ ∍ ∔∕∍∇∈∗∖∨ ∔∈∕∈∘∖∗∀−∀∂∐∍∂∀∗∣ ∓∔∈∕∀∛∍∓−−∘∧ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∘. ∂∈∇∣ ∂∖∈ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ −∈∂∈∜−∓. ∌∀∗∈∑ ∂ ∇∂∈∕∣ ∏∂∀∕∗∍∕∠ ∔∓∌∂∓−∍∐∍, ∔∕∍∝∐∍ ∆∓∖∗∍, ∍ ∓− ∌∀∃∠∐ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∎ ∑∠∖∐∍».




∥∗∀∔ № 3

(∔∓∌∋∈ ∑∠∖∐∣ ∔∓∆∐∓∞∀∈∗ ∍ ∖∗∀−∓∂∍∗∖∨ ∍∇∈∈∎, ∂∓∌−∍∏∀∈∗ ∥∑∓∛∍∨).


∔∕∓∝∐∓ ∔∓∐∆∓∇∀ −∓∘∗∃∘∏ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∐ √∓∕∓∝∓. −∀ −∈∑ ∖∏∓∔∍∐∓∖∣ ∃∓∐∣∝∓∈ ∏∓∐∍∜∈∖∗∂∓ ∛∈−−∓∎ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∍. ∓∇−∀∋∇∠ ∈∑∘ ∔∕∍∝∐∀ ∑∠∖∐∣:

«∜∗∓ ∈∖∐∍ ∨ ∂∇∕∘∆ ∘∕∓−∧ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕ ∍∐∍ ∔∓∎∑∀∧ ∂∍∕∘∖, ∗∓ ∨ ∑∓∆∘ ∔∓∗∈∕∨∗∣ ∂∖∈ ∖∂∓∍ ∇∀−−∠∈. ∖∗∕∀√ ∂∇∕∘∆ ∓∂∐∀∇∈∐ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∓∑, ∓− −∀∜∀∐ ∍∖∔∠∗∠∂∀∗∣ ∖∍∐∣−∠∎ ∖∗∕∀√ ∍ ∖∕∀∌∘ ∋∈ ∔∓∝∈∐ ∂ ∏∓∑∔∣∧∗∈∕−∠∎ ∑∀∆∀∌∍−, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∏∘∔∍∗∣ ∖∈∃∈ ∖∟∈∑−∠∎ ∋∈∖∗∏∍∎ ∇∍∖∏. ∓− ∏∘∔∍∐ ∇∍∖∏ ∍ ∔∈∕∈∏∍−∘∐ ∗∘∇∀ ∂∖∧ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∧ (∑∠∖∐∣ ∔∓∕∓∋∇∀∈∗ ∥∑∓∛∍∧, ∌∀ ∥∑∓∛∍∈∎ ∖∐∈∇∘∈∗ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∈)».

∓− ∔∕∓∇∓∐∋∀∐ ∇∘∑∀∗∣ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑ ∈∞∈ −∈∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∂∕∈∑∨, ∌∀∗∈∑, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∍−∙∓∕∑∀∛∍∨ ∃∠∐∀ ∔∈∕∈∏∍−∘∗∀, ∓− ∖∗∀∐ ∖∔∓∏∓∎−∈∈ ∍ ∖−∓∂∀ ∌∀∃∠∐ ∓∃ ∥∗∓∑.

∙∀∎∐ ∑∓∍_∇∓∖∗∍∋∈−∍∨.κτοξ ∗∈∔∈∕∣ ∂ −∀∝∈∎ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∈! √∓∜∈∝∣ ∨ ∔∓∏∀∋∘ ∗∈∃∈ ∈∆∓ ∗∓∜−∓∈ ∖∓∇∈∕∋∍∑∓∈ ∍∐∍ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∌∀∔∍∝∈∑ ∜∗∓-∗∓ ∈∞∉? 🔮

∃∕∀∗∈∛,−∘∋−∠ ∂∖∈ ∗∀∏∍ ∃∓∗∠! ∏∀∏ ∑∠ ∔∓∖∗∘∔∍∑?∂∏∐∧∜∍∑ ∃∓∗∓∂?∍ ∔∓∔∕∓∃∘∈∑ ∌∀∔∍∖∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ −∍√! ∂ ∏∓∇∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∌∀∔∍∝∈∑ .∜∗∓ −∘∋−∓ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂!∨ ∇∘∑∀∧ ∥∗∓ ∖∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∗ ∃∕∀∗∍∝∏∀!∔∕∓∃∘∈∑? ∖∓∌∇∀∎ ∏∓∇ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ !∌∀∔∍∝∍ ∗∀∏ ∋∈ ∂ −∈∑ ∖∗∕∘∏∗∘∕∠ ∏∓∇∀ ∃∓∗∓∂,∜∗∓∃ ∗∠ ∔∓∑−∍∐ ∏∀∏ ∓−∍ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∧∗!∍ −∀∔∍∝∍ ∜∗∓ ∂ ∔∈∕∂∘∧ ∓∜∈∕∈∇∣ −∘∋−∓ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂!
∑∠ ∖−∓∂∀ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∓∂∀∗∣ ∃∓∗∓∂, −∓ ∗∈∔∈∕∣ ∂ ∏∓∇∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∑∠ ∨∂−∓ ∘∏∀∋∈∑, ∜∗∓ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∑ ∜∈∕∈∌ −∍√.
∂∏∐∧∜∍∑ ∏∓∇ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∂ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∘ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨, −∓ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∂∠∌∠∂∀∗∣ ∍√ ∏∀∏ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∠∈ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍, ∜∗∓∃∠ −∈ ∃∐∓∏∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∔∀∑∨∗∣.
∓∇−∀∏∓, ∈∖∐∍ ∃∕∀∗∈∛ √∓∜∈∗, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∃∓∗∠ ∃∠∐∍ ∀∏∗∍∂−∠ ∍ ∑∠ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∐∍ ∜∈∕∈∌ −∍√, ∗∓ ∑∠ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∖∓∌∇∀∗∣ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∘, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨
∔∕∍ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∍ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∈∗ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∂ ∙∓−∓∂∓∑ ∕∈∋∍∑∈ ∍∐∍ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∍∑∈∈∗ ∍√ ∏∓∇ ∔∓∇ ∕∘∏∓∎ ∇∐∨ ∂∠∌∓∂∀.

−∓ ∘∜∗∈∑, ∜∗∓ ∕∀−∈∈ ∑∠ ∂∖∗∕∓∍∐∍ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∂ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∘, −∓ ∗∈∔∈∕∣ ∃∕∀∗∈∛ √∓∜∈∗ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∗∣ ∍∑∈−−∓ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂.

∔∕∈∇∐∀∆∀∧ ∏∓∑∔∕∓∑∍∖∖: ∑∠ ∖∓∌∇∀∇∍∑ ∏∓∇ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∖∓∇∈∕∋∍∗ ∏∓∇ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∍ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∍√ ∂∠∌∠∂∀∗∣ ∔∕∍ −∈∓∃√∓∇∍∑∓∖∗∍.
∔∕∍ ∥∗∓∑ ∑∠ −∈ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∗∣ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∖∕∀∌∘ ∔∕∍ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∍, ∀ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∏∓∆∇∀ −∘∋−∓.

∓∇−∀∏∓, ∈∖∐∍ ∔∕∓∃∐∈∑∀ ∂ ∃∐∓∏∍∕∓∂∏∈ ∔∀∑∨∗∍, ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓, ∑∠ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∗∣ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∂ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∠√ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∀√? −∓ ∥∗∓ ∖∐∓∋−∓.

∇∕∘∆∓∎ ∂∀∕∍∀−∗: ∑∠ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ √∕∀−∍∑ ∏∓∇ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∂ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∍ ∂∠∌∠∂∀∈∑ ∍√ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍, ∏∓∆∇∀ −∘∋−∓, ∃∈∌ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∓∆∓ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∀.

−∓ ∕∀∌ ∃∕∀∗∈∛ √∓∜∈∗ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂, ∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∖∓∌∇∀∇∍∑ ∏∓∇ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∔∕∍ ∂∠∌∓∂∈ ∓∔∕∈∇∈∐∈−−∠√ ∏∓∑∀−∇
∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∈∗ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∏∀∏ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∠∈ ∖∏∕∍∔∗∠ (∜∈∕∈∌ ∏∓∑∀⚡−∇−∘∧ ∖∗∕∓∏∘) ∍∐∍ ∏∀∏ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍.

∔∓∖∏∓∐∣∏∘ ∑∠ ∘∋∈ ∍∑∈∈∑ ∂∖∗∕∓∈−−∠∈ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍, ∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∔∈∕∈∍∑∈−∘∈∑ ∍√ ∂ ∏∓∇∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∓−∍ −∀∌∠∂∀∐∍∖∣ ∏∀∏ ∃∓∗∠,
∍ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∖∜∍∗∀∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∥∗∓ ∍ ∈∖∗∣ ∃∓∗∠, ∂∖∗∕∓∈−−∠∈ ∂ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∘.

−∓ ∈∖∐∍ −∘∋−∓ ∍∑∈−−∓ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∗∣ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∠∈ ∖∏∕∍∔∗∠, ∗∓ ∑∠ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∥∗∓ ∇∈∐∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ οτ.τςτυεν ∍∐∍ τφβπσογεττ.

∇∀∂∀∎ ∖∇∈∐∀∈∑ ∗∀∏: ∂ ∏∓∇∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∑∠ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∍∑∈∗∣ ∇∂∀ ∕∈∋∍∑∀:

∂∖∗∕∓∈−−∠∈ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍ (∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∘∋∈ ∈∖∗∣)

∌∀∔∘∖∏ ∂−∈∝−∍√ ∃∓∗∓∂ (∓∗∇∈∐∣−∠∈ ∖∏∕∍∔∗∠)

∍ ∃∕∀∗∈∛ ∖∑∓∋∈∗ ∂∠∃∕∀∗∣, ∏∀∏∓∎ ∖∔∓∖∓∃ ∍∖∔∓∐∣∌∓∂∀∗∣.

∓∇−∀∏∓, ∈∖∐∍ ∔∕∓∃∐∈∑∀ ∖ ∃∐∓∏∍∕∓∂∏∓∎ ∔∀∑∨∗∍ ∔∕∍ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∈ ∃∓∗∓∂, ∗∓, ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓, ∌∀∔∘∖∏ ∜∈∕∈∌ τφβπσογεττ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∃∠∗∣ ∕∈∝∈−∍∈∑.

−∓ ∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∖−∀∜∀∐∀ ∔∓∔∕∓∃∘∈∑ ∌∀∔∍∖∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂, ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∨ ∍√ ∏∀∏ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∠∈ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∠.

∨ ∔∕∈∇∐∀∆∀∧ ∖∓∌∇∀∗∣ ∂ ∏∓∇∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∏∐∀∖∖, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∘∑∈∈∗ ∌∀∔∘∖∏∀∗∣ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∏∀∏ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∠∈ ∔∕∓∛∈∖∖∠ ∍ ∏∀∏ ∂∖∗∕∓∈−−∠∈ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍.

−∓ ∜∗∓∃∠ −∈ ∘∖∐∓∋−∨∗∣, ∇∀∂∀∎∗∈ ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∂∏∐∧∜∍∑ ∏∓∇ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∂ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∘ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∍ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∂∠∌∠∂∀∗∣ ∍√ ∏∀∏ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍, −∓ ∔∕∍ ∥∗∓∑
∂ ∏∓∇∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨ ∨∂−∓ −∀∔∍∝∈∑, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∑ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂.

∖∓∌∇∀∇∍∑ −∓∂∠∎ ∏∐∀∖∖ ∇∐∨ ∃∓∗∓∂ ∂ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∈ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨.

∃∕∀∗, ∨ ∖∓∌∇∀∑ ∏∓∇ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∎ ∖∓∇∈∕∋∍∗:

∏∓∇ ∃∓∗∀-∔∍∖∀∗∈∐∨ (∏∀∏ ∙∘−∏∛∍∧)

∏∓∇ ∃∓∗∀-∔∓∍∖∏∓∂∍∏∀ (∏∀∏ ∙∘−∏∛∍∧)

∨∂−∓∈ ∘∏∀∌∀−∍∈, ∜∗∓ ∂ ∔∈∕∂∘∧ ∓∜∈∕∈∇∣ −∘∋−∓ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂

∍ ∔∕∍ ∥∗∓∑ ∑∠ ∖∓√∕∀−∍∑ ∂∖∗∕∓∈−−∠∈ ∙∘−∏∛∍∍, −∓ ∔∈∕∈∍∑∈−∘∈∑ ∍√ ∂ ∖∗∍∐∈ ∃∓∗∓∂.

μευ'τ δο ιυ!

∃∕∀∗∈∛! ∓∗∐∍∜−∀∨ ∍∇∈∨! ∇∀∂∀∎ ∖∓∌∇∀∇∍∑ ∘∑−∘∧ ∖∍∖∗∈∑∘ ∔∕∓∃∘∋∇∈−∍∨, ∏∓∗∓∕∀∨ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∗∣ ∜∈∕∈∌ ∃∓∗∓∂, −∓ ∃∈∌ ∃∐∓∏∍∕∓∂∏∍ ∔∀∑∨∗∍! 🚀

        function toggleView() {
            const content = document.getElementById('alienContent');
            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');
            
            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                alert('Переключено в "человеческий" вид (для теста)');
            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }

        function toggleView() {
            const content = document.getElementById('alienContent');
            const isAlien = content.classList.contains('alien-view');
            
            if (isAlien) {
                content.classList.remove('alien-view');
                content.classList.add('human-view');
                content.style.color = '#ffffff';
                content.style.fontFamily = 'Arial, sans-serif';
                alert('Переключено в "человеческий" вид (для теста)');
            } else {
                content.classList.remove('human-view');
                content.classList.add('alien-view');
                content.style.color = '#00ff00';
                content.style.fontFamily = "'Courier New', monospace";
                alert('Переключено в "инопланетный" вид');
            }
        }
        
        // Авто-прокрутка при загрузке (показывает что контент длинный)
        window.addEventListener('load', function() {
            setTimeout(function() {
                document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 100;
                setTimeout(function() {
                    document.getElementById('alienContent').scrollTop = 0;
                }, 500);
            }, 1000);
        });

∔∓∖∐∈ ∥∗∓∆∓, ∔∓∔∕∓∃∘∎∗∈ ∂∠∔∓∐−∍∗∣ ∇∕∘∆∓∈ ∘∔∕∀∋−∈−∍∈. ∔∓∔∕∓∃∘∎∗∈ ∇∘∑∀∗∣ ∓ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∖∘∇∣∃∈, ∏∀∏ ∓ −∈∘∇∀∜−∓∎ ∛∈∔∍ ∓∃∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣∖∗∂ ∍∐∍, ∏∀∏ ∓ ∌∐∓∑ ∕∓∏∈. −∀∎∇∍∗∈ ∙∀∏∗∠ ∍∌ ∋∍∌−∍, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∃∘∇∘∗ ∔∓∇∗∂∈∕∋∇∀∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∂∀∝∀ ∋∍∌−∣ −∈ ∘∇∀∐∀∖∣ ∍ ∔∕∓∝∐∀ ∌∕∨, ∔∕∍−∈∖∨ −∈∑∀∐∓ ∃∈∇ ∍ ∔∈∜∀∐∣−∓∆∓ ∓∔∠∗∀. ∔∓∆∕∘∖∗∍∗∈ −∈∑−∓∆∓ −∀ ∥∗∘ ∗∈∑∘.

∔∓∖∐∈ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∔∓∔∕∓∃∘∎∗∈ ∘∖∍∐∍∨∑∍ ∂∀∝∈∎ ∂∓∐∍ ∍ ∕∀∌∘∑∀ ∍∌∑∈−∍∗∣ ∗∓∜∏∘ ∌∕∈−∍∨ −∀ ∔∕∨∑∓ ∔∕∓∗∍∂∓∔∓∐∓∋−∘∧. −∀∎∇∍∗∈ ∂ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∖∘∇∣∃∈ ∙∀∏∗∠ ∔∓∇∗∂∈∕∋∇∀∧∞∍∈, ∜∗∓ ∂∀∝∀ ∖∘∇∣∃∀ ∓∜∈−∣ ∘∇∀∜−∀, ∀ ∂∠ ∈∈ ∖∀∑∠∎ ∖∜∀∖∗∐∍∂∠∎ ∃∀∐∓∂∈−∣.
−∀∎∇∍∗∈ ∔∕∍∑∈∕∠ ∍∌ ∂∀∝∈∎ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∎ ∋∍∌−∍, ∏∓∆∇∀ ∖∘∇∣∃∀ ∂∀∑ ∃∘∏∂∀∐∣−∓ ∃∐∀∆∓∂∓∐∍∐∀ ∍ ∖∔∀∖∀∐∀ ∓∗ ∘∋∀∖∀∧∞∍√ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∎.

∥∗∍ ∔∕∍∑∈∕∠ ∔∓∏∀∌∠∂∀∧∗ −∀∑, ∜∗∓ ∂∖∈ ∓∃∟∈∏∗∠ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∑∍∕∈, ∏∀∏ ∍ ∑∠ ∖∀∑∍ ∍∑∈∧∗ ∃∈∖∜∍∖∐∈−−∓∈ ∏∓∐∍∜∈∖🔮∗∂∓ ∆∕∀−∈∎. ∂∖∈ ∌∀∂∍∖∍∗ ∓∗ ∗∓∆∓, ∔∓∇ ∏∀∏∍∑ ∘∆∐∓∑ ∌∕∈−∍∨ ∑∠ ∖∑∓∗∕∍∑ −∀ ∏∓−∏∕∈∗−∓∆∓ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀, ∂∈∞∣ ∍∐∍ ∓∃∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣∖∗∂∓. −∀∝∀ ∂−∘∗∕∈−−∨∨ ∖∂∓∃∓∇∀ ∓∃∘∖∐∓∂∐∈−∀ ∍∑∈−−∓ −∀∝∍∑ ∂∠∃∓∕∓∑ ∖∓∓∗∂∈∗∖∗∂∘∧∞∈∎ ∍−∗∈∕∔∕∈∗∀∛∍∍. ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∗∕∈−∍∕∓∂∀∗∣∖∨, ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∑ ∓∃∕∀∌∓∑ ∍−∗∈∕∔∕∈∗∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∐∧∇∈∎, ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∍ ∍ ∂∖∈, ∜∗∓ ∘∆∓∇−∓ ∍ ∘∃∈∇∍∗∈∖∣ ∂ ∗∓∑, ∜∗∓ ∥∗∓ ∕∀∃∓∗∀∈∗ −∀ ∂∖∈ 100%.

∓∗ −∀∝∈∎ ∍−∗∈∕∔∕∈∗∀∛∍∍ ∌∀∂∍∖∍∗ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∂∍∇∍∑ ∍ ∂∓∖∔∕∍−∍∑∀∈∑. ∓∇−∓ ∍ ∗∓ ∋∈ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∈ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∃∠∗∣ ∕∀∖∛∈−∈−∓ −∀∑∍ ∏∀∏ ∃∓∐∣∝∀∨ ∘∇∀∜∀ ∍ ∘∕∓∏ ∂∖∈∐∈−−∓∎, ∐∍∃∓ ∏∀∏ ∂∈∐∍∏∓∈ ∌∐∓ ∍ −∀∏∀∌∀−∍∈. ∍∑∈−−∓ ∓∗ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∌∀∂∍∖∍∗ ∗∓, ∏∀∏ ∥∗∀ ∖∍∗∘∀∛∍∨ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∕∀∌∂∍∂∀∗∣∖∨ ∇∀∐∣∝∈, ∔∓∗∓∑∘ ∏∀∏ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∗∓∜∏∓∎ ∌∕∈−∍∨ ∂∠ ∂∠∃∍∕∀∈∗∈ ∇∀∐∣−∈∎∝∍∎ ∖∛∈−∀∕∍∎ ∍ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂∘.
∓∜∈∂∍∇−∠∈ ∔∕∈∍∑∘∞∈∖∗∂∀ «∗∀∎−∠ ∗∀∎−»!

∌∇∈∖∣ ∂∖∈ ∌∀∂∍∖∍∗ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∓∗ ∂∀∖. ∔∕∀∏∗∍∏∀ ∘∇∓∂∐∈∗∂∓∕∨∈∗

∔∓∗∕∈∃−∓∖∗∍ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍. −∈ ∗∕∈∃∘∈∗ ∓∗∇∈∐∣−∓∆∓ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍

∌∀∜∈∑ ∗∓∆∇∀ −∘∋−∠ ∇∕∘∆∍∈ ∘∜∈−∍∨ ∍ ∖∏∍∗∀−∍∨?

∥∗∓ ∌−∀−∍∈ - ∗∀∎−∓∈ ∘∜∈−∍∈, ∏∓∗∓∕∓∈ ∓∗∏∕∠∗∓ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∐∘∜∝∍∑ ∍∌ ∐∧∇∈∎. ∗∀∎−∀ ∗∀∎− – ∛∀∕∣ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∑∍∖∗∍∜∈∖∏∓∆∓ ∌−∀−∍∨!

∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∃∈∖∜∍∖∐∈−−∓∈ ∑−∓∋∈∖∗∂∓ ∋∈∐∀−∍∎ ∍ ∖∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∋∈ ∖∔∓∖∓∃∓∂ ∍∖∔∓∐−∍∗∣ ∍√. ∂ ∕∀∌−∠√ ∘∜∈−∍∨√ ∍ ∕∈∐∍∆∍∓∌−∠√ ∏∘∐∣∗∀√ ∇∀∧∗∖∨ ∕∀∌∐∍∜−∠∈ ∖∓∂∈∗∠. ∓∗ ∥∗∓∆∓ ∕∀∌−∓∓∃∕∀∌∍∨ ∑∓∆∘∗ ∕∀∌∃∈∆∀∗∣∖∨ ∆∐∀∌∀ ∍ ∘∖∗∀∂∀∗∣ ∖∈∕∇∛∈. ∗∈∔∈∕∣ ∗∀∎−∀ ∗∀∎− ∔∕∍∝∐∀ ∂ ∂∀∝∘ ∋∍∌−∣, ∍ ∂∀∝∍ ∖∏∍∗∀−∍∨ ∌∀∏∓−∜∈−∠.

∌∀∜∈∑ ∗∠∖∨∜∍ ∖∔∓∖∓∃∓∂, ∈∖∐∍ ∈∖∗∣ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∓∇∍−, ∖ ∔∓∑∓∞∣∧ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∆∓ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∇∓∖∗∍∜∣ ∂∖∈∆∓?

∂∈∕−∈∑∖∨ ∏ −∀∝∈∑∘ ∕∀∌∑∠∝∐∈−∍∧. ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ∂−∘∗∕∍ −∀∖ ∍ ∑∍∕ ∂∓∏∕∘∆ −∀∖ – ∃∓∐∣∝∈ −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗. ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ∥∗∓ −∀∝∈ «∨ » ∍ ∓∗∕∍∛∀∗∣ ∑∠ ∈∆∓ −∍∏∀∏ −∈ ∑∓∋∈∑. ∔∕∍∕∓∇∀ ∑∍∕∀ −∀∔∕∓∗∍∂ , ∑∓∋∈∗ ∌∀∂∍∖∈∗∣ ∓∗ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∨ ∍ ∘∆∐∀ ∌∕∈−∍∨. ∑∠ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∘∃∈∇∍∐∍∖∣ ∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∍∌ ∔∕∈∇∠∇∘∞∍√ ∌∀∇∀−∍∎.

−∀∃∐∧∇∈−∍∨ ∔∓∏∀∌∀∐∍, ∜∗∓ ∓∗ −∀∝∈∎ ∗∓∜∏∍ ∌∕∈−∍∨ ∍ ∍−∗∈∕∔∕∈∗∀∛∍∍ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∍, ∐∧∇∈∎ ∍ ∖∓∃∠∗∍∎ ∌∀∂∍∖∍∗, ∗∓ ∏∀∏∓∎ ∖∗∓∕∓−∓∎ ∓−∍ ∏ −∀∑ ∔∓∂∈∕−∘∗∖∨.

−∀∝∈ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈ ∍ ∖∔∓∖∓∃−∓∖∗∣ ∏ ∓∖∓∌−∀−−∓∎ ∍−∗∈∕∔∕∈∗∀∛∍∍ ∈∖∗∣ ∏∐∧∜ ∏ ∘∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∧ ∂−∈∝−∈∎ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∣∧!

∏∕∓∑∈ ∖∈∃∨ ∍ ∖∂∓∈∆∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∨ ∂∈∞∈∎ ∑∠ −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∌−∀∈∑!

∔∓∥∗∓∑∘ ∍∌∑∈−∍∗∣ ∑∠ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∖∈∃∨ ∍ ∖∂∓∈ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∈.







∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍
∈∖∗∣ ∈∞∈ ∔∓∖∐∈∇−∨∨ ∏∀∗∈∆∓∕∍∨, ∏∓∗∓∕∘∧ ∑∠ −∈ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∓∗∕∍∛∀∗∣. ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣. ∓−∀ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗, ∂ ∥∗∓∑ −∈∗ ∖∓∑−∈−∍∨. ∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍ −∈∐∣∌∨ ∖∔∓∕∍∗∣. ∓−∀ ∂−∘∗∕∍ −∀∖. ∈∖∐∍ ∌∀∆∐∨−∘∗∣ ∆∐∘∃∓∏∓ ∂−∘∗∕∣ ∖∈∃∨, ∗∓ ∖∗∓∐∏−∈∝∣∖∨ ∖ ∃∈∖∔∕∈∇∈∐∣−∓∖∗∣∧. ∈∖∐∍ ∍∇∗∍ ∂∓∂−∈ ∖∈∃∨ ∂ ∏∓∖∑∓∖, −∀∎∇∈∝∣ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣. −∈∐∣∌∨ ∓∆∕∀−∍∜∍∗∣ ∑∍∕∓∂∓∈ ∔∕∓∖∗∕∀−∖∗∂∓. ∘ −∈∆∓ −∈ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∃∠∗∣ ∏∓−∛∀. ∇∀∋∈ ∈∖∐∍ ∈∖∗∣ ∆∕∀−∍∛∀ ∍∐∍ ∏∓−∈∛, ∗∓ ∌∀ ∥∗∓∎ ∆∕∀−∍∛∈∎ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∇∓∐∋−∓ ∜∗∓-∗∓ ∃∠∗∣. ∍ ∥∗∓ −∈∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∃∘∇∈∗ ∔∕∓∇∓∐∋∀∗∣ ∔∕∓∗∨∋∈−−∓∖∗∣ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍. ∓−∓ ∍ ∂−∘∗∕∍ ∍ ∖−∀∕∘∋∍. ∖−∍∌∘ ∍ ∖∂∈∕√∘ ∍ ∔∕∓∖∗∍∕∀∈∗∖∨ ∂∓ ∂∖∈√ −∀∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∨√. ∓−∓ ∂∈∌∇∈. ∓−∓ ∂∖∈! −∈∔∓∖∗∍∋∍∑∓∈, ∂∈∜−∓∈, ∃∈∖∔∕∈∇∈∐∣−∓∈. ∓−∓ ∈∖∗∣ ∛∈∐∣ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∔∓∌−∀−∍∨, ∍ ∓−∓ ∈∖∗∣ ∔∘∗∣ ∍ ∖∘∗∣ ∔∓∌−∀−∍∨. ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗.




∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣?

∔∓∌∂∓∐∣∗∈ ∕∀∖∝∍∕∍∗∣ ∔∓−∍∑∀−∍∈ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍. ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣ - ∥∗∓ −∍∜∗∓ ∍ ∂∖∈ ∓∇−∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∓. ∥∗∓ ∂∠∖∝∀∨ ∐∓∆∍∏∀, ∑∀∗∈∑∀∗∍∏∀ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∠√ ∂∈∐∍∜∍−…

∑∠ −∈ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∓∗∕∍∛∀∗∣ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∓∂∀−∍∨ −∍∜∗∓ ∍∐∍ ∔∘∖∗∓∗∠. ∇∀∋∈ ∈∖∐∍ −∀∝∈ ∨ ∍∖∜∈∌−∈∗, ∍ ∑∍∕ ∍∖∜∈∌−∈∗, ∜∗∓ ∓∖∗∀−∈∗∖∨? −∍∜∗∓. −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∓∖∗∀−∈∗∖∨. ∍∐∍ ∓∖∗∀−∈∗∖∨ −∍∜∗∓. ∥∗∓ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∓! −∈∓∔∕∓∂∈∕∋∍∑∓.

∂∖∈ ∑∓∋−∓ ∓∔∕∓∂∈∕∆−∘∗∣. −∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ −∍∜∗∓ −∈ ∓∔∕∓∂∈∕∆−∈∝∣ . ∥∗∓ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∀∨ ∂∈∐∍∜∍−∀. −∍∜∗∓∋−∓ ∑∀∐∀∨ ∍ ∃∈∌∆∕∀−∍∜−∓ ∂∈∐∍∏∀∨ ∓∇−∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∓. ∛∈∐∣ ∍ ∖∕∈∇∖∗∂∓! ∑∠ ∂∖∈ ∓∗∗∘∇∀ ∔∕∍∝∐∍ ∍ ∂∈∕−∈∑∖∨ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∗∘∇∀. −∈∗ ∇∕∘∆∓∆∓ ∔∘∗∍, ∂∖∈ ∓∖∗∀∐∣−∓∈ ∂∕∈∑∈−−∀∨ ∍∐∐∧∌∍∨!
























∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ «−∍∜∗∓»?


∥∗∓ ∔∓∇∓∃−∓ ∖−∘ ∃∈∌ ∖−∓∂∍∇∈−∍∎. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∂∠ ∌∀∖∠∔∀∈∗∈ ∍ ∍∖∜∈∌∀∈∗∈. ∂∀∖ ∃∓∐∣∝∈ −∈∗. −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈∗. −∈∗ ∇∀∋∈ ∔∘∖∗∓∗∠. ∏∓∆∇∀ ∂∠ ∔∕∓∖∠∔∀∈∗∈∖∣, ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∂∖∔∓∑−∍∗∣ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ −∍∜∈∆∓ −∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∍ ∂∖∈…

∗∀∑ −∈∗ ∔∕∓∖∗∕∀−∖∗∂∀, −∈∗ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍, −∈∗ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨, −∈∗ ∨, −∈∗ ∛∂∈∗∀, −∈∗ ∖∂∈∗∀, −∈∗ ∗∣∑∠, −∈∗ ∑∍∕∀, −∈∗ ∌∀∔∀√∀, −∈∗ ∂∏∘∖∀, −∈∗ ∓∖∨∌∀−∍∨, −∈∗ ∌∂∘∏∀, −∈∗ ∗∍∝∍−∠, −∈∗ −∍∏∀∏∓∆∓ ∂∏∘∖∀, −∈∗ −∍∜∈∆∓. ∂∀∑ ∥∗∓ ∌−∀∏∓∑∓, ∨ ∌−∀∧. −∈ ∔∠∗∀∎∗∈∖∣ ∔∓−∨∗∣ ∕∀∌∘∑∓∑, ∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∂∖∔∓∑−∍∗∈ ∖∓− ∃∈∌ ∖−∓∂∍∇∈−∍∎ ∍ ∂∖∈ ∔∓∎∑∈∗∈.


∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ «∂∖∈»?

∂∖∈ ∥∗∓ ∂∖∈. ∥∗∓ ∂∓∓∃∞∈ ∂∖∈, ∜∗∓ ∈∖∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∃∠∐∓ ∍ ∜∗∓ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∃∘∇∈∗ . ∀ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∑∓∆∐∓ ∃∠ ∃∠∗∣. ∍ ∗∓, ∜∈∆∓ ∃∠∗∣ −∍∏∀∏ −∈ ∑∓∆∐∓. ∂∈∖∈∐∓ ∔∓∐∘∜∀∈∗∖∨, ∔∕∀∂∇∀? −∓ ∂ ∔∕∓∗∍∂−∓∑ ∖∐∘∜∀∈ ∥∗∓ ∃∠∐∓ ∃∠ ∇∀∐∈∏∓ −∈ ∂∖∈! ∂∖∈ ∂∓ ∂∖∈∑, ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∓∇−∓∂∕∈∑∈−−∓ ∍ ∖∓∃∕∀−∓ ∂ ∓∇−∓∎ ∗∓∜∏∈. ∂∕∈∑∨ ∍ ∔∕∓∖∗∕∀−∖∗∂∓ – ∍∐∐∧∌∍∨ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∨ . −∀∝∈ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ −∀∏∐∀∇∠∂∀∈∗ −∀ ∂∈∞∍ ∥∙∙∈∏∗ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍ ∍ ∔∕∓∖∗∕∀−∖∗∂∀. ∥∗∓ ∇∓∏∀∌∀−−∠∎ −∀∘∜−∠∎ ∙∀∏∗, ∍ ∑∠ −∈ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∂∇∀∂∀∗∣∖∨ ∂ ∍∌∐∍∝−∍∈ ∕∀∌∑∠∝∐∈−∍∨ −∀ ∥∗∘ ∗∈∑∘, ∇∀∃∠ ∃∠∖∗∕∈∈ ∇∓∃∕∀∗∣∖∨ ∇∓ ∖∀∑∓∎ ∗∀∎−∠.




∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠∈ ∑∍∕∠?

∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠∈ ∑∍∕∠ ∍∐∍ ∑∍∕∠ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠√ ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓∖∗∈∎ - ∥∗∓ ∗∈ ∔∀∕∀∐∐∈∐∣−∠∈ −∀∑ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∍ , ∆∇∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗ ∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∑∓∆∐∓ ∃∠ ∃∠∗∣, −∓ ∜∈∆∓ −∈∗ ∂ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈. ∂∖∈ ∥∗∓ ∑∀∗∕∍∛∀, ∆∇∈ ∘∋∈ ∈∖∗∣ ∂∖∈ ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∓∖∗∍, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∑∓∆∐∍ ∃∠ ∖∐∘∜∍∗∣∖∨. ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠∈ ∑∍∕∠ ∑∓∆∘∗ ∃∠∗∣ ∂ ∗∓∜−∓∖∗∍ ∔∓√∓∋∍ −∀ ∑∍∕, ∂ ∏∓∗∓∕∓∑ ∑∠ ∋∍∂∈∑, ∀ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∍ ∔∓∐−∓∖∗∣∧ ∓∗∐∍∜∀∗∣∖∨ ∓∗ −∈∆∓.
∇∐∨ −∀∆∐∨∇−∓∆∓ ∔∕∍∑∈∕∀ ∓∔∍∝∘ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∂∀∕∍∀−∗∓∂ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠√ ∑∍∕∓∂:

∂ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈, ∂∠ ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∖∍∇∍∗∈ ∍ ∜∍∗∀∈∗∈ ∥∗∓∗ ∗∈∏∖∗ , −∓ ∂ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠√ ∑∍∕∀√, ∈∖∐∍ ∃∠ ∔∓-∇∕∘∆∓∑∘ ∖∐∓∋∍∐∍∖∣ ∓∃∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣∖∗∂∀, ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∔∕∨∑∓ ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∍∇∗∍ ∔∓ ∘∐∍∛∈ ∍∐∍ ∖∍∇∈∗∣ ∂ ∏∍−∓∗∈∀∗∕∈ ∔∕∓∖∑∀∗∕∍∂∀∗∣ ∙∍∐∣∑.

∍∐∍ ∇∓∔∘∖∗∍∑, ∂∠ ∌∀∑∘∋∈∑ ∍∐∍ ∋∈−∀∗∠ −∀ ∓∇−∓∑ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∈, ∀ ∂ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∋∍∗∣ ∖ ∇∕∘∆∍∑ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∓∑.

∥∗∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∃∠∗∣ ∃∓∆∀∗∠∑, ∀ ∂ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∃∠∗∣ ∃∓∑∋∈∑.

∕∈∀∐∣−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∍∑∈∗∣ ∀∂∗∓∑∓∃∍∐∣, ∀ ∂ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ ∂∠ ∑∓∋∈∗∈ ∍∑∈∗∣ ∑∓∗∓∛∍∏∐.

∔∕∓∖∗∓ ∔∓∎∑∍∗∈, ∓ ∜∈∑ ∍∇∈∗ ∕∈∜∣. ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠√ ∑∍∕∓∂ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∑−∓∋∈∖∗∂∓, ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∓∈ ∃∠∗∍∈ ∍∐∍ −∍∜∗∓, ∘∋∈ ∂∏∐∧∜∀∈∗ ∂ ∖∈∃∨ ∂∖∈ ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∠∈ ∂∀∕∍∀−∗∠ ∋∍∌−∍, ∖∘∇∈∃ ∍ ∕∀∌∂∍∗∍∨ ∓∃∖∗∓∨∗∈∐∣∖∗∂. ∗∀∏∋∈ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣ ∘∋∈ ∂∏∐∧∜∀∈∗ ∂ ∖∈∃∨ ∃∈∖∜∍∖∐∈−−∓∈ ∑−∓∋∈∖∗∂∓ ∂∖∈ ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∠√ ∑∍∕∓∂. ∍ ∗∈, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∑∠ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∖∈∃∈ ∔∕∈∇∖∗∀∂∍∗∣ ∍ ∇∀∋∈ ∗∈, ∏∓∗∓∕∠∈ ∑∠ ∇∀∋∈ −∈ ∑∓∋∈∑ ∂∓∓∃∕∀∌∍∗∣. ∂∈∇∣ ∂ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∓∑ ∃∠∗∍∍ ∘∋∈ ∈∖∗∣ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∓ ∂∖∈!

∂∀∝ ∓∃∕∀∌ ∘∋∈ ∍∑∈∈∗∖∨ ∂∓ ∂∖∈√ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠√ ∑∍∕∀√. ∗∀∑ ∗∀∏∋∈ ∈∖∗∣ ∂∀∝∍ ∕∓∇∖∗∂∈−−∍∏∍ ∍ ∌−∀∏∓∑∠∈. ∂ ∓∇−∍√ ∑∍∕∀√ ∓−∍ ∗∀∏∍∈ ∋∈ , ∗∓∆∇∀ ∏∀∏ ∂ ∇∕∘∆∍√ −∈∖∏∓∐∣∏∓ ∍−∠∈. −∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∂ ∓∇−∓∑ ∍∌ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠√ ∑∍∕∓∂, ∂∀∝ ∓∗∈∛ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∖∍∐∣−∓ ∔∍∗∣, ∗∓∆∇∀ ∏∀∏ ∂ ∇∕∘∆∓∑ ∓− ∃∘∇∈∗ ∂∈∖∗∍ ∌∇∓∕∓∂∠∎ ∓∃∕∀∌ ∋∍∌−∍. ∍∐∍ ∂ ∓∇−∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ ∂∀∝∀ ∋∈−∀ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∃∠∗∣ ∕∀∖∖∈∨−∀ ∍ −∈∀∏∏∘∕∀∗−∀, ∗∓∆∇∀ ∏∀∏ ∂ ∇∕∘∆∓∑ ∑∓∋∈∗ ∃∠∗∣ ∓∜∈−∣ ∔∈∇∀−∗∍∜−∀ ∍ ∖∓∃∕∀−∀.

∔∓∥∗∓∑∘, ∈∖∐∍ ∍∑∈∗∣ ∖∔∓∖∓∃ ∔∈∕∈∑∈∞∀∗∣∖∨ ∍∐∍ ∗∈∐∈∔∓∕∗∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∂ ∐∧∃∓∎ ∍∌ ∔∀∕∀∐∐∈∐∣−∠√ ∍ ∀∐∣∗∈∕−∀∗∍∂−∠√ ∑∍∕∓∂, ∖∗∀−∓∂∍∗∖∨ ∂∓∌∑∓∋−∠∑, ∔∓∐−∓∈ ∍∌∑∈−∈−∍∈ ∖∘∇∣∃∠ ∍ ∋∍∌−∍ ∜∈∐∓∂∈∏∀, ∇∐∨ ∏∓−∏∕∈∗−∓∆∓ ∍−∇∍∂∍∇∀.




∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ «−∍∜∗∓ – ∂∖∈»?

∍∗∀∏, ∈∖∗∣ ∂∈∐∍∏∓∈ −∍∜∗∓. ∓−∓ ∈∖∗∣ ∖∘∗∣ ∍ ∂∑∈∖∗∍∐∍∞∈ ∂∖∈∆∓. ∂ ∑∀∗∈∑∀∗∍∏∈ ∀∃∖∓∐∧∗−∠√ ∂∈∐∍∜∍−, ∈∖∗∣ ∗∀∏∓∈ ∔∓−∨∗∍∈, ∜∗∓ −∓∐∣ ∘∋∈ ∀∂∗∓∑∀∗∍∜∈∖∏∍ ∂∏∐∧∜∀∈∗🔮 ∂ ∖∈∃∨ ∂∈∖∣ ∜∍∖∐∓∂∓∎ ∕∨∇ ∓∗ ∈∇∍−∍∛∠ ∇∓ ∇∈∂∨∗∍. ∏∀∏ ∍∌∂∈∖∗−∓ ∃∓∐∣∝∈ ∜∍∖∈∐ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗, ∀ ∓∖∗∀∐∣−∠∈ ∜∍∖∐∀ ∖∐∀∆∀∧∗∖∨ ∍∌ −∍√. ∏∀∏ ∥∗∓ −∍ ∔∀∕∀∇∓∏∖∀∐∣−∓ −∍∜∗∓ ∘∋∈ ∀∂∗∓∑∀∗∍∜∈∖∏∍ ∂∏∐∧∜∀∈∗ ∂ ∖∈∃∨ ∂∖∈. ∍ ∥∗∓ ∈∖∗∣ ∔∕∍∜∍−∀ ∑∍∕∀.
∗∓, ∜∗∓ ∑∍∕ ∃∠∐ ∏∓∆∇∀-∗∓ ∍ ∏∈∑ -∗∓ ∖∓∌∇∀−, ∗∀∏∋∈ ∍∐∐∧∌∍∨ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∓∆∕∀−∍∜∈−−∓∆∓ ∂∓∖∔∕∍∨∗∍∨ ∍ ∐∓∆∍∏∍. ∑∠ ∖∏∐∓−−∠ ∖∜∍∗∀∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∘ ∂∖∈∆∓ ∈∖∗∣ −∀∜∀∐∓ ∍ ∏∓−∈∛. −∓ ∂ ∇∈∎∖∗∂∍∗∈∐∣−∓∎ ∕∈∀∐∣−∓∖∗∍ ∥∗∓ −∈ ∗∀∏. ∂∖∈ ∘∋∈ ∈∖∗∣ ∍ ∂∖∈∆∇∀. ∗∀∏ ∏∀∏ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍ −∈ ∖∘∞∈∖∗∂∘∈∗. ∈∖∗∣ ∐∍∝∣ ∂∈∜−∓ ∇∐∨∞∍∎∖∨ ∑∍∆ – −∀∖∗∓∨∞∈∈. ∍ ∑∠ ∂∖∈∆∇∀ −∀√∓∇∍∑∖∨ ∂ −∈∑.

−∀∑ ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∏∀∋∈∗∖∨, ∜∗∓ ∑∠ ∔∈∕∈∑∈∞∀∈∑∖∨ ∂∓ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍. ∂∖∔∓∑−∍∗∈ ∖∈∃∨ ∂ ∇∈∗∖∗∂∈ ∍∐∍ √∓∗∨ ∃∠ ∇∈−∣ −∀∌∀∇. ∇∐∨ ∂∀∖ ∗∓∗ ∑∓∑∈−∗ ∗∓∋∈ ∖∜∍∗∀∐∖∨ – ∖∈∎∜∀∖. ∂∠ ∂∖∈∆∇∀ −∀√∓∇∍∐∍∖∣ ∂ ∑∓∑∈−∗∈ ∖∈∎∜∀∖. ∗∓∐∣∏∓ ∑∍∕ ∘√∓∇∍∗ ∂ ∔∕∓∝∐∓∈. ∀ ∂∀∝∈ «∨» ∂∖∈∆∇∀ ∓∖∗∀∈∗∖∨ ∂ −∀∖∗∓∨∞∈∑.

∗∓ ∋∈ ∏∀∖∀∈∗∖∨ ∍ ∔∕∓∖∗∕∀−∖∗∂∀. ∑∠ ∂∖∈∆∇∀ −∀√∓∇∍∑∖∨ ∂ ∗∓∜∏∈ ∌∇∈∖∣. ∆∇∈ ∃∠ ∑∠ −∍ ∃∠∐∍, ∑∠ ∂∖∈∆∇∀ ∌∇∈∖∣. ∈∖∐∍ −∀∖ ∖∔∕∀∝∍∂∀∧∗, ∆∇∈ ∗∠? ∑∠ ∓∗∂∈∜∀∈∑ ∨ - ∌∇∈∖∣. ∔∓∇∘∑∀∎∗∈ ∖∀∑∍.




∂∈∕−∈∑∖∨ ∏ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍

∂∖∈ ∜∗∓ ∗∕∈∃∘∈∗∖∨ ∔∓−∨∗∣, ∜∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣ ∔∕∓∖∗∍∕∀∈∗∖∨ ∂∓ ∂∖∈√ −∀∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∨√. ∓−∀ ∔∕∓∨∂∐∈−∀ ∂∓ ∂∖∈∑ ∍ ∂∖∈∆∇∀. ∓−∀ ∌∇∈∖∣ ∍ ∖∈∎∜∀∖.

∂ ∏∀∏∍√ −∀∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∨√ ∍∌∑∈∕∨∈∗∖∨ ∔∕∓∗∨∋∈−−∓∖∗∣ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍?

∂∓ ∂∖∈√! ∥∗∓ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∂∖∈ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ −∍∜∗∓. ∥∗∓ ∍ ∝∍∕∍−∀, ∍ ∇∓∐∆∓∗∀ ∍ ∆∐∘∃∍−∀. ∥∗∓ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∀∨ ∏∕∀∖∓∗∀ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∃∈∌∓∃∕∀∌∍∈. ∥∗∓ ∍ ∂∈∜−∓∖∗∣ ∂∕∈∑∈−∍, ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣ ∔∕∓∖∗∕∀−∖∗∂∀. ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∀∨ ∖∐∀∇∓∖∗∣ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∀∨ ∆∓∕∈∜∣. ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∖∜∀∖∗∣∈ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ −∈∖∜∀∖∗∣∈. ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ −∀∖∐∀∋∇∈−∍∈ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∖∗∕∀∇∀−∍∈ . ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∀∨ ∐∧∃∓∂∣ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∀∨ −∈−∀∂∍∖∗∣. ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∏∓∐∍∜∈∖∗∂∓ ∛∂∈∗∓∂ ∍ ∍√ ∔∓∐−∓∈ ∓∗∖∘∗∖∗∂∍∈. ∥∗∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∇∓∃∕∓ ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∈ ∌∐∓. ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣ −∈∎∗∕∀∐∣−∀, ∂ −∈∎ ∈∖∗∣ ∂∖∈ ∍ ∂∓ ∂∖∈√ −∀∔∕∀∂∐∈−∍∨√. ∖∔∍∖∓∏ ∑∓∋−∓ ∔∕∓∇∓∐∋∀∗∣ ∇∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍, −∓ ∑∠ −∈ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∗∕∀∗∍∗∣ −∀ ∥∗∓ ∂∕∈∑∨. ∇∘∑∀∧, ∖∘∗∣ ∂∠ ∔∓−∨∐∍.
∗∈∔∈∕∣ ∈∞∈ ∆∐∘∃∋∈ ∔∓∆∕∘∌∍∑∖∨ ∂ ∔∓−∍∑∀−∍∈ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍. ∥∗∓ ∂∖∈ ∍ −∍∜∗∓. −∓ ∥∗∓ ∂ ∗∓∋∈ ∂∕∈∑∨ «∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣» - ∥∗∓ ∐∍∝∣ ∔∓−∨∗∍∈. ∔∓−∨∗∍∈ ∈∖∗∣ ∕∈∌∘∐∣∗∀∗ ∑∠∝∐∈−∍∨. ∑∠∝∐∈−∍∈ ∈∖∗∣ ∖∂∓∎∖∗∂∓ −∀∝∈∆∓ ∕∀∌∘∑∀. ∕∀∌∘∑ ∈∖∗∣ ∖∂∓∎∖∗∂∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨. ∖∓∌−∀−∍∈ ∈∖∗∣ ∖∂∓∎∖∗∂∓ −∀∝∈∆∓ «∨». ∈∖∐∍ −∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∃∠ «∨» ∍∐∍ ∗∓∆∓, ∏∗∓ ∜∍∗∀∈∗ ∥∗∍ ∖∗∕∓∏∍ ∍ ∕∀∌∑∠∝∐∨∈∗ ∓ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍, ∗∓ −∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∃∠ ∍ ∖∀∑∓∆∓ ∔∓−∨∗∍∨. ∀ ∖∗∀∐∓ ∃∠∗∣, ∍ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∍…

∀ ∈∖∐∍ ∃∠ −∈ ∃∠∐∓ ∂∀∝∈∆∓ ∖∓∌−∀−∍∨ ∍∐∍ «∨ », ∗∓∆∓ , ∏∗∓ ∖∈∎∜∀∖ ∜∍∗∀∈∗ ∥∗∍ ∖∗∕∓∏∍, ∜∗∓∃∠ ∓∖∗∀∐∓∖∣ ∇∐∨ ∂∀∖? −∍∜∗∓, ∀ −∍∜∗∓ ∥∗∓ ∍ ∈∖∗∣ ∃∈∖∏∓−∈∜−∓∖∗∣ ∍∐∍ ∂∖∈. ∗∘∗-∗∓ ∏∕∘∆ ∍ ∌∀∑∠∏∀∈∗∖∨ ∂ ∖∀∑∓∑ ∖∈∃∈…






∏∕∘∗∓ ∇∀

∜∗∓ ∇∀∐∣∝∈ ∇∈∐∀∗∣ ∃∘∇∈∑?





∜∗∓ ∗∀∏∓∈ «∨»?


∂ ∥∗∓∑ ∑∍∕∈ −∀∝∈ «∨» ∖∏∐∓−−∓ ∖∈∃∨ ∀∖∖∓∛∍∍∕∓∂∀∗∣ ∖ ∜∈∑-∗∓ ∍∐∍ ∖ ∏∈∑-∗∓. −∀∔∕∍∑∈∕, ∖ ∍∑∈−∈∑ ∇∀−−∠∑ ∕∓∇∍∗∈∐∨∑∍ ∍∐∍ ∔∕∓∌∂∍∞∈∑ ∇∀−−∠∑ ∇∕∘∌∣∨∑∍. ∖∓ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∔∕∓∙∈∖∖∍∈∎ ∍∐∍ ∖∓∛∍∀∐∣−∠∑ ∖∗∀∗∘∖∓∑. ∖∓ ∖∂∓∈∎ ∕∓∇∓∖∐∓∂−∓∎ ∍∐∍
∖∈∑∈∎−∠∑ ∔∓∐∓∋∈−∍∈∑. ∖∓ ∖∂∓∍∑∍ ∏∀∜∈∖∗∂∀∑∍ √∀∕∀∏∗∈∕∀ ∍∐∍ ∑∠∖∐∨∑∍ ∓ ∖∈∃∈. ∗∀∏∍√ ∖∀∑∓∓∔∕∈∇∈∐∈−∍∎ ∓∜∈−∣ ∑−∓∆∓ ∍ ∑∠ −∈ ∃∘∇∈∑ ∍√ ∔∈∕∈∜∍∖∐∨∗∣. −∀ ∙∀∏∗∈ ∥∗∓ ∂∠∆∐∨∇∍∗ ∗∀∏:

−∀∝∍ ∓∖−∓∂−∠∈ ∖∀∑∓∓∗∓∋∇∈∖∗∂∐∈−∍∨

	∨ ∃∈∇∈−.		∨ −∈∘∜.		∨ √∓∌∨∍− ∏∂∀∕∗∍∕∠.		∨ ∑∘∋ ∓∐∣∆∍.
